jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
EOS Defense Systems USA designs and produces highly accurate, cost-effective, modular, and scalable Remote Weapon Systems that give warfighters a decisive edge in counter-UAS and ground-to-ground missions. Trusted across platforms, we're at the forefront of defense innovation.

At EOS our people are our strength. Here, engineers own their work throughout their life cycle. Working side by side with a small, multi-disciplinary team in a safe, collaborative workplace. The pace is fast, the mission is real, and you'll build your skills and grow your career while advancing technology that matters, from advanced effectors to AI. If you want hands-on engineering with real ownership and a direct line to the mission, EOS Defense Systems USA is the place to be.

**Senior Embedded Software Engineer (Remote Weapon Systems)**  
  
EOS is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, test, and integrate embedded software solutions that extend the capabilities of our high-performing, world-leading Remote Weapon Systems (RWS) across multiple programs. The ideal candidate will be a senior technical professional who can bridge the gap between hardware and software. In this role, you will integrate various technologies such as the development of multi-platform software for Line-Replaceable Units (LRUs), command-and-control (C2) interfaces, and discrete electrical signals to enable full remote control of our weapon systems. You will collaborate directly with our electrical engineering team, reviewing PCB schematics and component data sheets to ensure hardware perfectly aligns with software requirements.  
  
**This is an on-site position located at our facility in Huntsville, AL.**  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Embedded Software Architecture & Development: Design and implement robust, real-time software solutions across bare-metal, FreeRTOS, and Embedded Linux environments.
* Hardware-Software Co-Design: Review PCB schematics and component datasheets; collaborate extensively with electrical engineers to guarantee hardware effectively supports software capabilities.
* Control & Fire-Control Systems: Support critical technology upgrades by modifying DSP-based motor-control software and enhancing our Java-based Fire-Control System (FCS).
* LRU Engineering: Develop software for critical line-replaceable units, integrating command-and-control (C2) interfaces with discrete electrical signals for comprehensive remote operation.
* System Integration & Field Support: Work cross-functionally to integrate software with EO/IR and radar systems; travel as required to support customer reviews, field integration, and live-fire test operations.

  
**Required Qualifications:**  

* Education: BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a highly related technical discipline.
* Experience: 8+ years of progressively responsible software engineering experience, with a strong focus on embedded systems.
* Platform & Hardware Expertise: Proven development experience with Microchip microcontrollers/microprocessors, their development ecosystems, and general C/C++ bare-metal and RTOS programming.
* Industry & Security: Demonstrated experience working in a Government Contracting Environment. Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret-level U.S. security clearance.
* Core Competencies: Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills; willingness to travel to customer reviews or test ranges.

  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Advanced Degree: Master's degree in a relevant engineering or computer science field.
* Linux Build Systems & Tools: Hands-on experience building custom embedded Linux distributions using the Yocto Project.
* Middleware & Networking: Proficiency with DDS publish/subscribe middleware, TCP/UDP sockets, RS-232, and Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) protocols.
* Advanced Weapon System Tech: Experience developing Command and Control (C2) software, integrating EO/IR or radar systems, and exposure to EO/IR test and evaluation instruments.
* Next-Gen Innovation: Familiarity with AI/Machine Learning concepts and their practical application to advance automation and targeting software in remote weapon systems

**Outstanding Benefits/Perks:**  

* Excellent insurance coverage
* 401(k) match
* Generous PTO
* Tuition Reimbursement
* 9/80 Work Schedule

  
EOS Defense Systems is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identification and sexual orientation) or national origin in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. An Equal Opportunity Employer for disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, other protected veterans, and armed forces service medal veterans. An Equal Opportunity Employer of individuals with disabilities. We participate in E-Verify.

jobs.title: Cyber Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Description**

**Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?**

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

**Your greatest work is ahead!**

Leidos’ ***Defense Uncrewed Systems Integration*** ***and Test*** is seeking a motivated and ambitious **UAS** **Cyber SW Engineer** to join the Software, Simulation, Systems Engineering and Integration Directorate (S3I) Joint Technology Center – Systems Integration Lab (JSIL) Technology and Certification Center. As a **UAS** **Cyber SW Engineer**, you’ll be an integral part of a dynamic engineering team that supports UAS cyber systems. This role bridges the gap between software engineering and cybersecurity. The candidate will be responsible for the security architecture, secure coding, static/dynamic code analysis, and vulnerability remediation for critical application software across the full software development lifecycle. Working directly within an Agile/Scrum team, the candidate will ensure complex systems meet rigorous DoD cybersecurity requirements (such as DISA STIGs/SRGs and RMF standards) while actively contributing to modern continuous integration and automated software delivery pipelines.

**If this sounds like the kind of environment where you can thrive, keep reading!**

**Leidos Defense Sector** provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions. To explore and learn more, click here!

**Are you ready to make an impact? Share your resume with us today!**

**Primary Responsibilities**

* **Secure Software Development & Engineering:** Participate in the full lifecycle design, coding, testing, and integration of secure embedded and application software for military systems using C/C++ and Object-Oriented methodologies.
* **Static & Dynamic Code Analysis:** Perform, analyze, and track static and dynamic code analysis scan results (e.g., Parasoft, Coverity, Fortify) to identify vulnerabilities, eliminate security flaws, and guide development remediation efforts.
* **Security Control Implementation & Hardening:** Work with cross-functional software teams to implement and automate technical security controls, including DISA STIGs, SRGs, and industry best practice hardening guidelines across Linux, databases, and application baselines.
* **Security Code & Architecture Reviews:** Evaluate software requirements, system design changes, and proposed merge requests for security impact to determine authorization and risk mitigation.
* **CI/CD & Pipeline Security (DevSecOps):** Integrate automated security testing and compliance checks within CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Microsoft Azure DevOps, Git).
* **Vulnerability Scanning & Remediation:** Analyze vulnerability scan outputs (such as ACAS/Nessus) to develop and implement code- or configuration-level remediation plans.
* **RMF & Artifact Support:** Assist in updating Risk Management Framework (RMF) artifacts, including software/firmware inventories, interface specifications, and Ports, Protocols, and Services Management (PPSM) documentation.
* **Cross-Discipline Collaboration:** Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, technical interchange meetings, and hardware/software design reviews alongside Systems, Cyber, Safety, Operations, and Test teams.

**Basic Qualifications**

* The candidate must have a Bachelor’s degree in Software or Computer Engineering or a related STEM field from an accredited institution with four (4) years of applicable experience, or an additional Masters degree in a Cyber Security related field with two (2) years of experience.
* U.S. citizenship, an active DoW Secret Security Clearance and the ability to maintain a Secret Clearance are required.
* Must hold or be willing to acquire a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II baseline certification (e.g., **CompTIA Security+ CE**, CySA+, or higher/equivalent).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Strong hands-on programming experience with Rust, C/C++ or other Object-Oriented languages.
* Direct experience running and interpreting **Static Code Analysis** tools (e.g., Fortify, Sonarqube, Parasoft).
* Practical understanding of **DISA STIGs/SRGs** and application security (AppSec) hardening.
* Experience operating within an **Agile/Scrum** software development environment.
* Experience with source control, build systems, and CI/CD tools (e.g., **Git, Visual Studio, etc.**).
* Strong working knowledge of **Linux** and Windows operating environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with customer stakeholders and multi-disciplinary teams.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer - EUAS
jobs.description:
Overview:

i3 is seeking a Systems Engineer to support the EUAS Product Office within the Army’s PM Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS). This position supports requirements development and verification, system architecture, hardware and software integration, testing, fielding, and sustainment of UAS capabilities.

Responsibilities:

The successful candidate will work with government personnel, contractors, developers, testers, and operational stakeholders to translate user needs into technical requirements, evaluate system solutions, and support delivery of interoperable capabilities. This role requires a thorough understanding of systems engineering processes, Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) methodologies, and the integration of complex systems.

We are seeking a self-starter who can identify technical issues and risks, develop practical recommendations, and turn general guidance into actionable tasks. Relevant experience may include systems engineering, UAS hardware and software integration, requirements management, verification and testing, or technical leadership within an Army aviation program.

* Develop, review, refine, and maintain system and subsystem requirements, including traceability to operational needs and verification activities.
* Support requirements allocation, interface definition, and verification planning across hardware and software components.
* Support system architecture development and apply MBSE methodologies to assess requirements, interfaces, dependencies, and integration considerations.
* Review and contribute to Department of War architecture models and products using the DoDAF framework, including Project, Capability, Operational, Systems and Services, Standards, and Data and Information viewpoints.
* Work across organizations to identify future capability and interoperability needs and translate those needs into technical requirements and recommendations.
* Support hardware and software integration across UAS platforms, ground control systems, mission systems, and associated equipment.
* Coordinate with government teams, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), and software developers to evaluate proposed changes, software releases, hardware updates, and interface compatibility.
* Conduct or support trade studies and technical assessments to evaluate alternatives and inform architecture and system-level decisions.
* Identify technical risks, assess potential impacts, develop mitigation strategies, and recommend courses of action throughout the product life cycle.
* Participate in Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), Change Control Boards (CCBs), technical interchange meetings, design reviews, and acquisition milestone reviews.
* Support developmental and operational test planning, test readiness reviews, execution, discrepancy resolution, and evaluation of results against requirements.
* Coordinate with cybersecurity, test, hardware, software, and electrical engineering specialists to address technical concerns and support system readiness.
* Assess system designs and interfaces for alignment with Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA) principles.
* Provide technical inputs, dependencies, risks, and status updates to support the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS).
* Prepare and present technical and programmatic briefings, written assessments, and recommendations to government leadership and other stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, integration efficiency, test coverage, and delivery of capabilities to end users.

Qualifications:

Required Education and Experience:

* Bachelor’s degree in systems engineering, aerospace engineering, electrical engineering, software engineering, computer science, information systems, cybersecurity, information assurance, technology management, or a related field. Additional years of relevant experience may be substituted for the degree.
* A minimum of three (3) years of relevant professional experience, or a master’s degree in a related field and one (1) year of relevant professional experience.
* Relevant experience in systems engineering, requirements development or verification, system architecture, hardware or software integration, developmental or operational testing, or closely related technical work.
* A thorough understanding of requirements development and verification processes, system architecture, MBSE methodologies, and complex systems integration.
* Experience supporting Army aviation acquisition processes through technical activities such as development, integration, testing, fielding, or sustainment.
* Ability to identify technical issues and risks, evaluate alternatives, and develop mitigation strategies and actionable recommendations.
* Ability to interpret operational needs and communicate technical requirements to government stakeholders, developers, and contractors.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, including the ability to develop and present technical briefings.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* U.S. citizenship.
* A current Department of War Secret security clearance and the ability to maintain that clearance.

Preferred Experience:

* Direct support to EUAS, other PM UAS product offices, or Army aviation programs.
* Experience spanning both hardware and software acquisition, development, integration, or testing.
* Development and maintenance of DoDAF architecture products across multiple viewpoints.
* Experience reviewing or developing SysML models using Cameo or similar MBSE tools.
* UAS command and control, ground control stations, mission systems, or interoperability between platforms.
* Software development, software integration, Agile development methodologies, or coordination of government-owned and OEM software updates.
* Hardware-in-the-loop (HWIL) testing, automated testing, or integration laboratory activities.
* Cybersecurity engineering or coordination of cybersecurity

jobs.title: Systems Engineer - SPIE R&V
jobs.description:
**Grow With Us**

Your growth matters to us—that’s why we offer a variety of ways for you to develop your career. With professional and leadership development opportunities like Team Lead Academy, education reimbursement, mentoring, and company sponsored networking events, you can take control of your own career path on your own terms with a company that believes in you.

**A Place Where You Belong**

People are at the heart of our business. We reflect a diversity of cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. We expect our people, clients, and partners to treat one another with dignity and respect. This means promoting inclusion, celebrating diversity, and appreciating the differences we all bring to our workplace.

**Support Your Well-Being**

Our comprehensive benefits package includes wellness programs, 11 paid holidays, paid time off, employee perks and much more. With these benefits, plus the option for flexible schedules, we’ll support you as you pursue a balanced, fulfilling life—at work and at home.

**Our team is comprised of 10 companies working together on one mission, Moon to Mars and then beyond.**

This is an on-site position, and you will need the STARId to access Marshall Space Flight Center

**About the position**

The person in this position will provide systems engineering, requirements management, verification and validation (V&V) coordination, and element/system level integration support to the MSFC Systems Requirements, Verification & Validation Branch (EV72) for support to the Space Launch Systems (SLS) Program Spacecraft Payload Integration and Evolution (SPIE) Element Project Office, and to the MSFC Systems Engineering and Integration Division (EV70).

The successful candidate will coordinate and interface with multiple engineering disciplines, system elements, cross-program elements and customers, as well as participate in reviews, meetings, working groups, task teams, and trade studies. The candidate will supply leadership and/or support for the development of key systems engineering products including requirement, specifications, support program/project milestones and subsequent activities where these products are assessed and matured. The successful candidate will work with the SLS SPIE element customers/partners from inception to deployment to ensure stakeholder needs are satisfied.

System engineering support to be provided by the candidate includes the following responsibilities:

  

* Lead and/or support development of SPIE element requirements and verification products and ensure compliance with these requirements during development, testing and evaluation of SPIE sub-elements.
* Provide technical integration with other engineering disciplines, the SPIE Program element and cross-program elements, including risk-based insight/oversight through assessment of requirements and verification activities.
* Support the SPIE Lead Systems Engineer and Engineering Discipline Lead Engineers to evaluate prime contractor deliverables, including assessments of element Detailed Verification Objectives and verification of allocated end item specification requirements.
* Perform systems engineering tasks and assessments to support the SLS SPIE Program through reviews, meetings, working groups, trade studies and development of key systems engineering products to support program milestones.
* Develop integrated schedules and other tracking mechanisms to manage the work and identify risks and opportunities.
* Implement Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) best practices, approaches, techniques, and tools.
* Provide support for requirement V&V including V&V planning, execution, coordination, and integration for system level requirements to assure design compliance.
* Communicate technical issues, risks, best practices and lessons-learned related to products, technical positions, requirement management, and V&V practices and develop integrated schedules and other tracking mechanisms to manage systems engineering tasks.

jobs.description:
Position Overview

Marketplace Automation Shop is seeking a skilled and motivated Electrical Engineer / Industrial Automation Engineer with expertise in Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC), industrial control systems, electrical design, and automation technologies.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, programming, implementing, troubleshooting, and maintaining industrial automation systems. This position requires strong technical knowledge of PLC programming, Human Machine Interfaces (HMI), Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA), motor controls, and industrial electrical systems.

The engineer will work on automation projects ranging from equipment upgrades and control panel design to complete industrial automation.

Key Responsibilities:

1. PLC Programming & Industrial Automation Design, develop, program, and troubleshoot PLC-based control systems. Work with Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Schneider Electric, Mitsubishi, and other PLC platforms. Develop PLC programs using Ladder Logic, Structured Text, and Function Block programming. Design and implement automated machine control sequences. Integrate PLC systems with industrial equipment, sensors, actuators, and drives. Upgrade and retrofit existing industrial control systems.

2. Electrical Engineering & Control Systems Design industrial electrical control systems and automation panels. Develop electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and control panel layouts. Select and specify electrical components, including circuit breakers, relays, contactors, sensors, and power supplies. Design motor control systems using Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) and motor starters. Perform electrical load calculations and component sizing. Support control panel fabrication, wiring, testing, and commissioning. Apply relevant NEC, NFPA 70E, NFPA 79, and UL 508A requirements.

3. HMI & SCADA Development Develop and configure HMI operator interfaces. Design SCADA systems for industrial process monitoring and control. Configure alarms, trends, data logging, and production monitoring. Integrate PLCs with HMI and SCADA platforms. Work with FactoryTalk View, Siemens WinCC, Ignition, Wonderware, or similar software.

5. Installation, Commissioning & Troubleshooting Perform equipment startup, testing, and commissioning. Troubleshoot electrical, PLC, HMI, and automation system failures. Diagnose and resolve equipment downtime and performance issues. Conduct Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). Optimize equipment efficiency, reliability, and production performance. Provide on-site technical support to industrial customers.

6. Project Engineering & Technical Documentation Manage automation projects from initial concept through commissioning. Develop project specifications, equipment lists, and engineering documentation. Prepare bills of materials (BOMs) and technical proposals. Coordinate with customers, technicians, contractors, and equipment manufacturers. Maintain PLC programs, electrical drawings, and system documentation. Provide technical training and operational support to customers.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience. 3+ years of experience in industrial automation, PLC programming, or electrical controls engineering. Strong knowledge of industrial electrical systems and control circuits. Hands-on experience with PLC programming and troubleshooting. Experience with HMI and SCADA development. Ability to read and develop electrical schematics. Familiarity with VFDs, motor controls, sensors, and industrial instrumentation. Knowledge of industrial networking and communication protocols. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple engineering projects. Willingness to travel to customer facilities when required.

Experience with machine safety systems, safety PLCs, and emergency-stop circuits. Experience designing and building UL 508A industrial control panels. Familiarity with manufacturing equipment, conveyor systems, packaging machinery, and process automation. Experience with industrial IoT, remote monitoring, and data acquisition. Experience developing complete turnkey automation solutions. **Reports to:** Engineering Manager

**Summary:** As an FPGA/Firmware Engineer, you will primarily design, develop, integrate, and verify FPGA and SoC solutions for SIL’s advanced avionics, power systems, and lithium-ion battery technologies, while also developing embedded firmware to support integrated system functionality. You will work extensively with FPGA and SoC platforms, RTL design, digital logic, embedded processors, and hardware interfaces to implement reliable, high-performance solutions for mission-critical aerospace applications. Collaborating closely with electrical, systems, software, manufacturing, and test engineers, you will contribute throughout the development lifecycle, from requirements and design through prototyping, integration, verification, qualification, and production.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, implement, and maintain FPGA and SoC solutions for aerospace electronics and avionics systems.
* Develop, maintain, and verify RTL designs using Verilog and/or SystemVerilog.
* Perform FPGA synthesis, implementation, timing analysis, programming, optimization, and hardware debugging using applicable vendor development tools.
* Develop and execute FPGA verification strategies, including HDL testbenches, simulation, and hardware-based verification.
* Perform FPGA and SoC prototyping, hardware bring-up, integration, troubleshooting, and debugging.
* Integrate FPGA and SoC designs with PCBAs, embedded processors, sensors, memory devices, and other electronic components.
* Develop and maintain embedded firmware in C and/or C++ for microcontrollers, processors, and SoC platforms as required by system architecture.
* Develop and support communication interfaces and protocols between FPGA/SoC devices, embedded processors, and peripheral hardware.
* Collaborate with electrical, systems, software, and test engineers to define system requirements, interfaces, and design architectures.
* Use oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other laboratory equipment to evaluate hardware behavior and troubleshoot FPGA, firmware, and system-level issues.
* Participate in design reviews, technical reviews, requirements reviews, and system integration activities.
* Develop and maintain RTL, firmware, design, verification, interface, and other required technical documentation.
* Support functional, environmental, qualification, and acceptance testing of aerospace hardware.
* Work with test and manufacturing engineering to support production programming, testing, troubleshooting, and product transition activities.
* Maintain configuration-controlled source code and design files in accordance with established engineering, quality, version-control, and configuration-management processes.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve FPGA and firmware performance, reliability, maintainability, verification, and development processes.
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Experience:**

* 3+ years of professional experience in FPGA development, digital design, embedded systems, or a closely related engineering field.
* Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, integrating, and verifying FPGA/SoC-based systems.
* Experience with embedded firmware development and hardware/software integration.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, avionics, or other safety- or mission-critical applications is preferred.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong knowledge of digital logic design and FPGA-based systems.
* Proficiency in Verilog and/or SystemVerilog for RTL development and verification.
* Strong knowledge of FPGA synthesis, implementation, timing analysis, simulation, and hardware verification.
* Working knowledge of FPGA/SoC architectures, embedded processors, and associated hardware interfaces.
* Working knowledge of embedded firmware development using C and/or C++.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, interface documentation, requirements, and technical specifications.
* Ability to use laboratory equipment to perform FPGA and hardware bring-up, debugging, and troubleshooting.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with AMD/Xilinx and/or Intel FPGA and SoC platforms.
* Experience with communication interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, or similar protocols.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, avionics, or other safety- or mission-critical industries.
* Experience with lithium-ion battery systems, battery management systems, power electronics, or related aerospace applications.
* Experience supporting qualification, acceptance, or production testing of aerospace electronics.

**Education:**

jobs.title: Principal Hardware Engineer

jobs.description:
**About Arable**
----------------

At Arable, our goal is to connect the world’s farms to help optimize the global food system. As we work to feed a growing population while reducing our impact on natural resources, we believe a critical part of the solution is digitizing the analog world with high-fidelity data that helps food producers optimize their operations.

Our work helps improve the lives of farmers and contributes to securing the global food supply for decades to come.

**Examples of Our Work:**

* Helping farmers maximize ROI through precision irrigation and data-driven water management.
* Supporting leading agricultural and technology partners in meeting sustainability and climate resilience goals.
* Equipping growers with insights to improve decision-making, reduce waste, and enhance yields across diverse cropping systems.

**The Role**
------------

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on hardware engineer to drive the development of our hardware ecosystem, including the Arable Mark 3 and future sensing platforms.

This role centers on individual technical contribution and ownership across the hardware product lifecycle—from design and prototyping through production and field performance. You will work directly on engineering challenges while providing technical leadership, mentoring colleagues, and collaborating closely with internal teams and external partners.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys staying close to the work while helping shape the technical direction of sensing products used by growers around the world.

### **What You Will Do**

* Drive hardware development across the full product lifecycle, from concept to production.
* Coordinate domestic and offshore manufacturing operations.
* Review and validate ODM designs to meet Arable’s quality standards.
* Develop technical documentation for designs, testing, and support.
* Lead hands-on prototyping of new hardware products and features.
* Work with QA teams on product validation and testing.
* Collaborate with product management, software, operations, and customer success.
* Manage key vendor relationships and guide component selection.
* Troubleshoot hardware issues and coordinate bug tracking and resolution.
* Support manufacturing test fixtures and processes.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship, influence technology direction, and strengthen the team’s engineering capabilities.

### **Experience and Skills**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field.
* 6+ years of hardware engineering experience spanning the full PCB design lifecycle.
* Proficiency with schematic capture, PCB layout, board bring-up, and lab equipment.
* Knowledge of regulatory testing, including FCC and CE, and new product introduction (NPI) processes.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* A self-directed approach and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication and organizational skills.

**Preferred**

* Advanced technical degree.
* 8+ years of experience bringing multiple hardware products to mass production.
* Experience managing or collaborating with offshore teams.
* Knowledge of C programming for embedded systems.
* Experience with wireless product design (WiFi, BLE, cellular) and/or RTOS.
* Background in agricultural or environmental sensor technology.
* Experience leading engineering initiatives, developing processes, or mentoring engineers.
* Expertise in low-power system design, particularly for solar-powered and battery-powered devices.

### **Qualities for Success**

* **Passion for Sustainability:** Care deeply about global food systems and environmental impact.
* **Startup Mindset:** Thrive in a fast-paced environment and take ownership across multiple responsibilities.
* **Technical Leadership:** Lead through engineering expertise, sound judgment, and ownership of results.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Communicate effectively and build productive relationships across teams.
* **Resourcefulness:** Develop cost-effective solutions and troubleshoot real-world field challenges.
* **Adaptability:** Stay current with emerging technologies and navigate new challenges.
* **Mentorship:** Share knowledge and help elevate the work of colleagues and partners.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

At Arable, you will join dedicated team players who bring together diverse expertise and a passion for building a more sustainable future. You’ll find no shortage of lively conversation around the lunch table about the food we eat and how it is produced.

We are a fast-moving startup committed to providing a rewarding employee experience through our work, team, compensation, and benefits, including:

* Excellent medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits, and a 401(k) program.
* Opportunities to work closely with customers who are eager for our products and make a positive impact on their livelihoods and the world.
* A focus on community involvement and career development.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Optivolt**
------------------

Optivolt’s mission is to overshoot humanity’s energy supply by reimagining solar.

America is at an inflection point. We need reliable energy fast. The grid is aging. And solar, the only technology that deploys quickly enough, is still constrained by technology frozen in time.

To close this gap, we build intelligent solar systems that think and adapt to real world conditions. Optivolt solar systems understand the sun, the weather, shading, harsh conditions, and optimize energy flow in real time. Every Optivolt panel is designed with an aerospace power electronics brain sealed inside to make solar more powerful and cost effective than ever in any condition.

The next step is putting it everywhere. In the home as Optivolt Home Solar and in the field as Optivolt Solar Fields. Hyper performant, controllable, reliable solar that works for everyone, everywhere.

**Our Team & Traction**
-----------------------

Optivolt is a team of some of the best builders and doers in the world, drawing from incredible talent pools in aerospace, electrical engineering, design-led organizations. We ultimately will win by designing and building the world’s best solar energy products.

But chiefly important, our organization is a lab for those devoted to solving some of the toughest problems in energy. Everyone is expected to contribute to the mission meaningfully. Clear communication, rapid iteration, and strong work ethic is the floor for anyone on our team.

To date we’ve shipped over 20,000 units and have companies worth billions of dollars relying on our solar architecture.

**Why we are looking for you**
------------------------------

As an Electrical Engineer at Optivolt, you will design and develop the hardware systems that power, control, and connect our intelligent solar products. You will work across embedded electronics, system architecture, communications, sensing, and power management, including our Hub, which coordinates and controls distributed power electronics systems.

This is a hands-on role with significant ownership. You will design, build, test, debug, and iterate on real hardware, working closely with firmware, mechanical, test, and manufacturing teams to bring products from concept through production.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* **Own the electronics behind our Hub.** Design embedded control boards, communications interfaces, sensing circuits, and power-management hardware.
* **Design the system, not just the board.** Own Hub electrical architecture, including microcontrollers, connectivity, battery and power supply interfaces, and controls interfaces to distributed devices.
* **Take designs from schematic to working hardware.** Develop schematics, select components, lay out PCBs, and lead hardware design reviews.
* **Make our devices communicate reliably.** Integrate wired and wireless communications, including PLC, Bluetooth, and other relevant protocols.
* **Get hands-on in the lab.** Bring up and debug prototypes; investigate hardware, firmware, and system-level faults.
* **Make thoughtful design tradeoffs.** Optimize for low power, reliability, thermal performance, cost, and manufacturability.
* **Work closely with firmware.** Collaborate with firmware and software engineers on interfaces, controls, telemetry, and system integration.
* **Prove the hardware is ready for the field.** Develop validation procedures and support environmental testing, certification, and manufacturing ramp.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* **You have shipped hardware.** 3+ years of hands-on electrical engineering experience developing physical hardware products.
* **You know your circuit fundamentals.** Strong analog and digital circuit fundamentals, embedded electronics, and PCB design experience.
* **You understand embedded electronics.** Experience with microcontrollers, communications interfaces, and power-management circuits.
* **You can own a PCB design.** Proficiency in schematic capture and PCB tools such as Altium.
* **You are comfortable at the bench.** Comfort with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power supplies, and board bring-up.
* **You understand how devices communicate.** Knowledge of UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet, or similar interfaces.
* **You follow through from design to validation.** Ability to independently deliver validated hardware from requirements through prototype.

**Preferred skills**
--------------------

* **Experience with PLC, Bluetooth, wireless or** IoT hardware.
* **Experience with battery-powered,** low-power, or self-powered systems.
* **Familiarity with solar,** energy storage, and distributed energy controls.
* **Experience with outdoor electronics,** EMC/EMI, and high-volume production.

**Additional requirements**
---------------------------

* Willingness to work extended hours as needed to support critical milestones
* Everyone at Optivolt is required to participate in on call support for customers
* Must be based in San Francisco, CA

**Pay and benefits**
--------------------

The estimated starting base salary range for this role is $150K-210K depending on level, location and experience, plus a generous pre-IPO equity package

Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, unlimited PTO, plus extra fun perks!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Who we are**

Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America's drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment.

As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We're hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years.

**What you will be doing**

Neros builds drones for the modern battlefield. As a Senior Software Engineer on our Application team, you will build the tools and integrations our operators and engineers rely on. Mission planning and control software, desktop tools, and the connections between our systems and external command & control and situational awareness systems. You'll own major pieces end to end, from design to production software that keeps working when the network drops or the systems around it change.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain applications and integrations for operators and engineers — mission planning and control, configuration and monitoring tools, and connections to external command-and-control and situational-awareness systems
* Build cross-platform desktop and web applications (Windows, Mac, Linux)
* Own the interfaces your software depends on — data models, APIs, and external specifications that are incomplete or changing
* Design software that behaves correctly when connectivity is intermittent or unavailable
* Build test harnesses and simulators to verify software without access to live partner systems or hardware
* Write unit and integration tests for your software, partnering with our test organization on system and field testing

**You should have the following**

* 7+ years of experience designing, building and deploying production software
* Deep expertise in **TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust** or another modern application language
* Track record **owning significant software end to end** — from design to production, and after launch
* **Application** experience — cross-platform desktop (Electron, Qt, or similar) or modern web shipped to real users
* Solid **networking fundamentals** — TCP/UDP, message framing and serialization, and designing for unreliable or high-latency links
* Experience **working through interfaces you didn't control** — protocols, message formats, and APIs owned by another team or organization
* Experience building test harnesses or simulators for systems you couldn't test against directly

**Nice to have**

* **Production experience in more than one language** is a strong plus
* **TAK ecosystem** — ATAK plugins (Java/Kotlin), WinTAK plugins (C#), TAK Server, Cursor on Target
* **MAVLink** or other drone/robotics protocols
* Military or defense C2 or situational-awareness systems
* Geospatial and mapping — coordinate systems, datums, and map rendering
* Real-time operator interfaces — live telemetry, video, and many-vehicle displays
* Embedded or device-facing software — applications that talk directly to hardware
* Android development
* You fly — FPV, RC, or drones generally

$180,000 – $252,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are considered part of Neros' total compensation package.

SleepRes is developing next-generation sleep apnea therapy technologies that improve patient outcomes. We are a small, fast-moving R&D team focused on building high-quality medical devices that make a real-world impact.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Lead Electrical Engineer to lead the electrical and electronic architecture of current and next-generation positive airway pressure (PAP) therapy systems.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you will own the design, integration, verification, and production implementation of device electronics, including power architecture, PCBAs, sensors, blower and heater interfaces, display and user-interface hardware, communications hardware, electrical safety, EMC, and production-test interfaces.

You will work closely with systems, firmware, mechanical, software, V&V, NPI, quality, regulatory, overseas suppliers, and contract manufacturers to deliver reliable, compliant, and manufacturable electronics from concept through commercialization.

**Level**

This role may be filled at the Staff or Principal level based on experience, technical scope, and demonstrated leadership.

* Staff: Typically 8+ years of relevant product-development experience. Serves as the primary technical owner for the electrical discipline, leads architecture and cross-functional technical decisions, mentors engineers, and remains deeply hands-on in design, testing, and commercialization.

* Principal: Typically 10–12+ years of relevant experience with demonstrated platform-level technical leadership. Acts as a company-level authority for electrical architecture, establishes engineering standards, resolves the most complex multidisciplinary problems, mentors senior engineers, and influences multiple product generations.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead electrical architecture, design, development, and verification for SleepRes PAP products

* Own main control PCBAs, power distribution and conversion, sensor interfaces, blower and heater electronics, display/UI hardware, communications hardware, and electrical protection circuitry

* Translate system requirements into electrical specifications, interfaces, component selections, design margins, and production-ready solutions

* Lead schematic, PCB layout, component-selection, tolerance, derating, grounding, shielding, and signal-integrity reviews

* Own electrical-safety and EMC engineering, including early pre-compliance testing, troubleshooting, and support of formal certification testing

* Lead the hardware side of cellular, BLE, Wi-Fi, antenna, SIM/eSIM, and RF integration and support FCC, PTCRB, carrier, and related certification activities

* Support verification, reliability testing, and hands-on root-cause investigation using appropriate electrical laboratory equipment

* Work with NPI, PCBA suppliers, and contract manufacturers on DFM, testability, ICT/functional test, calibration, programming, end-of-line test, yield, and design transfer

* Partner with Operations and Strategic Sourcing on component lifecycle, alternate-source qualification, supplier changes, value engineering, and cost reduction

* Support design controls and risk management, including requirements, specifications, DFMEA, verification documentation, engineering reports, and design changes

**What We're Looking For**

* BS in Electrical Engineering or related engineering discipline (MS preferred)

* 8+ years of relevant electrical product-development experience; Principal-level candidates will typically bring 10–12+ years and demonstrated platform-level technical leadership

* Strong experience with analog and digital circuit design, embedded microcontroller systems, power electronics, sensor interfaces, PCB design, signal integrity, grounding, shielding, and EMC

* Strong hands-on laboratory and troubleshooting skills using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, power analyzers, electronic loads, and related equipment

* Experience with component selection, tolerance analysis, derating, lifecycle management, and alternate-component qualification

* Demonstrated experience taking complex electromechanical products from concept through commercial production

* Experience working directly with PCB assemblers, contract manufacturers, and component suppliers

* Strong systems thinking, communication, and ability to lead technical decisions in a fast-paced cross-functional environment

**Nice to Have**

* Experience developing CPAP, ventilator, respiratory, anesthesia, patient-monitoring, or other medical devices

* Medical-device development experience under ISO 13485 and FDA design controls/QMSR

* Familiarity with IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2, IEC 60601-1-11, and applicable IEC/ISO 80601 requirements

* Experience with pressure/flow sensors, blowers or motors, resistive heaters, thermistors, TFT/LCD displays, cellular modems, BLE, or Wi-Fi

* Experience with FCC, PTCRB, cellular-carrier, or other wireless-device certification

* Experience with production-test systems, high-volume Asian manufacturing partners, and electrical failure analysis

* Experience leading electrical engineers or serving as the electrical technical lead for a multidisciplinary product program

jobs.title: Validation & Tooling Software Engineer, Residential Energy Products
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

The Tesla Energy Device Software team is looking for a Software Engineer to design and maintain the internal tooling and simulation infrastructure that lets residential energy firmware teams move faster with higher confidence. You will work across Powerwall, Backup Gateway, Wall Connector, and related home energy products—building Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) environments that approach real-world behavior, and the visualization and debugging tools that make complex multi-process systems understandable.

Device software is only as good as the feedback loop around it. Our goal is tooling that shortens the path from idea to validated behavior: high-fidelity SIL, field-trace capture and replay, rich reports and dashboards, control-flow and system visibility, and extensible instrumentation (traces, hooks, probes). As products, revisions, capabilities, and regional variants grow—including market-specific configurations such as external companion hardware—you will regularly extend the platform so new and existing products can be brought into the same validation and debugging workflow.

 **What You'll Do**

* Design, implement, and maintain internal SIL, harness, and developer tooling (primarily Python and Go) that improves correctness, debuggability, and release confidence for residential energy device software
* Build and evolve close-to-real-life SIL environments for multi-process embedded Linux systems; close gaps between simulation and field behavior where they matter most
* Develop visualization and debugging tools—including report generation, SIL-driven dashboards, control-flow visualization, and related analysis views—so engineers can understand system behavior without spelunking logs alone
* Implement and support trace/hook/instrumentation systems that reach into device software (Go, Rust, C/C++); enable capture of traces in the field and faithful replay in SIL
* Onboard new products, product revisions, capabilities, and regional or market-specific configurations (e.g. installations that require additional external hardware) into shared tooling and SIL workflows
* Collaborate with Product, Device Software, Hardware, and Validation to turn team pain points into clear tool designs, tests, and shippable internal platforms
* Improve reliability and usability of tooling used daily by engineers; reduce time-to-root-cause for lab, SIL, and field issues
* Contribute to automated tests, CI integration, and engineering practices that raise product reliability, developer productivity, and release confidence
* Support production and fleet needs where tooling helps: bring-up, field anomaly reproduction, and continuous improvement after launch

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience
* Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and work in an extremely fast-paced, collaborative environment

**General Summary:**

The Connectivity Hardware Systems (HWS) team is looking for an engineer with a strong foundation in **digital communications, signal processing, and wireless systems** to work on characterization, validation, performance optimization, and debugging of next-generation Wi-Fi products.

In this role, you will work closely with hardware, PHY, RF, firmware, and systems engineering teams to understand wireless performance from theoretical models through implementation and silicon measurements. This position is well suited for a new graduate or early-career engineer who enjoys applying communication theory and signal-processing concepts to real-world wireless systems.

  

**What You'll Do**

* Characterize and analyze **Wi-Fi PHY and system performance** across different operating conditions.
* Apply digital communications and DSP fundamentals to understand and debug wireless performance issues.
* Analyze key PHY concepts including **OFDM/OFDMA, QAM, MIMO, beamforming, channel estimation, equalization, synchronization, coding, and link adaptation** .
* Analyze metrics such as **EVM, PER, sensitivity, throughput and transmit/receive performance** .
* Develop **MATLAB and Python** scripts for simulation, data processing, visualization, test automation, and characterization.
* Compare theoretical and simulated performance against measurements from actual Wi-Fi hardware.
* Analyze firmware, hardware and PHY logs to identify performance issues and help determine root cause.
* Work with experienced HWS, PHY, RF, firmware and design engineers to debug complex wireless-system problems.
* Develop an understanding of **IEEE 802.11 PHY/MAC** behavior and next-generation Wi-Fi features.
* Participate in lab characterization and system-level validation of wireless chipsets.
  

**Required Skills**

* Solid academic foundation in **Digital Communications** and **Digital Signal Processing** .
* Understanding of:
  + Digital modulation and demodulation
  + OFDM
  + Fourier transforms and spectral analysis
  + Sampling and filtering
  + Noise and communication-channel fundamentals
  + Probability/random processes as applied to communications
* Coursework or project experience with **MATLAB and/or Python** .
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Interest in hands-on wireless system characterization and debugging.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.

* Academic, internship, or project experience involving wireless communications, DSP, SDR, MATLAB simulation.
* Familiarity with RF concepts and basic RF test equipment is a plus.
* Python scripting and data-analysis experience.
* Exposure to embedded systems, firmware, FPGA/RTL, or hardware/software debugging is a plus.

jobs.title: Flight Control Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Imagine an air taxi that takes-off vertically and quietly, carries you and your fellow passengers across the city streets below, bringing you to the people and places you want to spend time with via the uncongested electric sky. Since 2009, our team has worked steadily to make this dream a reality. We’ve designed and tested many generations of prototype aircraft capable of serving in the urban environment. We’re looking for talented, committed individuals to join our team as we push toward certifying the Joby aircraft, scaling our manufacturing, and launching our initial commercial service.

Overview:

As a Flight Control Systems Engineer, you will be implementing and improving the flight control algorithm, running simulations and analysis to validate control law design, drafting tests to verify system level behavior in labs and on-aircraft. You will work alongside the system test team to debug and verify system performance and failure handling. You will help certification engineers draft and manage requirements and review test cases and procedures. You will work with the modeling team to create simulations and analysis frameworks for collecting and presenting critical design data. You will collaborate with the Aircraft, Safety, Avionics, Loads, Performance, and Rotor Dynamics teams to identify deficiencies and refine the aircraft design. You will work with test pilots to define desirable handling and flying characteristics, participate in mission planning, scenario simulations, and provide in-person support during envelope expansion flight testing. You will work with software engineers to ensure relevant tests are run and relevant artifacts are produced, stored, and linked.

  
Responsibilities:

* Simulation and analysis of aircraft responses
* Development and implementation of flight control features
* Data review from flight test and other testing platforms
* Test case authorship
* Tool development and continuous integration improvement
* Requirement authorship and management
* Authorship and management of artifacts used for compliance-showing

Required:

* B.S. + 3 years of experience, or M.S. in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, computer science, or a related field
* Knowledge in classical controls, modern state-space controls, and numerical optimization
* Knowledge in multi-body dynamics, aerodynamics, and electrical powertrain
* Knowledge in digital signal processing and real-time embedded systems
* Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink, C/C++, and Python
* Proficiency with continuous integration pipelines, virtual environments, and Linux operating systems

Desired:

* Passion about flying machines

**Compensation at Joby is a combination of base pay and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). The target base pay for this position is $115,200 - $198,200/yr. The compensation package will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.**

**Joby also offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid time off, healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan with a company match, an employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, and more.**

  
Additional Information:

Joby is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

***Job Title: Senior Specialist, Electrical Engineer- Mixed-Signal DSP Hardware Engineer***

***Job Code: 46257***  
***Job Location: San Diego, CA***  
***Job Schedule: 9/80 1st Shift***

**Job Description:**

L3Harris is seeking a Senior Hardware Engineer to develop mixed-signal, high-speed digital, and DSP-oriented hardware for Tracking, Telemetry, and Command products used in airborne and space-based electronic systems. The role includes architecture, detailed design, verification, troubleshooting, integration, and production support for converter-based receiver, transmitter, direct-conversion, and modem subsystems incorporating high-speed ADCs, DACs, AFEs, PLLs, clock distribution, FPGA or ASIC interfaces, power supplies, and GHz-class signal interfaces. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in timing, synchronization, throughput, signal integrity, power integrity, noise performance, and hardware/software partitioning across modem and signal-processing systems.

**Essential Functions:**

* Lead the design and development of mixed-signal, high-speed digital, and DSP hardware for advanced electronic systems, including receiver, transmitter, direct-conversion, and modem signal chains, with responsibility for architecture, schematic capture, component selection, derating, worst-case analysis, and hardware documentation.
* Design hardware that supports or implements DSP functions, including high-speed digital data paths, converter interfaces, synchronization, and throughput-critical processing chains, and optimize digital hardware platforms used to execute, accelerate, or interface with DSP algorithms.
* Guide PCB layout and board-level implementation for high-speed mixed-signal designs, including stack-up definition, placement, controlled impedance, grounding, isolation, power distribution, and design considerations for signal integrity, power integrity, dynamic range, jitter, phase noise, and overall noise performance.
* Conduct trade studies, simulations, hardware bring-up, debugging, design verification, and troubleshooting to the component level to support architecture selection, clocking strategy, hardware/software partitioning, and product performance through integration, test, manufacturing, and production.
* Collaborate closely with FPGA, ASIC, RF, DSP, software, systems, mechanical, and manufacturing engineering teams, and provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior engineers.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field with 6+ years of prior related experience, or Graduate degree with 4+ years of prior related experience.
* Active Secret security clearance

**Preferred Additional Skills**

* Experience designing mixed-signal and high-speed digital hardware using ADCs, DACs, AFEs, FPGA interfaces, ASIC interfaces, and high-speed digital data paths, including hardware that supports or implements DSP functions.
* Strong understanding of direct-conversion, modem, and related communications and signal-processing architectures, including timing, synchronization, clocking, throughput, and converter interfaces such as JESD204.
* Experience optimizing hardware platforms for DSP algorithms and working at the hardware/software boundary, including partitioning functions across hardware, programmable logic, embedded processing, and software-defined modem implementations.
* Experience with signal integrity, power integrity, low-noise power design, and GHz-class board-level implementation, including design and implementation of point-of-load power supplies for FPGAs, ADCs, DACs, AFEs, and other high-performance devices.
* Familiarity with RF principles as applied to converter-based and high-frequency modem systems.
* Experience with schematic capture, design analysis, laboratory debug, and design verification testing.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering environment.
* Experience with direct RF sampling, integrated AFEs, modern converter-based system architectures, PLLs, synthesizers, jitter-cleaning clocks, clock buffering, and phase-coherent timing systems.
* Experience with SI/PI simulation, PCB layout guidance for high-speed mixed-signal hardware, and familiarity with performance metrics such as EVM, SNR, SFDR, ENOB, phase noise, I/Q imbalance, and LO leakage.
* Experience with RF and high-frequency modem architecture, DSP integration, partitioning of functions between hardware, FPGA or ASIC resources, firmware, and software, and modem implementation as part of a complete communications subsystem.
* Experience supporting high-reliability, military, or aerospace hardware development.

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer, Precision Instrumentation
jobs.description:
**About Astera**
----------------

Astera is a private foundation on a mission to steer science and technology toward a better future. We believe the coming years will bring an era of unprecedented scientific and technological advancement as exponential progress in AI converges with central advances in other fields to accelerate innovation. This inflection point provides an unparalleled opportunity to fundamentally rethink the institutions, systems, and tools that drive progress. We have committed a $3.5B endowment to that work and fit the form of our support to the function it serves: grants, investments, and in-house research programs. We accept meaningful risk in the research we back and expect some of it to fail because transformative ideas are rarely the ones already proven. Our projects, and the foundation itself, operate like high-velocity startups, with a high performance bar and competitive compensation to match. We are searching for leaders who are compelled by the challenge of driving high-impact change in the way science is funded, conducted, and communicated. You can read more about our mission, vision, and programming at astera.org/vision.

**Company Overview**
--------------------

Astera Neuro seeks to understand and engineer consciousness. We believe consciousness is the process by which the brain builds a coherent internal model of the world and the self. We aim to understand this model and to develop the technologies to write experience directly into the brain. By combining large-scale neural recording, causal perturbation, and brain-based AI, we seek to move neuroscience from observing correlates of experience to engineering it. The same tools carry direct therapeutic promise for neurological and psychiatric diseases that alter perception, thought, and sense of self. Because the science and tools required do not yet exist, we are assembling a founding team of neuroscientists, theorists, and engineers to create them. We do high-risk, high-reward science in a well-resourced, collaborative environment with competitive pay, and share everything openly under Astera's Open Science Policy.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

As a Hardware Engineer, you will design and build the physical systems our experiments depend on, most of which don't exist commercially. Working directly with scientists, you will take a project from a well-specified plan or a rough idea through design, fabrication, and iteration until it works for the experiment. The work crosses mechanical design, fabrication, electronics, and optics, often within a single project.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Design precision mechanical systems for experiments, such as titanium microfixtures, micrometer-precision electrode drives, and custom machined jigs.
* Build components for custom microscopes and optical systems, including alignment and mounting hardware.
* Design and iterate custom laboratory instrumentation and surgical or experimental robotics alongside the scientists who depend on them.
* Develop electronics and control hardware that interface mechanical systems with data acquisition and the rest of the research stack.
* Help build the design and prototyping facility itself — the tooling, workflows, and fabrication capabilities that determine how fast the team can move.

**Who You Are**
---------------

***Required:***

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in mechanical, electrical, or biomedical engineering, physics, or a related field, with a track record of building precision hardware in a high-precision industry (e.g., medical devices, robotics, aerospace, semiconductor capital equipment, or commercial scientific instrumentation).
* Experience designing and building hardware that other people relied on for real work, and keeping it running.
* Resourcefulness about getting things built quickly: comfortable machining one part, 3D-printing the next, and outsourcing what's better made elsewhere.
* Comfort working from a rough idea rather than a finished spec, figuring out the path to a working instrument together with the people who need it.
* Deep fundamentals in mechanical design and fabrication, with real working ability in electronics or optics; you do not restrict yourself to what is familiar.
* Intellectual curiosity, collaborative instincts, and eagerness to learn the science around you.
* A track record of owning complex instruments end-to-end, from concept through fabrication, integration, and reliable operation.
* Experience making and defending design tradeoffs across performance, manufacturability, cost, and timeline.
* Experience equipping and running a workshop, makerspace, or prototyping facility.

***Preferred/Nice to Have:***

* Experience with small precise parts, difficult materials, tight tolerances, precision motion, or optical alignment.
* Hands-on electronics design experience (PCB layout, embedded systems, sensor/actuator integration).
* Familiarity with electrophysiology or other low-volume, high-complexity hardware environments.
* CAD/CAM proficiency with hands-on machining (CNC, lathe, mill) and 3D printing.
* Experience integrating hardware with data acquisition systems (DAQ, TTL synchronization, serial/SPI protocols).

**Why Join Us**
---------------

Join a founding-caliber hardware team building instruments that don't exist anywhere else, in service of understanding how the brain works. You'll own complex builds end-to-end, work shoulder-to-shoulder with the scientists who use what you make, and help shape the engineering culture, tools, and standards of our design and prototyping facility as the team grows.

*Astera Neuro provides a comprehensive benefits package and total compensation that is competitive and commensurate with the level of experience and qualifications.*

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity and inclusion!*

Compensation Range: $200K - $300K

**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

Help build the optical connectivity that moves AI forward.  
AI performance depends on more than compute—it depends on how efficiently data moves. At Marvell, you’ll help turn advanced coherent DSP technology into high-performance hardware platforms that enable faster, more power-efficient optical networks.  
  
This position is based in our Irvine, California office and requires working onsite five days per week. Remote and hybrid arrangements are not available.

**What You Can Expect**

Join the team developing hardware platforms for Marvell’s coherent digital signal processors (DSPs), critical enablers of high-speed transmission over fiber-optic networks. Our technology supports the bandwidth, reach, and efficiency demanded by hyperscale cloud infrastructure and telecommunications networks worldwide.

Across Marvell, semiconductor innovation helps customers scale up compute, scale out networks, and scale across interconnected data centers. Within that broader mission, our team focuses on coherent optical connectivity—transforming advanced silicon into reference designs and evaluation platforms that demonstrate performance and accelerate customer adoption.

As a Sr. Staff Hardware Design Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of high-speed electronics, optical communications, and system engineering, solving the physical design challenges that determine how effectively next-generation silicon performs in the real world.

**Your Impact**

Take technical ownership of complex board-level designs, from architecture and simulation through bring-up, characterization, and validation. Your engineering decisions will directly influence platform performance, design quality, and development execution.

* **Develop high-performance coherent DSP platforms.** Design reference boards and evaluation systems supporting 400G/800G-per-wavelength optical transmission, including power delivery, control, clocking, high-speed I/O, and form-factor requirements.
* **Push high-frequency signal integrity.** Architect, simulate, and characterize high-speed interconnects and signal paths with bandwidth requirements exceeding 110 GHz, correlating simulation results with laboratory measurements.
* **Engineer robust power delivery.** Design and simulate power circuits and power distribution networks that meet the demanding requirements of high-performance coherent DSPs.
* **Translate silicon requirements into complete systems.** Collaborate with systems, analog, digital, firmware, design-for-test, failure analysis, validation, and applications engineers to define platform requirements and resolve design tradeoffs.
* **Lead board bring-up and debug.** Partner with hardware and firmware engineers to establish initial functionality, isolate issues, and drive corrective actions.
* **Prove performance through disciplined validation.** Develop and execute board validation plans, analyze results, and produce detailed reports documenting performance, issues, and recommendations.
* **Resolve complex hardware failures.** Perform board-level failure analysis, identify root causes, and define necessary repairs or design improvements.
* **Deliver manufacturable designs.** Work with PCB layout engineers, fabrication suppliers, and assembly partners to define placement, stack-ups, routing constraints, and design rules that support quality and timely delivery.
* **Strengthen engineering execution.** Contribute technical guidance, design reviews, and practical improvements that help the team build better hardware with fewer iterations.

**What Can You Expect**

* **Work on a critical challenge in AI infrastructure.** Help address the bandwidth and power constraints that shape how cloud and AI networks grow.
* **Own the full hardware development cycle.** Carry designs from initial requirements through simulation, fabrication, bring-up, and validated performance.
* **Combine deep analysis with hands-on engineering.** Move between electromagnetic simulation, schematic design, laboratory measurements, and system-level troubleshooting.
* **Collaborate across disciplines.** Work directly with specialists whose expertise spans silicon architecture, high-speed analog design, firmware, optical systems, and customer applications.
* **Build expertise with lasting relevance.** Deepen your capabilities in coherent DSP platforms, high-frequency signal integrity, power integrity, and advanced PCB implementation.
* **Make a visible technical contribution.** Bring your judgment to complex design decisions and help translate Marvell’s semiconductor innovation into platforms customers can evaluate and adopt.

**What We're Looking For**

You bring strong board-level design fundamentals, sound engineering judgment, and the persistence to solve difficult problems from simulation through the lab.

jobs.description:
**Who we are**

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

**What we are looking for**

We’re searching for a **Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure** to join our Behavior Analysis team, reporting to the team’s engineering manager. Aurora’s trucks already haul freight on Texas highways with no one on board, and every new version of the learned model that drives them has to prove, on real driving data, that it is better and safer than the one before. Behavior Analysis builds the systems that make that call: the evals that compare model versions, the embedding search that makes every driving scenario findable, and the introspection tools that show why a model did what it did. Engineers build more than 100 training and eval datasets a week through our tools. We’re a small team, so each engineer owns whole systems, and we work agent-first: our tools are built for AI agents to drive as easily as engineers do. You’ll own core pieces of that loop and help lead what comes next: putting LLMs, VLMs and agents to work on analysis, so questions that take days to answer today take minutes.

**In this role you will**

* Build and scale evaluation pipelines that compare model versions on large driving datasets: offline evals, slice-based metrics, regression detection, and model-vs-model reports.
* Own embedding and vector-search pipelines over driving data, versioned per model, so engineers can search, cluster and compare how any model represents the world. This is where you’d start: owning embedding generation and search end to end.
* Build model introspection infrastructure (attention, attribution, ablations) that turns “why did the model do that?” from a research project into a query.
* Help define how frontier LLMs, VLMs and agents change ML analysis here: triaging, labeling, clustering and summarizing driving scenarios and eval results. We already have a prototype using LLMs for data curation, and you’d help decide where it goes next.
* Work side by side with the ML engineers training these models to decide what to measure, then make those measurements trustworthy, observable and cheap enough to run on every candidate model.
* Build the web app and CLI that engineers and AI agents use to find datasets, training runs, evals and their costs, designed with agents as first-class users.

**Required qualifications**

* Typically 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, data or ML infrastructure.
* Strong Python, and proficiency with SQL.
* Designed and operated large-scale batch or data pipelines on cloud infrastructure, including backfills, retries and cost management.
* Built systems that measure or evaluate something: metrics, experimentation, evaluation or analytics platforms.
* Experience with distributed compute and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, AWS Batch or similar).

**Desirable qualifications**

* ML evaluation infrastructure: eval harnesses, golden datasets, regression detection, A/B model comparison.
* Embeddings and vector search, or model introspection and interpretability tooling.
* Using LLMs, VLMs or agentic workflows to automate analysis, labeling or data curation.
* Autonomous vehicles, robotics or other large-scale sensor data.
* Observability for data systems (metrics, alerting, SLOs), and everyday use of AI coding agents.
* Coming from backend or data engineering and want to learn ML evaluation? Apply anyway: we’ll teach you the ML side.

*For roles based in Mountain View, CA:* The salary range for this position is $162,000 - $260,000 per year.

Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America's drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy.
