**What you will be doing**

As an Electrical Engineer III, Design Assurance at Neros, you will bring up, characterize, and validate the circuit boards that go into our next generation airside and groundside platforms. You will write and run test plans, contribute to worst-case circuit analysis from schematic through bench validation, and design the fixtures and automated test setups behind that work. You will work with design engineers during product development to get results back into the design.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Bring up, characterize, and validate new circuit boards against requirements
* Contribute to worst-case circuit analysis, from schematic-level calculations and simulation through post-layout checks and bench validation, feeding measured results back into the analysis
* Write and execute test plans, procedures, and reports
* Design and build test fixtures, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) setups, and automated test scripts
* Run qualification and reliability testing, including thermal, vibration, and HALT/HASS, and support root-cause analysis on failures
* Provide design-for-test (DFT) input to design engineers during product development

**You should have the following:**

* 4+ years of experience in electrical hardware engineering, with hands-on bench validation of circuit boards
* Board bring-up and characterization experience, including writing your own test plans and reports
* Proficiency with bench instrumentation: oscilloscopes, logic and protocol analyzers, power supplies, electronic loads, DMMs, and spectrum analyzers
* Board-level design experience: schematics and PCBs you designed yourself. Test fixtures and test boards count
* Circuit analysis across analog, digital, and power supply circuits, including hand calculations, tolerance analysis, and SPICE simulation (LTspice or similar)
* Test automation and data analysis in Python or similar
* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related field

**Nice to have:**

* Signal and power integrity simulation (HyperLynx, SIwave, or similar) and bench measurement (TDR, VNA, eye diagrams)
* Hands-on WCCA and component derating on production hardware

jobs.description:
San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 47776

  

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

**Your Role:**
--------------

Roblox's data infrastructure processes petabytes of data daily, powering analytics, ML, and product decisions for a platform serving 200M+ daily active users. As a **Senior Software Engineer** on our **Real-time Analytics Platform team**, you will design, build, and scale the core OLAP infrastructure powering sub-second analytical queries across Roblox. Our team directly owns and operates **StarRocks** and **Apache Druid**, driving high-throughput streaming ingestion and low-latency MPP query processing. You will lead the next-generation architecture of our real-time analytics platform, combining high ownership and deep technical complexity to push the boundaries of MPP engine performance, streaming ingestion pipelines, and cluster scalability.

**You Will:**
-------------

* **Own and Scale Core OLAP Platforms**: Take end-to-end ownership of the architecture, operational health, and scalability of our high-throughput OLAP engines, specifically **StarRocks** and **Apache Druid**.
* **Optimize Query Engine Performance**: Dive deep into engine internals, cost-based optimization (CBO), query planning, vectorized execution, memory optimization, and serialization efficiency to maximize throughput and maintain sub-second latency under heavy concurrent load.
* **Architect Streaming Ingestion Pipelines**: Design, build, and optimize real-time data ingestion paths leveraging **Apache Kafka**, **Apache Flink** and native engine load mechanisms.

jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

Performs technical planning, system integration, verification and validation, cost and risk, and supportability and effectiveness analyses for total systems. Analyses are performed at all levels of total system product to include: concept, design, fabrication, test, installation, operation, maintenance and disposal. Ensures the logical and systematic conversion of customer or product requirements into total systems solutions that acknowledge technical, schedule, and cost constraints. Performs functional analysis, timeline analysis, detail trade studies, requirements allocation and interface definition studies to translate customer requirements into hardware and software specifications.

We are seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to drive the technical lifecycle, requirements verification, and customer delivery of our software-intensive systems. In this role, you will act as the primary technical interface between our engineering teams and the customer. You will focus heavily on managing engineering timelines, resolving system deficiencies, and coordinating formal program deliverables.

Your primary focus will be on execution, workflow management via Jira/Confluence, and customer delivery. * CDRL & Lifecycle Management: Lead the preparation, tracking, and formal delivery of Contract Data Requirements Lists (CDRLs) and engineering artifacts across major program milestones
* Deficiency & Workflow Tracking: Manage Deficiency Reports (DRs), technical anomalies, and execution timelines leveraging Jira and Confluence to keep developers and stakeholders aligned.
* Customer Interface & Demos: Serve as a key technical point of contact for the customer, planning and executing formal software solution demonstrations, technical reviews, and user evaluations.
* Interface & Code Literacy: Read, understand, and occasionally write scripts to analyze software data, or evaluate interface specifications
* Architecture Support: Maintain a working familiarity with Cameo Systems Modeler to reference system models, update basic interface definitions, and ensure alignment with the overall system design.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* B.S. in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Management, or a related technical field.
* Systems engineering experience within the Defense / Aerospace industry.
* Program Management Tools: Expert-level familiarity with Jira and Confluence for tracking deliverables, requirements, and deficiency resolution schedules.
* Software Literacy: Practical familiarity with Python with the ability to review code, understand system/software interfaces, and collaborate closely with software developers.
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with proven experience leading technical presentations and solution demos for government customers.

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Experience mapping formal requirements to software test cases or verification matrices.
* High-Performance Computing: Experience or familiarity with C++ architectures and GPU-accelerated computing (e.g., CUDA processing) to better understand high-throughput data pipelines and hardware/software boundaries.

* Collaborate with end users to translate feature requests into actionable software design. Build algorithms and models to foster data-driven decision making

* Write technical documentation for the design and use of equipment

* Proficiency in Python is required, knowledge of programming languages and fieldbus protocols such as the following: PLC programming, TCP/IP, MQTT, IIoT, Modbus, RS232, SCADA, Motion Control.

* **SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER – BACK END**

  **About Tillster**

  Headquartered in the USA, Tillster is the global leader in digital ordering and customer engagement solutions. For over a decade we have developed revolutionary self-service, ordering and payments solutions – for mobile, tablet, online, kiosk, call center, and more – creating personalized interactions based on consumer preferences, language, and currency. Our platform is compatible with 15+ unique POS systems, representing over 90% coverage in multi-unit restaurants. We offer one platform: one scalable, enterprise class solution – to create world-class digital engagement solutions. Our mission and passion are one in the same: Empower restaurants and consumers to engage and transact anywhere, anytime, and from any device - one consumer at a time, one order at a time, billions of times over. In doing so, together we are transforming e-commerce in restaurants and making the till grow for Tillster and our customers.

  **Are you a passionate Software Engineer with a knack for designing and developing quality software solutions? Tillster is the place for you—we are seeking an experienced Software Engineer.**

  **About the Role**

  As a Senior Software Engineer (SSWE), **BACK END** you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and maintaining our cloud-based microservices. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that meet business needs while following best practices, including design patterns, architectural patterns, thorough testing methodologies, **and modern AI developer tools to accelerate quality software delivery.** You will contribute to fostering an agile, collaborative, and high-performing development environment.

  **What You'll Do**

  + Building highly scalable, secure, and high-performance microservices using AWS and TypeScript. Apply key software engineering principles, design patterns, and architectural best practices.
  + Leverage state-of-the-art AI developer tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, LLM reasoning models) to accelerate context gathering, boilerplating, test generation, and code refactoring.
  + Build and maintain microservices that communicate via well-defined APIs, ensuring service modularity and scalability.

jobs.description:
San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 36414

  

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Roblox’s data platform processes petabytes of data daily, powering analytics, ML, and product decisions. The Data Platform Compute team owns the compute layer underneath it: the Kubernetes (EKS) clusters where all of Roblox’s Spark workloads run, and the software that lets engineers, analysts, and ML practitioners submit and run that work reliably and cost-effectively.

As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you will build and operate the systems that sit between our users and the cluster. These include the Spark job submission service, our internal Spark libraries, interactive notebook compute, and cluster lifecycle automation. You’ll have real ownership, you’ll work on problems where the design is not yet settled, and you’ll help decide which technologies Roblox adopts next.

**You Will:**

* **Build and own core compute platform services:** Design, build, and operate the software behind Spark job submission, including APIs, scheduling integration, and the libraries users depend on.
* **Launch interactive Spark at scale:** Deliver Spark Connect to support notebook workflows, including provisioning and managing the EKS compute that backs them, with sensible isolation, resource limits, and cost controls.
* **Run a safe, automated cluster fleet:** Build fleet management automation for EKS, such as blue-green rollouts that validate new AMIs and Kubernetes versions before they reach production workloads, with minimal disruption to running jobs.
* **Make jobs run better without user effort:** Develop our auto-tuner, which analyzes Spark history and event logs to recommend or apply job configuration changes that improve performance and reduce cost.
* **Own batch scheduling on Kubernetes:** Operate and upgrade our YuniKorn-based scheduling, including queue design, quotas, fairness across tenants, and version upgrades.
* **Shape what we adopt next:** Evaluate emerging technology such as native Spark acceleration (e.g., Apache Comet). Run rigorous benchmarks on real Roblox workloads and make a clear recommendation backed by data.
* **Be an owner of reliability and cost:** Define SLOs and metrics, build observability, and drive down toil, incidents, and compute spend across a multi-tenant platform.
* **Partner across the company:** Work with data engineering, ML, analytics, and infrastructure teams to understand their needs, communicate changes, and migrate users to better paths.

**You Have:**

* 5+ years of experience building and operating production-grade distributed systems or infrastructure platforms.
* **Spark on Kubernetes:** Hands-on experience running Apache Spark on Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, or self-managed) as a platform, including executor and driver behavior, resource tuning, and troubleshooting failed or slow jobs. We are looking for platform builders, not just Spark users.
* **Kubernetes depth:** Strong experience operating production Kubernetes clusters at scale, such as upgrades, node lifecycle, autoscaling, and operators or controllers.
* **Engineering foundations:** Strong proficiency in at least one of **Go, Java, Scala, or Clojure**, with a track record of writing clean, well-tested, maintainable backend code. Python is a plus, since much of our tuning and analysis tooling uses it.
* **Cloud fluency:** Experience with AWS (EKS, EC2, IAM, S3) or GCP equivalents, and infrastructure-as-code.
* **Operational ownership:** Experience taking a system from design through production operation, including on-call, incident response, and observability.
* **Technical leadership:** Ability to influence design decisions across teams, mentor engineers, and drive alignment on cross-cutting changes.
* B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
* Bonus Points:
  + Experience with YuniKorn, Volcano, Kueue, or other batch schedulers on Kubernetes.
  + Experience with Spark Connect, Livy, Kyuubi, or other interactive and gateway layers for Spark.
  + Experience with the Spark Operator, Karpenter, Helm, Terraform, or Argo.
  + Experience building tooling that uses Spark event logs or metrics for tuning, cost attribution, or anomaly detection.
  + Experience maintaining internal Spark builds or driving Spark version upgrades.
  + Familiarity with native execution engines (Comet, Gluten, Velox) or JVM performance tuning.
  + Experience migrating workloads from YARN/Hadoop to Kubernetes.
  + Contributions to open-source projects in the data or Kubernetes ecosystem.
  + Experience operating at consumer-internet scale (100M+ users).

Apache Airflow is ideal, but experience with an equivalent system (Dagster, Prefect, Temporal, or a large in-house scheduler) is also welcome. You understand scheduler and executor design, metadata store performance, task isolation, retries and idempotency, and safe upgrades and migrations.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer Principal – Core Systems Engineering – Lead Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems (SMS) is seeking a Lead Systems Engineer to provide Element-level systems engineering leadership for advanced technological system development. This role is responsible for ensuring alignment between stakeholder needs, system architecture, and subsystem performance while guiding the program through design, integration, and validation.
  
  
This position is for an experienced individual who can work in and lead a multi-disciplinary team through every stage of program’s lifecycle to develop, maintain, verify and communicate the technical baseline for a program or part of a program that includes Segment, Element. and/or Subsystems level ownership. You’ll coordinate with Customers, the Program Management Office, the Chief Systems Engineer, the Chief Engineer and other engineering disciplines, suppliers, and partners as applicable to lead the architectural development, technical integration, and verification of space systems and their associated ground and launch systems as necessary.
  
  
The Engineering, Science and Analysis (ESA) Strategic Capabilities Unit comprises the technical talent and organizational leadership that enables the successful delivery of high-impact discriminating technologies for our customers’ missions. Our collaborative, cross-functional teams are committed to innovation, integrity, continual learning and strong execution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**

* The Lead Systems Engineer is the authority for the technical requirements baseline of a program and will supervise and lead a team of Systems Engineers to define mission objectives, identify stakeholders, and establish system architecture during the development, design, integration, and V&V of a mission.
* Work with Engineering Management and the PMO to manage the staffing assignments for a team of Systems Engineers.
* Work closely together with the PMO and CSE to balance technical performance with programmatic constraints.
* Provide systems engineering leadership of technical teams in the development, verification, delivery, and operations of Segments, Elements, and Subsystems of space-based missions.
* Support the proper allocation, traceability, and verification of requirements at all levels through the lifecycle of the program.
* Interact with our teams of subject matter experts to develop the required allocation analysis and verification artifacts.
* Interface with and support the program’s stakeholders including the Customer, PMO, suppliers, and internal SBUs.
* Coordinate and own trade studies and their impact to the technical baseline while working cross-functional teams.
* Own the activities and products, including setting expectations, preparations, and delivery, for major gate reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, PSR) and other technical interchanges throughout the program lifecycle.
* Own and delegate requirements and interface verification with I&T activities according to company processes to ensure a successful V&V campaign.
* Use Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) for architecture to requirements traceability and interface development in coordination with Customers
* Own the System-level technical budgets.
* Mentor other system engineers assigned to the team.
* Support the program Risk & Opportunity Management and ERB processes.
* Prepare and give presentations to peers, management, and customers.
* Maintain a regular and predictable work schedule.
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships within the department, the Strategic Business Units, Strategic Capabilities Units and the Company. Interact appropriately with others in order to maintain a positive and productive work environment.
* Perform other duties as necessary.

**On-Site Work Environment:** This position requires regular in-person engagement by working **on-site five days** each normally scheduled week in the primary work location. Travel and local commute between company campuses and other possible non-company locations may be required.
  
  
**Working Conditions:**

* Work is performed in an office, laboratory, production floor, or cleanroom, outdoors or remote research environment.
* May occasionally work in production work centers where use of protective equipment and gear is required.
* May access other facilities in various weather conditions.
  

  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* BS degree or higher in Engineering or a related technical field is required plus 6 or more years related experience.
* Each higher-level degree, i.e., Master’s Degree or Ph.D., may substitute for two years of experience. Related technical experience may be considered in lieu of education. Degree must be from a university, college, or school which is accredited by an agency recognized by the US Secretary of Education, US Department of Education.
* A current, active TS/SCI security clearance is required with ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI Polygraph.
* Experience using requirements database tools (DOORS, Jama, Cameo Requirements Modeler, e.g.)
* Experience with Cameo Enterprise Architecture, SysML and DoDAF/UAF/UPDM.
* Demonstrated ability to manage effective and verifiable requirements – detail oriented.
* Demonstrated experience in systems engineering processes, including requirements development, requirement allocation, change management, verification and validation – a self-starter that will own this activity.
* Demonstrated experience leading multi-disciplinary teams including meeting schedule and performance goals.
* Customer Relationships: extensive knowledge of missions and customers across core technologies areas. Knowledge/experience working with critical customer base, established relationships with key personnel within customer community.
* Good presentation skills with experience to senior decision making and technical audiences.

* Demonstrated experience as a Chief or Lead Systems Engineer on

* Analyze real-world data pertaining to Missile Defense and Space Domain Awareness.
* Develop and complete features and user stories mapped to program objectives as part of an Agile Scrum team.
* Collect and interpret real-world data.
* Develop new algorithms to effectively utilize data.
* Update and enhance existing algorithms based on new data.

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

Strong analysis background with the ability to filter data and predict future states of ballistic missile threats.

Experience in performance analysis and characterization of large-scale complex system simulations focused on:

* Weapon systems
* Command and control architectures

Knowledge of systems engineering principles and practices, including:

* System design
* Development
* Testing
* Evaluation

Working or theoretical knowledge of ballistic or non-ballistic missile defense concepts, including:

* Battle Management and Command and Control (BM/C2) systems
* Defense communication systems
* Missile Defense System (MDS)

Strong foundation in mathematics and physics.

Experience using MATLAB to support analysis of complex data.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* The candidate should possess data analytics skills, with the ability to collect, analyze, and filter large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform predictions of future ballistic missile threat states.

We’re looking for an electrical engineer who can use their skills to design new and innovative electronic warfare products and systems.

  

We’ll look to you to share your electrical engineering expertise through leadership and mentoring junior staff. This is a chance to use your experience -based knowledge in digital signal processing and PNT. Join us and take on exciting challenges to further the mission of our military clients.

  

Join us. The world can’t wait.

* Experience integrating and prototyping electronic devices
* Experience with sof tware development in a Linux-based development environment, including programming in Python and C, and GitHub repository management
* Ability to identify and develop innovative solutions to challenging technical problems in the absence of specific requirements

Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

**The work:**

Automation Engineer will be responsible for developing and automating CICD pipelines using GitLab CICD, Urban Code Deploy, and other tools for a large scale national security system. Founded in 1989, Foxtronics is a full-service electronic manufacturing services (‘EMS”) platform serving middle-market OEM’s across a variety of industries, including ag-tech, medical devices, industrial and aerospace sectors.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Electrical Engineer to support our electronics manufacturing and engineering teams at three locations: Milford, CT; Windsor CT; and Jacksonville, IL.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of electrical and electronic principles, hands-on lab experience, and the ability to analyze and resolve technical issues in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Responsibilities:**

* Perform testing, troubleshooting, and validation of electronic assemblies and PCBs to ensure functionality and reliability.

* Operate and interpret results from oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, waveform generators, spectrum analyzers, and high-voltage power supplies.
* Create and refine Bills of Materials (BOMs) by cross-referencing general components (resistors, capacitors, ICs, diodes, etc.) to in-house part numbers, ordering prototypes, and applying appropriate scrap factors.
* Maintain accurate, repeatable test data and assist in root cause analysis for production or field issues.
* Install and troubleshoot engineering software, firmware tools, and driver issues as needed for testing or production support.
* Perform data collection, feasibility analysis, and assist in process or product improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering, production, and quality teams to support builds, testing, and continuous improvement.
* Use Outlook, Word, Excel, SolidWorks, CAB, and online databases to locate technical documentation, data sheets, and component specifications.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

* Legally authorized to work in the U.S. in compliance with ITAR regulations.
* 8+ years of experience in electronics testing, troubleshooting, or manufacturing support.
* Solid understanding of microcontroller architectures, embedded systems, and communication protocols.
* Skilled in use of test and measurement equipment for signal tracing and circuit validation.
* Hands-on experience with SMT soldering, rework, and prototype assembly.
* Strong mechanical aptitude and fine motor skills for working with small components and lab tools.
* Excellent documentation, organization, and communication skills.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

The Motorola Solutions Advanced Development Engineering team, located in Plantation, FL., specializes in the design and development of world class Mission Critical Communications equipment. This team develops RF modems, integrated circuits, and other related circuit modules and subsystems for use in our radio products. We need an innovative and motivated radio device system engineer. As a member of our team you will have opportunities to work on a variety of circuits and system designs. This position requires 100% on site presence Monday thru Friday at our engineering facility located in Plantation FL.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The **Radio Device System Engineer** will work with commercial off-the-shelf ICs as well as custom CMOS technologies to develop RF transceiver systems to be utilized in hi-reliability public safety communications equipment. This position will be one of a team of advanced technologists that will conceive, design and implement radio systems with off-the-shelf semiconductor devices as well as custom mixed signal digital, RF and analog circuits and subsystems using robust design methodologies for deployment in two way radio equipment. The completed RF transceiver systems are intended for use in Motorola Solutions radio products.

  

The following are activities related to this job and require prior experience:

* **System Architecture & Definition:** Translate product-level radio requirements into comprehensive architectural specifications for mixed-signal SoCs including antenna tuners, PLLs, fractional multi-loop synthesizers, ADCs and DACs, baseband and RF amplifiers/filters, AGC sub systems, digital state machines, embedded microprocessors, memories, memory interfaces. Must be able to communicate and work with radio product development hardware and software architects to achieve product level requirements.
* **System Level Modeling:** Develop behavioral system models to accurately determine and manage block level specs for a radio modem lineup including hardware, firmware and software components. Arbitrate block level spec adjustments throughout the design process to accomplish the overall system performance goals on finished silicon and complete radio product implementation.
* **IP Evaluation & Integration`:** Collaborate with internal and external IP providers to integrate high-speed analog peripherals, data converters (ADC/DAC).
* **Power & Performance Optimization:** Develop power-modeling and thermal management strategies across multiple operating modes and low-power states
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with digital design, analog layout, firmware/software, verification, and test engineering teams from specification to silicon tape-out, bring-up and ultimately deployment into radio products. Work with external contractor SMEs to define and implement specialized subsystems in our custom IC designs.
* **Documentation:** Work with team members to document transceiver and sub-systems requirements, theory of operation, step-by-step functional operation instructions, troubleshooting, engineering & manufacturing test procedures and related procedures.

  

**Qualifications**

  

* Solid experience in analog/mixed-signal circuit block and feedback control system modeling like PLL and AGC subsystems, design and verification using Cadence or equivalent CAD tools.
* Knowledge of multi-loop feedback control systems and modeling such systems.
* Experience in assessing 3rd party IP and COTS ICs for modem development.
* Experience with embedded processors.
* Experience with digital signal processing as applied to modulation and demodulation of signals in a faded radio channel environment.
* Experience implementing high-speed interfaces (hyperRAM MIPI, LPDDR, Ethernet) within a radio modem and mitigating interaction with RF signal processing.
* Knowledge of SoC power management architectures, clocking schemes, and voltage domains.
* Experience with Verilog-A/Verilog-AMS/System Verilog/Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) for digital and analog/mixed signal (AMS) designs. Familiar with shell and scripting languages
* Experience as a technical team leader and providing direction to other technical staff in the development of radio transceivers.

**Company Description**

Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 12 countries, and more than 170 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.

We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.

 **Job Description**

Avaloq’s R&D Lab is building a SaaS, API-first, composable banking platform. You will help develop its Rust backend, creating financial technology where precision, quality and scalability matter, while working closely with engineers in Fort Lauderdale and Zurich.

These 3 roles are among the first engineering roles at our new Fort Lauderdale development center, offering significant scope for ownership as the team grows. You will work directly with clients, see how your solutions are used and bring those insights back into the product. The role includes onboarding with the Zurich team, collaborative mornings and productive afternoons, with regular travel to Switzerland and occasional travel to client sites.

**Our stack**

Rust with Tokio and the AWS SDK for Rust. Serverless-first on AWS, using Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS and S3, with GitHub Actions for CI/CD. Clients integrate through our APIs and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We do not run containers.

**Useful domain experience**

Depending on the role, relevant experience may include wealth and asset management, discretionary portfolio management, investment performance and attribution, portfolio valuation and rebalancing, benchmarks and fees, or US investment taxation, including tax lots, cost basis, holding periods, wash sales, corporate actions, withholding and tax reporting.

What you'll do:

* Design, develop and test Rust backend services for complex financial products, with a focus on accuracy, scalability and reliability.
* Translate complex financial rules and mathematical concepts into precise, efficient and testable software, accounting for numerical precision and edge cases.
* Build scalable solutions using historized, non-relational data models and asynchronous, event-driven architectures.
* Contribute to technical specifications, design discussions and code reviews, using AI coding agents while maintaining rigorous review standards and accountability.
* Own features through the development lifecycle, from implementation and automated testing to deployment and monitoring, working alongside Platform and SRE engineers.
* Work directly with clients and domain specialists to analyse product questions, solve problems and bring insights back into product development.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Strong programming foundations in a statically typed language such as Rust, C++, Java, Scala, Kotlin, C#, Go or TypeScript.
* Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, mathematics, physics or a related quantitative field.
* Strong modelling skills, including experience or understanding of historized data, effective dating, immutability and audit trails.
* Strong analytical ability and intellectual curiosity, with the ability to quickly learn new technologies and complex financial domains.
* Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts effectively to both technical and business audiences.
* Ability to work independently within a distributed team and travel to Switzerland and client sites when required.

It would be a real bonus if you have:

* Production Rust experience, or experience with another systems/strongly typed language such as C++, Haskell, OCaml or Scala.
* Experience in wealth or asset management technology, including investment performance, portfolio construction/rebalancing, or tax, accounting and other rule-heavy financial software.
* Experience with AWS serverless and event-driven architecture, particularly Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, S3 and API Gateway, or related distributed-systems technologies.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering, client-facing product development, research or open-source software.

  
**Additional Information**

This role includes onboarding with the existing team in Zurich, regular travel to Switzerland and occasional travel to client sites.

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.

In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.

We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

### **Overview**

The Georgia Tech Research Institute (GTRI) is the nonprofit, applied research division of the Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech). Founded in 1934 as the Engineering Experiment Station, GTRI has grown to more than 2,900 employees, supporting eight laboratories in over 20 locations around the country and performing more than $940 million of problem-solving research annually for government and industry. GTRI's renowned researchers combine science, engineering, economics, policy, and technical expertise to solve complex problems for the U.S. federal government, state, and industry.

### **Georgia Tech's Mission and Values**

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:

1. Students are our top priority.
  
2. We strive for excellence.
  
3. We thrive on diversity.
  
4. We celebrate collaboration.
  
5. We champion innovation.
  
6. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.
  
7. We nurture the wellbeing of our community.
  
8. We act ethically.
  
9. We are responsible stewards.

Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact.

### **Project/Unit Description**

The Applied Embedded Systems (AES) division of the Electronic Systems Laboratory (ELSYS) supports multiple research products and projects in concert with development teams who are building complex, multi-faceted embedded and electronic systems. AES predominantly focuses on the research, development, testing, and deployment of embedded electronic and electromechanical systems. These systems provide our sponsors with technological solutions in the fields of Electronic Warfare (EW), Radar, command and control, communications, avionics, entertainment, physiological monitoring, and other applications. This research position will support electronic hardware development needs of the Open Systems Development Branch (OSDB). This includes developing hardware from existing open standards such as OpenVPX as well as developing hardware that is driving new open standards.

### **Job Purpose**

The Embedded Software/Firmware Engineer is responsible for developing algorithms and code for real-time signal processing to include communication and data transfer between system level hardware and embedded hardware. The Embedded Software/Firmware Engineer develops designs based on embedded firmware systems, such as Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA), Digital Signal Processors (DSPs), microcontrollers/computers, Application-Specific Integrated Circuits/systems (ASICs), and or Graphics Processor Units (GPUs). These designs also require development of documentation to support future reviews of design and enhancements. This position requires extensive knowledge of development environments for Xilinx and Altera (Intel) technologies, software development and configuration skills, and computer operating systems. The Embedded Software/Firmware Engineer applies engineering principles to firmware software creation and implementation of real-time hardware interface firmware and analysis, debugging, and testing of these systems.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, test, and develop software packages to meet requirements and open system standards
* Develop and maintain software and scripts to support software development and processes
* Follow embedded software/firmware development processes
* Contribute to research reports, white papers, and competitive proposals

### **Additional Responsibilities**

* Firmware programming and coding, real-time hardware interface coding, and design of architecture / algorithms
* Firmware analysis for reliability and debugging and testing of firmware to meet requirements

jobs.title: Flight Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Astria is a custom heavy-lift drone that combines lift motors with a cyclorotor for lateral force. It runs our own Simulink-built controllers on PX4-based flight hardware. It flies real installs on utility lines today. You'll contribute to controller changes from idea to flight. That means modeling the vehicle, designing and tuning the controller, testing it on the stand, flying it with our pilots, and reading the logs to find out what actually happened. It's a small team, so you'll be in the shop and in the field, not just at a desk. We're an AI-driven company. AI tooling runs throughout our engineering workflow, including MATLAB and Simulink work, log analysis, and simulation.

### **About Pitch Aeronautics Inc.**

Pitch Aeronautics (www.pitchaero.com) is a rapidly growing startup creating game-changing solutions for the utility industry. Pitch has developed a drone to install our line sensor, bird diverters, and other equipment on power lines. Our drone-deployable line sensors wirelessly transmit environmental and line characteristics to an online secure API to help utilities push more power through existing lines, prevent wildfires, and improve grid reliability.

At Pitch we’ve fostered a collaborative, fun, “get-stuff-done” working environment. We believe in moving fast and creating products and prototypes rapidly. If you’re looking for a place where you can make a difference on day one, be empowered to achieve, and love working in small teams, we want to meet you!

### **Description**

**Responsibilities**

* Design, model, and tune flight controllers (attitude, position, altitude, yaw, trim) in MATLAB/Simulink and deploy them to PX4-based flight hardware.
* Build and maintain vehicle dynamics models, including the cyclorotor, and extend our simulation capability (e.g., Gazebo, SITL).
* Write test plans and run test-stand and flight tests with the drone ops crew.
* Analyze flight logs (PX4 ULog) for tracking error, motor saturation, and vibration, and build tools that make that analysis faster.
* Make the controller robust to estimator events such as EKF resets, IMU switches, and GPS dropouts.
* Characterize propulsion (thrust vs. RPM, motor and prop selection) and fold the results back into the control code.
* Develop control for aerial manipulation: precise lateral positioning, wind rejection, and contact with the conductor during sensor install and removal.
* Configure and integrate motor controllers over DroneCAN.
* Document controller design decisions and changes, manage control code in Git, and post clear updates for the team.
* Mentor technicians and interns, and work with pilots on how the aircraft feels to fly.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with a focus on controls.
* 3+ years designing and testing control systems for UAVs, aircraft, or robots, or a graduate degree with significant hands-on flight-test work.
* Strong MATLAB/Simulink skills, including code generation for embedded targets.
* Solid grounding in classical control: PID/PD design, feedforward, saturation and anti-windup, rate and jerk limiting, and frequency-domain analysis.
* Hands-on flight or hardware testing experience, including reading logs to diagnose problems.
* Python for data analysis and tooling; Git.
* Clear technical writing.
* Able to work on-site in Boise and travel occasionally for field tests and installs.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot internals (uORB, EKF2) and Pixhawk/Cube hardware.
* Multirotor or unconventional rotorcraft dynamics; cyclorotor experience is a big plus.
* Aerial manipulation or contact control.
* State estimation and sensor fusion.
* Simulation with Gazebo, SITL, or HITL.
* CAN/DroneCAN and motor controller integration.
* FAA Part 107 certificate or piloting experience.
* Master's or PhD in controls, robotics, or aerospace.
* Fluency with AI assistants in engineering work, and enough depth to catch them when they're wrong.

**Benefits**

* 120 hrs of paid time off
* Health Insurance
* Dental & Vision Insurance
* Short-term disability insurance
* Long-term disability insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Paid holidays
* Flexible work schedule

In accordance with applicable federal regulations and requirements Pitch Aeronautics does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, disability, or age.

jobs.title: Structural and Dynamic Systems Engineer - Analytical
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

This entry level/early career professional, applied science position conducts numerical computations via third party and in-house tools to determine structural performance of components and systems. The results from the computer models are used to determine the validity of the design to meet the customer requirements. Design recommendations are then provided as needed.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Investigates product and system problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members Main focus is on the execution and improvement of established processes primarily documented in detailed local and global work instructions (EPs) that are required in Engineering Standard Work (ESW) and/or Design Validation Plans (DVP&R). This is accomplished through standard, as well as development of specialized computational tools and methods that are required to support the Design and Validation processes and enable high confidence decision making. Obtains input from Design, Thermal Sciences, Materials and Product Validation and delivers computer models and results for key structural performance parameters like motion, load, natural frequencies, stress, design margin, life, sound power to Design and Product Validation. Uses formal training like Statics, Dynamics, Machine Design, Mechanics of Materials, Failure Analysis, Engineering Materials and others along with tool specific training (ANSYS, FE-Safe, GT, AVL) to make Design decisions based on numerical predictions of structural performance of components and systems. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.

**Competencies:**

Applies Principles of Dynamics and Vibration - Determines motion of components and systems via numerical modeling and/or physical measurements; evaluates rigid and flexible body motion, natural frequencies, mode shapes, displacements, velocities, accelerations, friction, and wear to draw conclusions that influence design decisions with internal and external customers.

Applies Principles of Fatigue and Durability - Determines life of components and systems via numerical modeling and/or physical measurements; evaluates component temperatures, natural frequencies, mode shapes, displacements, strains/stresses, wear, and fatigue life to draw conclusions that influence design decisions with internal and external customers.

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Systems Modeling and Simulation - Identifies representation of a system or system element by using suitable analytical tools and techniques in order to derive knowledge about the real system; defines the strategy for modeling, simulation, and analysis of a system or system element by considering specifics of a given situation or nature of the system of interest in order to derive insights for making quality decisions.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

City: West Lafayette

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Senior Research Software Engineer will support the Midwestern Regional Climate Center (MRCC) and the Indiana State Climate Office (IN-SCO) as a member of their research teams. This position will help researchers use large-scale research computing systems and provide the computational tools and expertise needed to answer their research questions through the testing, development, and implementation of software applications, tools, and components. jobs.description:

**Security Clearance:** Active Secret or higher [Required]  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Target Salary Range\*:**$100,000 - $140,000

* *This represents the potential salary range for this position depending on education level, years of experience and/or certifications in addition to other position specific requirements which may impact salary*

**Position Overview**
=====================

For this R&M Engineering Analyst position, you will be responsible for lifecycle reliability and maintainability (R&M) planning, influencing design for reliability and design for maintainability, modeling and predicting R&M performance, optimizing supportability resources to achieve readiness at cost targets, operational performance assessment and improvement, and facilitation of a cross functional readiness review process as a framework to achieve reliability, maintainability, and availability goals.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Possess a strong understanding of reliability engineering and statistical analysis, as well as a knowledge of maintenance management processes.
* Develop and implement reliability plans that support increasing the readiness of Department of the War (DoW) sensor, electromagnetic warfare, and communications systems.
* Design and develop methods to improve and maintain the reliability of systems and processes.
* Provide guidance for design for reliability and design for maintainability activities with full application of reliability-centered maintenance tools.
* Build, review, and revise supportability analysis including but not limited to reliability block diagrams, fault tree analysis, failure modes effects and criticality analysis, reliability centered maintenance, level of repair analysis, maintenance task analysis, and enterprise asset and resource optimization.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to identify potential Reliability, Maintainability, and Availability (RMA) performance issues and develop and implement effective solutions that ensure equipment reliability, maintainability, and availability.
* Conduct risk and failure mode analysis to support project teams.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation related to system reliability.
* Drive root cause analysis of issues identified at the system, subsystem, and component failure levels.
* Develop, implement, and monitor key performance indicators to track performance and implement corrective action where necessary.
* Edit and format information for consumption through various media channels to include printed materials, scripted voice content, email, websites, and other electronic access points.
* Travel as needed to support test events. The contractor shall operate test units, monitoring devices, and associated equipment.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in a position requiring STEM expertise
* Eligibility for a SECRET clearance.
* Excellent technical writing and data presentation skills
* Track record of complex problem-solving aptitude
* Ability to think analytically and independently

* Ability to communicate clearly both orally and in written form
* Willingness to learn new skills
* Ability to work on multiple projects concurrently

============================

* Accredited Master Degree in STEM discipline
* Experience in DoD customer relations and technical writing
* Active minimum Secret clearance

jobs.title: Automation Engineer I
jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.  

**JOB SUMMARY**  
The Automation Engineer I is responsible for supporting the design, development, integration, testing, installation, and maintenance of automation systems and manufacturing equipment used in industrial and manufacturing environments. This role works across multiple disciplines including controls engineering, robotics, motion control, machine vision, and system integration to deliver reliable and efficient automation solutions.

The position focuses on developing and supporting control systems, PLC/HMI programming, motion control applications, robotic integration, machine vision systems, and automation concept development. The Automation Engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize manufacturing processes, improve equipment performance, and support continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring compliance with safety and industry standards.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, develop, test, and support automation systems and machinery used in manufacturing environments.
* Develop and modify PLC, HMI, and motion control programs for automation equipment and manufacturing systems.
* Support integration of industrial robots, vision systems, servo systems, and peripheral automation equipment.
* Create and maintain electrical schematics, control system documentation, and automation design specifications.
* Assist in concept development and feasibility studies for new automation equipment and process improvements.
* Integrate and troubleshoot machine vision systems including Keyence, Cognex, and other industrial vision platforms.
* Support robotic integration, programming, and troubleshooting for systems such as FANUC and Universal Robots.
* Configure and troubleshoot industrial communication networks including Ethernet/IP, EtherCAT, PROFINET, and related industrial protocols.
* Support implementation of motion control systems including servo drives, VFDs, and motor control systems.
* Participate in equipment commissioning, startup, validation, and production support activities.
* Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, software, manufacturing, and maintenance teams to ensure successful system integration.
* Support safety system integration including Safety PLCs and machine safety devices in compliance with applicable standards and regulations.
* Analyze manufacturing and equipment issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on cycle time reduction, equipment reliability, and process optimization.
* Work with suppliers, contractors, and internal teams to ensure equipment and systems meet technical and customer requirements.
* Assist with project planning, technical documentation, cost estimation, and project execution activities.
* Provide technical support to manufacturing, maintenance, and operations teams as needed.
* Maintain accurate engineering documentation including electrical drawings, PLC backups, network configurations, and operating procedures.
May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.  

**JOB QUALIFICATIONS**

* Knowledge of industrial automation systems, controls engineering, and manufacturing processes.
* Experience with PLC programming, HMI development, and industrial control systems.
* Understanding of motion control systems including servo motors, servo drives, and variable frequency drives (VFDs).
* Knowledge of industrial robotics integration and programming concepts.
* Familiarity with industrial machine vision systems and inspection technologies.
* Understanding of industrial communication protocols and networks such as Ethernet/IP, EtherCAT, PROFINET, and Modbus.
* Knowledge of electrical controls design, ladder logic programming, and troubleshooting techniques.
* Familiarity with machine safety systems and safety control integration.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work in cross-functional team environments and support multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong communication and technical documentation skills.

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Robotics Engineering, or related field.
* 1–2 years of experience in automation engineering, controls engineering, or manufacturing automation environments.
* Basic experience or exposure to PLC programming, HMI development, robotics, or industrial automation systems preferred.

Hiring a senior Systems Engineer to guide the architecture, requirements, integration, and technical development of battery systems and associated electronic hardware/software. The person will manage system-level interfaces among energy-management and battery-management technologies, controls, sensors, software, and electronic hardware. This is a true systems engineering position—not primarily PCB layout or circuit design.

* Experience with controls, sensors, software interfaces, and cross-functional engineering teams.

Our mission-first software and data engineering platform modernizes data operations, utilizing advanced workflows, CI/CD, and secure DevSecOps practices. We focus on challenges in Information Warfare, Cyber Operations, Operational Security, and Data Structuring, enabling end-to-end solutions that drive operational impact.

We are committed to delivering cutting-edge tools and capabilities that address the most complex national security challenges, empowering our partners to stay ahead of emerging threats and ensuring the success of their critical missions. At Clarity, we are people-focused and set on being a destination employer for top talent, offering an environment where innovation thrives, careers grow, and individuals are valued. Join us as we continue to lead innovation and tackle the most pressing challenges in national security.

We are hiring a Senior Principal Platform Engineer to build and run the on-prem Kubernetes platform that teams across Clarity Innovations depend on. Half of this job is software: you will own our in-house cluster provisioning tool as a product. The other half is operations: you will keep the clusters, storage, networking and hardware underneath it healthy.

Rapid Capabilities is the product development org at Clarity Innovations, home of the Aurora Enterprise and Manifest product suites. We run lean, in Extreme Programming (XP) teams, so you will pair with engineers daily and ship in small, tested increments.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Own the provisioning tool as a software product**

* Develop and maintain our in-house automated cluster provisioning solution so every cluster is reproducible and consistent.
* Design new features, write tests, manage releases and versioning, and keep clear documentation for its users.
* Gather requirements from internal teams and turn them into a roadmap for the provisioning platform.
* Refactor and modernize the existing codebase over time, paying down technical debt while keeping clusters stable.
* Integrate the tool with CI/CD, observability, secrets management and access control.
* Build internal tools, services, APIs and CLIs in Go that automate deployment and operations.

**Run on-prem Kubernetes for the whole company**

* Deploy, maintain and upgrade on-prem Kubernetes clusters, including capacity planning, version upgrades and lifecycle management.
* Operate cluster-critical components: storage (Longhorn), networking (Calico or Cilium, MetalLB, ingress controllers) and internal registries (Harbor or similar).
* Build multi-tenancy so many teams can share clusters safely, using namespaces, RBAC, resource quotas, network policies and fair-share scheduling.
* Plan, run and regularly test backup, disaster recovery and etcd maintenance.

**Manage the infrastructure underneath**

* Manage bare-metal and virtualized infrastructure, working with data center and IT teams on hardware provisioning and replacement.
* Design and maintain infrastructure across on-prem data centers and AWS / Azure, using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi or similar) wherever possible.
* Implement observability for metrics, logging, tracing and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry or similar).

**Build security in**

* Embed security and compliance into the platform: secrets management, IAM, policy-as-code and supply chain security.
* Patch OS and cluster components on a regular cadence to meet security and compliance requirements.

jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

WHAT WE'RE DOING:  
Lockheed Martin, Cyber & Intelligence invites you to step up to one of today’s most daunting challenges: the evolving threat of cyber warfare. As a cyber security professional at Lockheed Martin, you’ll protect the networks that our citizens and the world depend upon each minute. Here, you’ll work with cybersecurity experts on the forefront of threat protection and proactive prevention. In this fast-paced, real-world environment, you’ll draw on all your education and experience as well as the resources of Lockheed Martin to keep the threats at bay.

Cyber | Lockheed Martin

THE WORK:  
The GG RF Cyber Software Engineer is a critical role responsible for designing, installing, and testing RF systems, with a focus on SATCOM components and devices operating in various frequency bands, including but not limited to S-band, C-band, X-band, Ku-band, and Ka-band. The successful candidate will be working on complex RF system design, installation, and test, and will be required to travel up to 15% worldwide. The RF Cyber Software Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of our RF systems, from design to deployment, and will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure systems meet user requirements.

RF Design and Installation:  

* Design, install, and test RF systems, including SATCOM components and devices, utilizing knowledge of RF principles and system design
* Conduct site surveys, climb antennas, and rack hardware as required, ensuring compliance with safety protocols and regulations

RF Test and Measurement:  

* Utilize RF test equipment such as Keyband PNA-X, Fieldfox, Spec-A, Sig-Gen, and O-Scopes to test and measure RF system performance, including spectral analysis, modulation analysis, and bit error rate (BER) testing
* Measure and analyze S-parameters, P1dB, TOI, NF, Phase Noise, and Group Delay, with consideration for the impact of non-linear effects, such as intermodulation distortion and spectral growth
* Familiarity with signal processing techniques, including filtering, amplification, and frequency conversion, as applied to SATCOM signal chains

System Design and Documentation:  

* Create system drawings and documentation using AutoCAD or Visio, including block diagrams, schematics, and layout drawings
* Understand and apply link budget analysis, antenna patterns, and G/T measurements, with consideration for the effects of noise, interference, and multipath on system performance

Collaboration:  

* Work closely with cross-functional teams, including system architects, and project managers, to ensure systems meet user requirements and are delivered on schedule

WHO WE ARE:  
The program performs the analysis, design, development, integration, test and deployment, securing, modernization, and operations and maintenance (O&M) and decommissioning activities of RF and optical capabilities.

WHY JOIN US:  
Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life  
Our flexible schedules, competitive pay and comprehensive benefits enable you to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work. We support our employees, so they can support our mission.  
  
#RMSGG2026 #RMSROC

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (or similar degree) from an accredited college, or equivalent experience/combined education.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today's five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Principal Systems Engineer to join our growing team in Lanham, MD. This is a senior technical leadership role with system-level authority across multiple programs: owning system architecture, setting technical direction, resolving the most complex cross-cutting issues, and developing the next generation of systems engineering leads.

The ideal candidate brings a record of leading systems engineering on complex space or comparable programs from concept through launch and operations, is trusted by executives, customers, and engineers alike, and thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment where no two days look the same.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the technical authority for systems engineering across multiple programs, owning system architecture and technical direction from concept through verification, validation, launch, and on-orbit operations.
* Define and own system architectures and mission concepts, leading trade studies and making and defending key technical decisions in response to customer and internal needs.
* Establish top-level system requirements and govern their allocation, flow-down, and interface control across subsystems, suppliers, and organizations.
* Own technical budgets and margin philosophy (mass, power, link, thermal, schedule) at the program and constellation level, and ensure rigorous tracking across subsystems.
* Drive system-level integration across engineering disciplines (RF, software, mechanical, electrical, GNC, operations) and lead resolution of the most complex cross-cutting technical issues and anomalies.
* Provide technical leadership for proposal and business development efforts, including solution architecture, basis-of-estimate development, and cost/schedule inputs, and represent AST in technical engagements with customers and government partners.
* Serve as senior technical lead for major design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) and technical interchange meetings (TIMs), presenting to executive leadership, customers, and independent review boards.
* Lead technical risk management: identify and quantify top program and technical risks, drive mitigation, and advise leadership on risk-informed decisions.
* Define and evolve systems engineering processes, standards, practices, and drive their adoption across the organization.
* Mentor and develop SE leads and engineers, serve as a technical coach across the department, and contribute to hiring and talent growth.
  

**Qualifications**

**Education:**

Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field required; Master's degree or PhD strongly preferred

**Experience:**

A minimum of 12 years of systems engineering experience, with at least 5 years serving as SE Lead, Chief Engineer, or equivalent on a program of record or flight program, including end-to-end lifecycle experience on at least one program through launch and on-orbit operations

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in a relevant engineering discipline.
* Experience in space, satellite, or defense programs, ideally satellite communications, phased array, or RF payload systems.
* Experience establishing or leading SE practices and configuration control processes at the program or organizational level.

**Soft Skills:**

* Proven ability to lead and influence without direct authority across cross-functional teams and at the executive level.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to brief and build trust with executive, customer, and government audiences.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity: able to define the path forward and make sound decisions when requirements are incomplete or roles are fluid.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with the judgment to balance technical rigor against schedule and cost.
* Ability to manage multiple competing priorities across programs in a dynamic, fast-moving environment.
* Demonstrated mentor who builds technical talent and raises the bar for the team.
* Self-starter who takes ownership and drives issues to closure without close supervision.

**Technology Stack:**

* Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for documentation, analysis, and reporting.
* Requirements management tools: DOORS, Jama, or equivalent, with experience defining requirements management practices.
* MATLAB / Simulink for analysis and trade studies (preferred).
* Confluence and Jira for program tracking and collaboration.
* STK (Systems Tool Kit) for mission analysis (preferred).

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to work in a standard office environment and use a computer for extended periods.
* Occasional travel to other AST SpaceMobile facilities or customer/government sites (up to 20%).

*This job description may not be inclusive to the duties and responsibilities listed. Additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time or the scope of the job may change as needed by business demands**.*

You will contribute to the planning, implementation, oversight, and collaborative co-management of significant infrastructure initiatives, with a focus on minimizing disruption, improving reliability, maintaining secure and supportable configurations, and ensuring each environment remains stable, resilient, and aligned with client needs as they evolve. * Strong customer service skills, with both in-person and remote situations
* Demonstrable project/process management background and experience in a technical environment.

* Direct the work of contract engineers alongside full-time staff, holding both to the same design and code quality bar.
* Lead the team's delivery of the member's on-device experience firmware, from prototype through production release.

* Set engineering practices for testing, hardware-in-the-loop validation, release readiness, and field diagnostics.
* Foster a culture of high standards, direct feedback, accountability, psychological safety, and continuous learning.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years of embedded firmware development in C or C++, including experience as an engineering manager or team lead responsible for mentorship, feedback, and career development.
