jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the Team**

STR's Intelligence Division researches, develops, and transitions advanced analytics and machine-learning solutions for challenging national-security problems. Our team includes engineers and researchers with advanced backgrounds in engineering, computer science, mathematics, and data science who apply deep technical expertise and creativity to mission-critical challenges.

Our work spans data analysis, deep learning, and statistical methods across networking, communications, social media, text, time series, geospatial, and imagery data. We develop capabilities under constraints not typically encountered in commercial environments. U.S. Government analysts use our tools and technologies to extract, enrich, and act on intelligence information worldwide.

**The Role**

As a Lead Software Engineer, you will lead the technical execution of mission-relevant software systems that operationalize advanced analytics, machine learning, and data-processing capabilities. You will apply software and systems engineering expertise to develop scalable, secure, maintainable applications that operate in complex customer environments.

You will work with software engineers, systems engineers, researchers, and mission partners to translate customer needs into executable technical plans. You will own technical delivery for an assigned project or major subsystem, guiding architecture, implementation, integration, testing, demonstration, and transition.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Lead project execution:** Lead software development from requirements definition through implementation, integration, test, demonstration, deployment, and sustainment
* **Translate mission needs into plans:** Convert customer objectives into requirements, architectures, development plans, milestones, performance measures, and acceptance criteria
* **Lead the technical team:** Lead and mentor software engineers and collaborate with systems engineers, researchers, DevSecOps personnel, and mission partners
* **Manage technical work:** Decompose complex work into actionable tasks; manage dependencies, technical risks, interfaces, and progress toward program objectives
* **Own project architecture:** Design and oversee architectures spanning services, APIs, data pipelines, databases, ML integrations, user interfaces, and deployment infrastructure
* **Drive integration and quality:** Lead design reviews, code reviews, integration activities, testing, customer demonstrations, and release readiness; ensure reliability, security, maintainability, and performance
* **Support growth and transition:** Contribute technical content to proposals, customer engagements, and transition planning while ensuring delivered capabilities are reusable and mission relevant

**Who You Are:**

* **Education and experience:** PhD with 2+ years, MS with 6+ years, or BS with 8+ years of relevant experience in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, or a related technical discipline
* **Clearance eligibility:** Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance, for which U.S citizenship is needed by the U.S government
* **Technical delivery leadership:** Experience leading software development efforts or major workstreams involving applications, services, distributed systems, data platforms, or related domains
* **Systems engineering:** Experience translating customer needs into software requirements, designs, development plans, test plans, and integrated capabilities
* **Software development****:** Proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Python, C++, Java, Go, or similar languages, with experience developing and maintaining production-quality software
* **Engineering practices:** Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, issue tracking, documentation, and secure software-development practices
* **Communication and collaboration:** Ability to lead technical discussions, communicate risks and tradeoffs, and work effectively with customers and multidisciplinary teams

**Even Better**

* **Clearance:** Active Secret, Top Secret, or TS/SCI security clearance
* **Architecture experience:** Experience designing system or software architectures for distributed, data-intensive, real-time, cloud, on-premises, or edge systems
* **DevSecOps experience:** Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, container orchestration, cloud platforms, monitoring, logging, and security tooling
* **Large codebase experience:** Experience developing software in large, multi-team code bases using collaborative engineering practices
* **Decentralized systems:** Familiarity with message queues, stream processing, distributed computing, or microservices
* **Customer and capture support:** Experience supporting technical proposals, customer demonstrations, technical briefings, or capture activities with DoW or IC customers
* **Modern development tools:** Experience using LLM-enabled development tools, such as Cursor or Codex, in a secure and effective engineering workflow

**Pay Information**  
Full-Time Salary Range: $180,000 - $230,000  
*The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate's experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.*

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

Draper is an independent, nonprofit research and development company headquartered in Cambridge, MA. jobs.title: Senior Computer Vision Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

We have a new opportunity for a Senior Software Development Engineer to join our Engineering team. In this role you will be working within a collaborative team on the development of next generation non-contacting measurement technologies and processes for video extensometer products. You will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced algorithms and systems and will have deep expertise across optical and imaging system design, and high‑performance, real‑time software implementation. The successful candidate will serve as both a technical authority and hands‑on contributor, working across algorithm development, computational performance optimization, and integration with imaging hardware. This role plays a critical part in delivering robust, production‑grade solutions used in demanding real‑time and high‑accuracy measurement applications.

*Key Responsibilities*

  

* Collaborate on the design and selection of optical systems, including lenses, cameras, illumination, and stereo configurations.
* Design, implement, and maintain image analysis techniques and algorithms
* Develop and refine correlation metrics, interpolation schemes and strain calculation methods.
* Contribute to camera calibration, stereo reconstruction, and geometric correction
* Understand and optimize performance tradeoffs across resolution, frame rate, depth of field, and signal‑to‑noise ratio.
* Work closely with hardware teams to ensure seamless integration between imaging systems and DIC software.
* Optimize software for real‑time or near real‑time execution, including low‑latency processing pipelines.
* Apply performance optimization techniques such as multi‑threading, SIMD/vectorization, GPU acceleration (e.g., CUDA/OpenCL), and memory‑efficient architectures.
* Profile and benchmark code to identify and eliminate computational bottlenecks.
* Balance accuracy, robustness, and execution speed for production deployment

*Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:*

**Job Description**

**The Team:**

Embedded Platform System & Infrastructure (EPSI) is a production level group that supports the definition, design, and development of all embedded controllers related to vehicle mechatronics. The Low Voltage Infrastructure (LVI) organization within EPSI is focused on the development of controls & diagnostic software centered around on-vehicle low voltage power generation, energy storage, power management, and distribution.

  
  

**The Role:**

This **Senior Controls Software Engineer** role is paramount to the successful review, development, simplification, integration and release of VIP (Vehicle Interface Platform) and SDV2.0 architectures controller software. There is no better time to join this domain as we evolve to the next generation of low voltage power strategy, innovation, and capability for EVs, ICE and every product GM has to offer!

  

We are seeking creative, highly motivated, agile thinkers with passion and expertise in embedded controls. The selected candidate will learn, modify existing and develop new innovative controls strategies, which will be at the core of all vehicles within the General Motors portfolio and essential to keeping General Motors at the forefront of low voltage related technologies.

**What You'll Do (Responsibilities):**

* Lead development and implementation of controls development for complex low voltage related features in embedded C and C++. Proficiency in both is vital as this role will be centered around improvements, best practices institution, code efficiency, vulnerability surface mitigation and addressing feature to feature interference.
* Research and develop novel solutions to controls challenges.
* Contribute to ART Feature and user story elaboration into individual work items. Contribute to ensuring that definition of done and acceptance criteria are well defined
* Provide information as required to calibration procedures.
* Ensure compliance to safety and governmental regulations while following GM-internal best practices.

* Bachelors degree (or higher) in Engineering, Computer Science, or relevant discipline.
* 5+ years Engineering experience related to embedded controls, calibration, integration, or software development.
* Skilled with software development in C, C++, and/or Python.
* Understanding of embedded controls development and delivery processes, including SAFE/Agile.
* Experience using embedded controls test assets (SIL, HIL, Vehicle, etc) and tools (INCA, MDA, etc).
* Expert capability to capture and analyze data to verify system and feature performance.
Proficiency with control system theory and application to embedded systems including state space feedback control, adaptive control, and model predictive control (or equivalent).  

  
  

**People Skills:**

* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex projects and assignments with autonomy and accountability for results.
Consistent demonstration of innovative thinking that is customer-centric.  

  
  

**What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications):**

* In-depth knowledge of automotive low voltage systems and hardware components.
* Strong understanding of low voltage controls features, software, and calibration.

jobs.title: SR Industrial Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you looking to join a dynamic team that provides its people with the tools to be successfull and opportunities to grow?
  
Universal Logistics is a leading provider of customized transportation and logistics solutions, offering a comprehensive suite of services including transportation, value-added, intermodal, and specialized services utilized throughout entire supply chains.
  
Universal has immediate career opportunities in your area. Apply today to become part of the Universal team!

**Position Description**
------------------------

The Industrial Robotics Engineer will be based in Warren, MI and will develop, engineer, and launch industrial and collaborative robotic automation across Universal Logistics operations and customer facilities.

This role focuses on robotic applications including material handling, sequencing, kitting, palletizing, depalletizing, machine tending, packaging, and other automation solutions designed to improve safety, quality, productivity, ergonomics, and process consistency.

  

The Industrial Robotics Engineer will serve as a hands-on manufacturing and automation engineer and project owner. This position will work with robotic cells, end-of-arm tooling, machine vision, controls, safety systems, equipment suppliers, customers, and cross-functional teams to take projects from concept and process development through build, commissioning, production ramp-up, and final handoff to operations.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop industrial and collaborative robotic concepts and manufacturing processes.
* Conduct feasibility, cycle-time, capacity, layout, ergonomic, process-flow, and technical trade-off studies to determine the appropriate automation solution.
* Define technical requirements, RFQs, and Statements of Work (SOWs) for robotic cells, including: Robot selection End-of-arm tooling Fixtures Machine vision Sensors Guarding and safety devices Controls Conveyance Equipment interfaces
* Manage automation projects with system integrators and equipment suppliers from concept and design through build, FAT, installation, SAT, commissioning, and production ramp-up.
* Manage project timing, cost, scope, risks, and technical deliverables.
* Serve as the engineering interface between customers and cross-functional teams, including Operations, Controls, IT, Safety, Quality, Maintenance, and Facilities.
* Lead design reviews, process reviews, FMEA activities, risk assessments, and site-readiness planning.
* Support robot and cobot programming, PLC/HMI integration, machine vision, sensors, and end-of-arm tooling.
* Troubleshoot and debug equipment while validating safety, quality, cycle time, throughput, uptime, process capability, and production readiness.
* Develop acceptance criteria, operating standards, training, spare-parts requirements, preventive-maintenance requirements, and lessons learned.
Complete formal project handoffs to Operations and help standardize successful automation designs for future applications.  

  

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Mechatronics, Robotics Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical field.
* 2+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, automation engineering, robotics integration, controls, or equipment launch within a manufacturing, warehousing, or logistics environment.
* Working knowledge of industrial and/or collaborative robots, end-of-arm tooling, PLC/controls, machine vision, sensors, safety systems, and integrated robotic cells.
* Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, layouts, and technical specifications.
* Experience with cycle-time analysis, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and project coordination.
* Ability to manage suppliers, schedules, technical deliverables, and launch-related issues.
Willingness to travel and support non-standard hours during critical installation, commissioning, and production launch periods.  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong self-starter with a manufacturing engineering mindset and the ability to independently own projects, work directly with customers, coordinate cross-functional teams, and drive technical issues to resolution.
* Hands-on experience with industrial robot or cobot platforms such as FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots, or similar systems, including programming, simulation, or commissioning.
* Experience with Allen-Bradley/Rockwell PLCs and HMIs, safety PLCs, industrial networking, servo systems, and robotic equipment integration.
* Experience with machine vision, force/torque sensing, grippers, vacuum tooling, fixtures, quick-change tooling, and other end-of-arm tooling technologies.
* Understanding of industrial and collaborative robot safety requirements, machine guarding, risk assessments, lockout/tagout, and applicable ANSI/RIA and ISO standards.
* Experience with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, robot simulation, virtual commissioning, FAT/SAT, run-at-rate validation, Lean/Six Sigma, automotive manufacturing, or other high-volume production environments.

* 4 Year Bachelors BS degree and 4+ years equivalent experience

jobs.title: Experienced Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Build custom machines that turn demanding manufacturing requirements into working automation.
  
  
PAR Systems is seeking a Controls Engineer with a strong Beckhoff background to join our Advanced Manufacturing team. Our systems support challenging aerospace and defense applications, including precision cutting and trimming, robotic and configurable fixtures, drilling, and friction stir welding. In this role, you will develop controls and software for custom machines where coordinated motion, process control, and reliable operation are essential. You will bring hands-on TwinCAT experience to project delivery while helping expand our Beckhoff expertise, reusable software, and engineering practices.
  
  
We welcome candidates at the Advanced or Senior Engineer level. Placement will reflect your technical depth, independence, project ownership, and ability to guide others.
  
  
What you’ll do
  

* Translate customer and machine requirements into controls architectures, software designs, and test plans.
* Develop modular, maintainable machine-control software using Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 and IEC 61131-3 Structured Text.
* Configure and commission Beckhoff controllers, EtherCAT networks, I/O, servo drives, and connected devices.
* Implement and tune motion control, including axis sequencing, synchronization, and coordinated movement.
* Develop machine operating modes, process sequences, interlocks, alarms, diagnostics, and recovery behavior.
* Integrate operator interfaces, instrumentation, robots, and PC applications with the machine-control system.
* Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, software, and process engineers to resolve system interfaces and design challenges.
* Test software through simulation and staged integration, then support machine power-up, debugging, Factory Acceptance Testing, and customer-site commissioning.
* Troubleshoot issues across software, electrical hardware, motion systems, and manufacturing processes.
* Contribute reusable libraries, coding standards, documentation, and technical reviews. Share your Beckhoff knowledge and mentor other engineers.

What you bring
  

* A bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.
* Typically five or more years of controls or automation engineering experience, with demonstrated responsibility for delivering automated equipment.
* Substantial hands-on experience developing and commissioning Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 applications. Your experience includes implementing machine functionality and bringing it into operation.
* Strong Structured Text programming skills and experience organizing software into reusable function blocks and clear interfaces.
* Practical experience configuring and troubleshooting EtherCAT networks, I/O, and servo systems.
* Experience implementing motion control, commissioning axes, tuning drives, and diagnosing motion performance.
* Ability to read electrical schematics and troubleshoot interactions between software and physical equipment.
* Clear communication, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to follow technical issues through resolution.
* Willingness to travel for installation and commissioning.

Experience that would strengthen your application
  

* TwinCAT NC PTP, NC I, or CNC applications involving coordinated motion and interpolated toolpaths.
* Robotics, custom kinematics, coordinate transformations, or path-controlled manufacturing.
* TwinSAFE programming and machine safety validation.
* TwinCAT HMI or other industrial operator-interface development.
* ADS communication and integration with C#, C++, Python, or web applications.
* Git, object-oriented programming, automated testing, and reusable software-library development.
* Simulation, virtual commissioning, or digital machine models.
* Precision manufacturing, process instrumentation, force control, or closed-loop process control.
* Experience with Siemens, B&R, or Rockwell platforms.
* AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, or similar electrical design tools.

You do not need experience with every preferred technology to apply. We are especially interested in engineers who combine strong Beckhoff fundamentals with curiosity, practical troubleshooting skills, and ownership of completed machines.
  
  
You’ve learned about what you'll be doing, here are the benefits you'll gain when you join our team:
  

* Global team recognized for their passion of inventing
* First-of-a-kind product culture and project exposure
* Training and development from industry-leading experts
* Cutting edge benefit programs that include: 401(k) & matching; Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance; Disability & Life Insurance; PTO, Paid Holidays, & Parental Leave for both Parents; Tuition Reimbursement

PAR Systems is an equal opportunity employer and we value individuals with a variety of backgrounds and experiences. Energy Management oversees the reliable, safe and efficient operation of mechanical, electrical, and civil utilities systems in approximately 250 buildings on the Twin Cities campus. Your Job
  
You will help create one of the most advanced manufacturing operations in North America.
  
This is an opportunity to help define and deploy the next generation of manufacturing where robotics, AI, machine vision, autonomous material flow, advanced controls, and digital technologies work together to enable increasing levels of autonomous production and ultimately support our Lights-Out Manufacturing roadmap.
  
As part of RESRG's Operations Transformation team, you will lead the design, programming, deployment, and optimization of robotic and automation systems that directly advance our lights-out strategy. You will help transform Portageville into a showcase facility where innovative automation technologies deliver new levels of safety, quality, productivity, and operational excellence.
  
If you are passionate about robotics, enjoy solving difficult engineering challenges, and want to build technology that changes how factories operate, we want to hear from you.
  
  
What You Will Do in Your Role
  

* Design, build, program, commission, and optimize advanced robotic manufacturing systems.
* Develop next-generation automation solutions supporting our Lights-Out Manufacturing vision.
* Program and integrate industrial robots, PLCs, HMIs, servos, drives, and motion control systems.
* Implement advanced machine vision and AI-driven inspection technologies.
* Develop autonomous material handling solutions utilizing AGVs, AMRs, and intelligent logistics systems.
* Lead automation projects from concept through production launch.
* Partner with plant operations, maintenance, quality, and manufacturing engineering teams to identify and execute high-impact automation opportunities.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and help shape the future automation roadmap for Portageville and other RESRG facilities.
* Troubleshoot complex system issues and continuously improve equipment performance, reliability, and OEE.
* Contribute to new standards, automation architectures, and best practices that will be replicated across the enterprise.
* Serve as a technical leader for robotics and controls initiatives that accelerate OAMI advancement.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)
  

* BS/MS in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics Engineering, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience implementing industrial automation systems.
* Strong hands-on experience programming industrial robots and PLC-based control systems.
* Experience integrating vision systems, sensors, drives, and automation components.
* Ability to lead projects from concept through startup and production stabilization.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and a passion for continuous improvement.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

What Will Put You Ahead
  

* FANUC robot programming and vision experience.
* Allen-Bradley Studio 5000, ControlLogix, FactoryTalk, and PowerFlex expertise.
* Experience with AI-enabled inspection systems.
* Experience with AGVs, AMRs, autonomous logistics, or warehouse automation.
* Automation simulation and digital twin experience.
* Experience commissioning highly automated manufacturing cells or production lines.
* Automotive manufacturing experience.
* Knowledge of Industry 4.0, IIoT, MES integration, and smart factory technologies.

Join the Team Building the Future
  
At RESRG Automotive, we believe the next generation of manufacturing will be defined by intelligent automation, digital connectivity, and autonomous operation. If you're excited by the challenge of helping build a Lights-Out Manufacturing environment and advancing one of the industry's most aggressive automation roadmaps, Portageville is where you can make your mark.
  
About the Company
  
We are a fast-growing global manufacturer with a strong internal culture that values respect, diversity, and purposeful work. We offer career paths that enable professional growth, a team-focused environment, and a commitment to safety and wellness.
  
Our Benefits
  
Our goal is for each employee and their family to live fulfilling and healthy lives. Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, AD&D, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, paid parental leave, and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description. Speak to your recruiter for details on benefits that apply to you.
  
Equal Opportunities
  
Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E-Verify.

We are looking for an experienced Firmware Engineer to design and develop embedded firmware for advanced flow control products. In this role, you will work across firmware, hardware, and systems engineering to develop reliable, scalable solutions for real-time embedded applications.

You will contribute throughout the product development lifecycle, from system architecture and requirements through implementation, testing, design reviews, and release to manufacturing. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems and collaborating across multidisciplinary teams.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded firmware using C/C++ in a multi-threaded, real-time environment.
* Develop firmware for EtherCAT, DeviceNet, and legacy protocol flow control products.
* Translate product requirements into functional, firmware, and hardware/software design specifications.
* Contribute to embedded system and microcontroller/DSP architecture, considering performance, maintainability, scalability, and long-term product sustainability.
* Analyze and optimize embedded system resources for efficiency, stability, reliability, and scalability.
* Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and peer reviews of proposed hardware and software changes.
* Develop and execute design verification and test plans.
* Troubleshoot complex firmware and system-level issues throughout development and product lifecycle.
* Document product designs and support successful release and transition to manufacturing.
* Partner with electronics design engineers on the selection and qualification of new or replacement components.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to evaluate technical tradeoffs and guide designs toward optimal solutions.
Work independently with directional supervision while exercising sound technical judgment.  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 4+ years of combined firmware, embedded software, embedded controls, or closely related engineering experience.
* 3+ years of hands-on programming experience using C and/or C++ for embedded systems.
* Experience developing firmware in a real-time, concurrent, interrupt-driven, or multi-threaded environment.
* Experience developing firmware for microcontroller-, SoC-, or DSP-based embedded systems.
* Experience integrating firmware with hardware interfaces and peripherals such as ADCs, timers, PWM, GPIO, UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, or similar interfaces.
* Understanding of embedded system architecture, hardware/software interfaces, timing constraints, resource-constrained environments, and common firmware failure modes.
* Experience applying software engineering practices such as source control, issue tracking, peer review, modular design, defect management, testing, and maintainable coding standards.
* Ability to interpret technical requirements, decompose problems, evaluate alternatives, and develop reliable firmware solutions.
* Hands-on troubleshooting ability using debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, protocol analyzers, or equivalent laboratory tools.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary product development team.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical designs, decisions, and test results.

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Description:

**Job Summary:**

The Staff Platform Engineer sets the technical direction for the platform and solves infrastructure problems that span teams. The role stays hands-on — writing and reviewing infrastructure code and operating production systems — but most of its impact comes from shaping how the whole engineering organization builds, deploys, and runs software, without formal management authority. Staff engineers may also serve as a team's Tech Lead, a role that carries no change in title, band, or bonus.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Regularly audit and evaluate the platform's architecture, and lead the design and delivery of major
* architectural changes across teams on an annual basis.
* Write technical proposals for those changes and build agreement on them with product and engineering
* stakeholders.
* Set org-wide standards for infrastructure patterns, delivery practices, tooling, and technology choices.
* Partner with Buyer and Cargo engineering leadership so the platform supports what their teams need to build
* next.
* Define observability, reliability, and incident standards, and take on the hardest production problems: systemic
* bottlenecks, performance crises, and failures under heavy contention.
* Plan and carry out large migrations, such as database moves, network re-architecture, and project
* restructuring, without disrupting live auctions.
* Own the platform's security, cost, and capacity strategy.
* Mentor senior engineers and act as a force multiplier, influencing direction without formal authority.

Requirements:

**Qualifications / Requirements:**

* **Autonomy:** Leads strategy — defines technical direction without day-to-day oversight.
* **Technical Depth:** Visionary — deep expertise with the ability to see and shape the broader technical landscape.
* **Leadership Impact:** Force multiplier and system architect — makes entire teams more effective.
* **Business Impact:** Strategic — future-proofs systems and drives technical decisions that enable business growth.
* **Experience:** 7-10+ years of professional engineering experience, with a demonstrated record of infrastructure or platform impact across teams.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Advanced study in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline (Master's or equivalent graduate-level work) is a strong differentiator at this level.

**Technical Skills**

* **Languages:** Expert-level proficiency in TypeScript and strong proficiency in Go or Python.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Sets standards for infrastructure as code — state management, resource lifecycle, refactoring and aliasing, and reusable component design. Pulumi in TypeScript is a strong plus.
* **Cloud:** GCP architecture expertise — designs for reliability, cost efficiency, and scale across GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, and BigQuery.
* **Networking:** Network architecture expertise — multi-project VPC design, private service connectivity, load balancing, mTLS, and traffic management.
* **Databases:** Deep expertise in operating MySQL, PostgreSQL, and distributed SQL — replication, connection pooling, schema evolution at scale, and zero-downtime migrations.
* **Observability:** Designs and owns observability strategy — alerting, SLOs/SLAs, and distributed tracing.
* **Security:** Understands security at the architecture level — auth patterns, secrets management, network security, IAM, and defending against abusive traffic.
* **Technical Fundamentals:** Expert-level distributed systems knowledge — consensus, replication strategies, concurrency control under write contention, exactly-once semantics, and fault-tolerant design; OS and runtime internals relevant to performance (GC behavior, syscall overhead, context switching); systems design fluency — can decompose and reason about large-scale distributed architectures from first principles.

**Nice to Have**

* Temporal or other durable workflow orchestration.
* CockroachDB, PgBouncer, or large-scale database migration and replication.
* Cloud Armor, WAF, or bot-mitigation experience.
* Vertex AI or other ML serving infrastructure.
* Experience architecting systems with heavy write contention, such as many users acting on the same records at once in bidding, inventory, or payments.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Electrical Engineer

**The Opportunity:**

As an electrical engineer, you understand the power behind complex systems. That knowledge is key when it comes to supporting the military in pursuing distributed generation, renewable energy, and microgrid goals. We’re looking for an electrical engineer who can use their skills to perform detailed analysis on electric infrastructure and provide solutions in the areas of distributed generation integration, smart grid implementation, microgrid implementation, and utility investment strategy.

At Booz Allen, you’ll use your engineering skills to transform military installations. Our team implements energy assurance projects on military installations. That’s why we need you, an electrical engineer, who specializes in electric utility power systems to help us design and develop energy resilient solutions. You’ll analyze electric distribution systems and utility substations to identify gaps between the baseline infrastructure and the energy requirements of mission owners.

On our team, you’ll directly impact the DoD mission by ensuring that mission owners have access to energy when they need it. This is a chance to use your electrical engineering skills while gaining experience in solving complex problems and working with new technologies. Join us and take on exciting challenges with the military, as we provide resilient energy solutions in support of the DoD mission.

Take on exciting challenges in the DoW with us as we modernize Operations Centers for the Air Force.

Join us. The world can’t wait.  
  
**You Have:**

* 8+ years of experience in electrical power system design, analysis, or engineering
* Experience designing 600 V and below AC power distribution systems, including service entrance, transformers, switchboards and panelboards, feeders, and branch circuits
* Experience applying the National Electrical Code NFPA 70, including grounding and bonding, conductor ampacity and derating, overcurrent protection, and transformer and raceway requirements
* Experience performing or reviewing short-circuit, protective-device coordination, and arc-flash studies including IEEE 1584 or NFPA 70E
* Experience with UPS and battery energy storage systems, standby or mobile generators, or source-transfer schemes
* Experience self-driving complex projects independently and as a technical lead on larger multi-disciplinary teams
* Ability to interpret, develop, and analyze electrical single-line diagrams, panel schedules, and cable schedules
* Ability to travel to fabrication, test, and deployment sites up to 25% of the time
* Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Energy Engineering

**Nice If You Have:**

* Experience with HEMP/EMP hardening including MIL-STD-188-125, TEMPEST, or shielded-enclosure design, including power-line filters and treatment of barrier penetrations
* Experience with mobile, transportable, or tactical power systems, or the electrical design of shelters, containers, or skids
* Experience supporting secure-facility (SCIF) electrical design or accreditation, and with DoD infrastructure, facilities, and organizations, including coordination with base civil engineering electrical shops
* Experience with system safety and reliability analysis, such as FMECA MIL-STD-1629, or hazard analysis MIL-STD-882, and with grounding, bonding, and lightning protection for military facilities or electronic systems including MIL-HDBK-419 and UFC 3-575-01
* Experience writing requirements verification matrices, factory inspection and test plans, or field acceptance test procedures, and witnessing them, and releasing designs to fabrication and reviewing vendor submittals and shop drawings
* Experience with load flow, short-circuit, or power-system simulation software such as SKM, ETAP, or EasyPower, and with microgrids, renewable integration, or energy-resilience design for military installations
* Experience communicating technical designs and concepts to a non-technical audience
* Possession of excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Master's degree in Engineering or a related field
* Professional Engineering license (P.E.)

**Clearance:**
  
Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

**Compensation**

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. * Review and influence technical decisions to improve quality, consistency, maintainability, and scalability

* Able to influence without authority and align teams around clear technical direction

* Skilled at mentoring engineers and raising team capability
* Able to balance hands-on technical work with broader leadership responsibilities
* Communicative, collaborative, and effective in cross-functional settings

**Qualifications**

* Extensive experience in software engineering, with demonstrated principal-level technical impact
* Strong experience designing scalable, maintainable systems
* Proven ability to lead technical discussions and drive design decisions
* Experience working in agile environments and collaborating across engineering, product, and operations

**Job Description**  
We are seeking a mid-career Electrical Engineer to support our Electronic Attack Systems and related technologies. If selected, you will be part of the Hardware Team supporting development programs in the Franchise Program Portfolio – a major piece of our Electronic Attack Solutions product line.
  
Key Responsibilities could include:

* Translate system requirements into successful system architectures and complex printed board assembly designs.
* Create system schematic and layouts
* Perform trade studies and prototyping to down select critical components, develop optimized electronic architectural solutions (SWAP), verify complex custom circuit blocks of an overarching system
* Support System Integration and Test in labs and directly on platforms
* Provide electrical engineering support for critical test events
* Document design verification tests and design review documentation
* Actively participate in knowledge-sharing culture via mentoring
* Work within schedule and budget constraints and elevate concerns if challenges arise.
  

  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering
* Minimum of four years of relevant experience in related industry (i.e. defense, electronics) or two years with a Master’s Degree
* Solid understanding of fundamentals of digital, analog, power, and mixed-signal electronics and interface/communication standards such as UART, SPI, QSPI, I2C, USB, Ethernet, ARINC 429, MIL-STD-1553, PCIe
* PCB/CCA design experience, with an emphasis on DFA and DFM optimization, for complex rigid and rigid-flex mixed-signal HDI PCBs.
* Proficient at testing and troubleshooting analog, digital, and power supply-based circuits in a lab setting using oscilloscopes, bench supplies, vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, frequency counters, arbitrary waveform generators, function generators, logic analyzers
  

  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, or equivalent
* Familiarity designing with FPGAs, System-On-Chips (SoC), and/or CPLDs using VHDL and/or Verilog
* Familiarity designing and writing embedded SW for microcontroller-based systems and modules
* Knowledge of system level EMI mitigation techniques along with proper grounding/shielding architecture
* Experience with high-speed mixed signal HDI PCB design, constraints management, and proper routing for interfaces with lane rates exceeding 1Gbps
* Hands-on experience with high voltage testing with an emphasis on measurement safety
* Experience with low noise, wide bandwidth, low power, Analog Front-End systems
* Understanding of SPICE simulators and simulation methods, preferably using LTSpice, TINA, PSpice Experience with the following PCB and CCA design features: micro-via and blind/buried vias, stacked micro-vias, via-in-pad and via fill/cap processes, controlled impedances, backdrilling, high pin count / fine-pitch BGAs, Chip-on-Board (COB), QFNs/DFNs, LGAs, and other advanced IC package types
* Familiarity with phase/gain margin stability analysis and other small signal analysis techniques, as it applies to analog circuit design and switch-mode power supply design
* Familiarity with Signal Integrity and Power Integrity, as it applies to proper layout techniques
* Active DoD Security Clearance – Top Secret with SCI
  

  
  
**Pay Information**

jobs.title: Systems Engineering Strategy Lead - PGSS Programs
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  
See what you are missing. Our employees work on the world’s most advanced electronics – from providing the latest technologies in Smart Munitions sensor solutions to illuminating the night for soldiers. Spanning air, land, sea, and space, we are developing the technology of tomorrow, delivered today. Drawing strength from our differences, we are innovating for the future. In addition, you can, too. Our flexible work environment provides you a chance to change the world without giving up your personal life. We put our customers first – exemplified by our mission: “We Protect Those Who Protect Us®.”
  
  
Sound like a team you want to be a part of? Come enhance your career with us.
  
  
In Precision Strike & Sensing Solutions, we design and manufacture state-of-the-art systems and technology that enable our customers to successfully execute their precision strike missions. We are a fast-growing business, partnering with end-use customers to design, prototype, and deploy some of the coolest capabilities that have a direct impact on warfighter today!
  
  
We are seeking a Systems Engineering ‘Strategy Lead’ that will directly support the Precision Guidance and Sensing Solutions (PGSS) Product Line systems engineering director. The selected candidate will be required to be highly versed in the systems engineering life cycle, assist the director on all necessary staffing and personnel actions, and coordinate activities of seven separate SE Section Managers across the entire PGSS portfolio. Currently, this team is comprised of over 80 systems engineers, located in our facilities in southern New Hampshire and Huntsville, Alabama. The PGSS Product line is responsible for key franchise programs such as the Advance Precision Kill Weapons System (APKWS) and the Terminal High Altitude Air Defense (THAAD) System, along with our ‘Market Expansion’ portfolio of programs which lead our efforts to develop various RF and IR Seeker technologies to meet the future needs of our warfighters. The systems engineering discipline is critical to the product development of new and modernized guidance systems. The selected candidate will be ‘all things strategy’ for our PGSS systems engineering team charged to develop requirements, monitor design, complete test and verification, deliver, and support critical mission capabilities.

We are seeking an R&D Electrical/Electronics Engineer to join our dynamic team in a Surety System Engineering role with special emphasis on Category 1 Electrical Equipment Assurance. Our department provides system and software surety, with this position specifically focusing on Category 1 Acceptance Testers, Use Control Systems, and T-gear for the DoD.

This position requires performing multiple engineering functions, from deep dive circuit analysis and failure mode determination, to testing actual prototypes, performing software safety analyses, qualifying Category 1 equipment, interfacing with Independent Assessment, and presenting to the NESSG. This role also involves engaging and collaborating regularly with personnel across multiple Sandia organizations, as well as with Los Alamos National Laboratory, Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory, the National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA), Pantex production facility, and Department of Defense (DOD) organizations.

Additional duties may include software surety for weapons and weapons-related product. This Surety Engineer would provide R&D contributions throughout the entire product realization lifecycle including monitoring every phase of the development process to ensure software product design, development, and verification activities delivers an assured software product that meets its requirements safely and reliably. The Surety Engineer applies engineering principles across a wide range of projects including components, subsystems, and systems. Projects span across all phases of the product realization lifecycle from conceptual design and development to production and maintenance/retirement.

On any given day you may be called on to:

* Analyze and interpret electrical schematics, environmental specifications, and system level documentation using the Sandia NW drawing and authorization system.
* Perform Fault Tree and Failure analysis at the system, subsystem, component, and ancillary equipment level to identify failure modes in analog and digital circuit designs.
* Develop testing approaches and test configurations to ensure that designs effectively meet requirements in a safe manner across a wide range of environmental conditions.
* Understand component functionality in light of its parent product use, from FPGA/ASIC/SoC through PWB/PWAs, subassemblies, systems, and software to effectively verify functionality and safety of those products in normal and abnormal environments.
* Develop qualification and safety plans to ensure successful authorization of high-consequence hardware and software products.
* Partner with component/system design teams, test organizations, safety and surety engineering, and independent assessment to devise and execute analysis and testing of Category 1 designs.
* Present at program technical reviews and nuclear explosive safety studies specifically regarding failure modes, risks, and issues identified.
* Interface with colleagues within Sandia and externally at LANL, LLNL, Pantex, Kansas City, and the NNSA.
* Interface with the Nuclear Explosive Safety Study Group (NESSG).
* Work independently and within teams to coordinate and execute large scale Category 1 design projects.
* Apply technical judgement and software engineering principles to recognize problems, develop requirements, monitor and support design/development methods, and deliver qualified, accepted digital product.
* Lead R&D teams in identifying and transforming unknown technical challenges into known technical risks to ensure and improve the safety, security, and reliability of the product.

Occasional travel between Albuquerque and production facilities is required. Due to the nature of the work, at least 80% on-site work at the Pantex facility is required for this position.

**Salary Range**
----------------

  

$97,500 - $190,200

* Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
At Skip-Line, your next circuit will hit the highway.

**Smart sensors. Embedded systems. Machines that move. An industry ready for its next big leap.** If that sounds more exciting than designing another gadget destined for a drawer, keep reading.

At Skip-Line, we build the brains behind modern pavement marking equipment. Our electronic controls, sensors, and embedded software turn paint trucks into autonomous precision machines that mark highways, roads, and runways smarter, with less waste and better data.

We’re the leading technology company in an industry most people drive past without thinking about. Look closer: there’s real-time control, laser sensing, connected hardware, and a whole lot of engineering between “put paint on pavement” and “get it right at speed.” And we’re hiring a collaborative, passionate, Electrical Engineer to help build what’s next.

**Job Location:** Adams Center, NY\* *(see details below)*

* *Must reside in Northern or Central New York regions with the ability to commute to our office on a hybrid schedule.*

**Base Salary:** $78,000 - $135,000, based on experience and demonstrated capabilities.

**What You’ll Do:**

You’ll design, build, and test (or sometimes break on purpose) the electronics behind our next generation of hardware. You’ll work side by side with our embedded, product, and production teams. Here’s what that involves:

* **Design the electronics behind smart machines:** You’ll design and build circuits, boards, and electrical interfaces for controllers, sensors, and connected pavement marking systems.
* **Board bring-up:** You’ll bring new boards to life by building prototypes, doing board bring-up, and troubleshooting with the persistence the problem requires.
* **Lead compliance testing:** You’ll plan and prepare for compliance testing, map out what our products need to pass, prep hardware for EMC/EMI testing, collaborate with outside test labs, and keep at it until we pass.
* **Make hardware and software play nicely:** You’ll collaborate with embedded engineers to investigate system behavior and solve problems across the hardware/firmware seam.
* **Make the call.** You’ll evaluate compliance requirements, recommend practical priorities, and explain the tradeoffs between design changes, testing, cost, and ship dates; know when to make a decision independently and when to bring in the right expertise.
* **Make the next build better.** You’ll partner with production teams on testability, component choices, and troubleshooting, so every new board is easier to make, test, and fix.

**A great design earns its place on the truck.** Through compliance testing, you’ll help build equipment crews can trust and products ready for market.

**What You Bring:**

* A Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* Hands-on PCB design and board bring-up experience.
* Compliance testing: Hands-on EMC/EMI experience, including prepping products for testing, working with outside labs, and turning failed results into design fixes is a must-have.
* Working knowledge of microcontrollers, sensors, and communication protocols like CAN.
* Comfort reading schematics, working with electronic components, and using tools such as oscilloscopes and multimeters.
* A methodical debugging habit: gather evidence, isolate the cause, fix it, and verify the fix.
* Ownership, sound judgment, and clear communication.

**Big plus:** Real EMC/EMI compliance experience. You’ve been to the test lab, failed a scan and figured out why.

**Never been near a paint truck? No problem. Bring your engineering curiosity. We’ll introduce you to the trucks.**

**Why Skip-Line?**

* **Real technology. Visible impact.** Our lineup spans precision striping controls, cloud-connected data logging, and laser-based material monitoring. Your work helps crews do a difficult job better.
* **A tight team where your ideas ship.** You won’t be a cog. You’ll decide what technology goes on paint trucks, challenge assumptions, and help shape better products with an innovative, collaborative team.
* **Modern tools, real judgment.** Use AI and modern tooling freely. Just understand the circuit and own the result.
* **Benefits that support life beyond the bench.** Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) retirement with company match; paid vacation and sick time; and a paid week off at Christmas, and more.
* **Established leadership. Continuous Innovation.** We’ve been advancing pavement-marking technology since 1969. We’re not done inventing.

**Build something worth putting on the road.**

Send your resume to **hr@skipline.com** with **“Electrical Engineer — Skip-Line”** in the subject line.

**Want to stand out?** Include a few sentences about a hardware problem you solved: what went wrong, how you found it, and what you changed. A project link is welcome. **Please don’t share confidential work.**

**The road ahead needs better technology. Help us build it.**

*Skip-Line is an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment and consider applicants without regard to protected characteristics under applicable federal, state, and local law.*

jobs.title: Systems Software Engineer, Hardware Validation
jobs.description:
**Systems Software Engineer, Hardware Validation**

**About us:**

Voyant Photonics builds silicon photonic chips that steer and switch light at high speed. They power next generation, chip-scale FMCW LiDAR for robotics and autonomy, and optical circuit switches (OCS) for AI data centers. Based in NYC, we’re a hands-on team designing, building, and deploying frontier hardware to solve problems that matter, from how machines see to how AI scales.

**About the role**

Our tech stack spans FPGA and ASIC logic, microcontroller firmware, Linux drivers and cross platform user-facing APIs, and every layer changes every week. We're hiring engineers, at more than one level, to keep them integrated, tested and releasable.

**What Actually Matters**

Code is cheaper to write than ever. Knowing what should be written, and what "done" means, is the job. We want someone with strong, well-reasoned opinions about how software should be organized and how test coverage should grow, who argues for them, and who changes their mind when the evidence says so.

Things we believe in as a team:

* **Fix it at the source.** A bug gets fixed where it lives, even when that's someone else's code. The friction of working in each other's areas is worth it.
* **Live at the tip.** Every repo tracks the latest of everything it depends on. Small, frequent bumps surface breaks while they're still cheap to fix.
* **Duplicated code is broken code.** Two copies drift apart, and then one of them is wrong.
* **It doesn't work until someone else has run it on hardware.** Your own simulation or bench is where you start, not where you're done.

Disagree with one? Tell us why when you apply.

**What You'll Do**

* Own releases from commit to customer: build, verify, version and ship product bundles (FPGA bitstreams, firmware, drivers, APIs), including field updates, with release notes and runbooks people trust.
* Grow our HIL CI to cover every subsystem, and bring each new product into it from its first bring-up board.
* Track every bug CI finds to its root cause, whether that's Python, Rust, firmware, a Linux driver or FPGA logic, then fix it.
* Take our products into the systems that use them: time sync, calibration, sensor fusion, and open-source ecosystems like OCP and ROS.

**What We're Looking For**

* 2+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent depth from research, internships or serious personal projects. We'll scale scope to experience.
* Strong Python, and comfort debugging languages you don't write every day.
* Hands-on hardware experience: bring-up, reading schematics, and using lab instruments to tell a software bug from a board bug.
* CI/CD experience, ideally against real hardware.
* Proactive communicator who cares about documentation to support cross functional team members & customers.

**Nice to Have**

* Rust, C++ or embedded C (we use STM32)
* Linux device drivers, especially SPI and custom low-level interfaces
* Reading System Verilog well enough to debug across the FPGA boundary
* HIL rigs and lab automation (SCPI/VISA, self-hosted CI runners)
* Timing and signal-integrity debug across SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet and JTAG/SWD, plus board rework
* Fiber optics and optical test equipment
* Datacenter networking, PTP, point clouds or ROS 2
* Supporting software that external customers depend on

**What You'll Gain**

* Ownership of the release and test architecture for our products, from first bring-up to shipping: real decisions, not someone else's pipeline.
* Close collaboration with hardware, optics, signal processing and perception engineers, and real influence over technical direction at an early-stage company.
* A path toward customer-facing integration work, if that interests you.

**Life at Voyant**

We build frontier hardware & software from our lab and office in Midtown Manhattan, where optical tables, lab benches and electronics sit alongside traditional office space. Our work is hands-on and primarily in person, but we don’t run on a rigid 9-to-5. We partner with customers across time zones, so some calls start early or run late, and we adjust schedules around them. We run a high-trust, high-accountability environment: you’ll own meaningful work, move quickly and often wear more than one hat. Voyant provides catered lunch every day at HQ, and we’re a diverse group of food lovers from around the world who enjoy sharing food, culture and technical ideas around the lunch table.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Voyant Photonics is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, citizenship, veteran or military status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, caregiver status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Compensation Range: $110K - $170K

jobs.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, VectorDB
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Anthropic is looking for a Staff+ Software Engineer to work on the vector search infrastructure behind Claude. Retrieval is how Claude learns about the world. Web search across claude.ai, the API and agentic surfaces, memory across conversations, and the reinforcement learning workloads that train our next models all depend on fast, cheap, high-recall nearest-neighbor search over billions of vectors.

You'll join a small team responsible for the vector database layer that serves Claude's retrieval workloads: its architecture, performance, scalability and cost. This is a foundational role. The team is small, core architectural decisions are still open, and the engineers who join now will shape how the system evolves.

The role sits in our Databases organization and works day to day with the Search Platform team, which owns web search indexing, retrieval and serving, and the Memory & Search team, which owns search and memory inside claude.ai.

We're looking for someone who has built vector or search systems that ran in production, at scale, with real users and a real on-call. You'll be hands-on in the code, and you'll also be the person deciding how the pieces fit together.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the core of Anthropic's vector database layer: index structures, storage layout, query execution and the serving layer
* Own production readiness - benchmarking against exact search, capacity planning, onboarding new workloads, and the operational tooling to run it at scale
* Drive the recall, latency and cost trade-offs - quantization, filtered search, index build and refresh strategy, and how compute and storage are separated and scaled
* Scale throughput by an order of magnitude as research and training demand grows, and work out whether the bottleneck is architecture, hardware or engineering bandwidth
* Extend the retrieval stack toward hybrid retrieval - lexical search and fused ranking alongside vector search
* Set the evaluation methodology for the system - recall targets, latency objectives, cost per query, and the regression detection that keeps them honest
* Set technical direction for a growing team - lead design reviews, make architectural decisions others build on, and mentor the engineers joining the effort
* Share the on-call for the systems you own

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Direct experience building a vector database or approximate nearest-neighbor search system that ran in production at scale
* Deep knowledge of ANN index structures (graph-based, clustering-based or disk-resident approaches), vector quantization and filtered search
* Experience with search relevance and ranking
* Strong systems programming skills in a language such as Rust, C++ or Go, including performance-critical and memory-intensive code
* Experience designing and operating large-scale distributed storage or serving systems with strict latency and reliability requirements
* A track record of independently scoping and delivering ambiguous, multi-quarter technical projects
* Strong written and verbal communication, with experience driving alignment across teams with different priorities
* Interest in AI safety and Anthropic's mission

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with object-storage-backed or disaggregated compute and storage database designs
* Experience building or operating full-text search engines (inverted indexes, BM25) or hybrid retrieval systems
* Familiarity with embedding models and the retrieval demands of LLM training and inference
* Experience using GPUs or other accelerators for index build or search
* Prior experience as a technical lead on a database or search infrastructure team

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$320,000 - $485,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Technician
jobs.description:
Join our Team as a **Electrical Engineering Technician**!

**The Role:**

Join our team as an **Electrical Engineering Technician** and put your electrical expertise to work supporting the development, integration, and testing of electric forklift systems and components.

In this hands-on role, you'll build and troubleshoot electrical harnesses, assemblies, and test fixtures while working with electrical schematics, diagnostic equipment, and prototype systems. You'll collaborate with engineering teams to solve technical challenges, support testing, and keep projects moving in an environment where priorities can shift and no two days are exactly alike.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Read, interpret, and create electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and component layouts for test fixtures and equipment.
* Fabricate, assemble, and repair electrical wiring harnesses, power harnesses, panels, and test fixtures using proper crimping, soldering, wire routing, and assembly techniques.
* Operate electrical test equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes, current clamps, thermocouple loggers, strain gauges, and voltage/current data loggers.
* Troubleshoot electrical systems on electric forklifts, test fixtures, and prototype equipment using standard and specialized diagnostic tools.
* Support electrical system integration by installing, calibrating, and testing motor controllers, vehicle wiring harnesses, sensors, and other electrical components.
* Build and support test stands and fixtures used for electrical system integration and testing.
* Document testing, troubleshooting, and integration activities using Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and PTC Creo Schematics.
* Maintain laboratory equipment, tools, workbenches, and soldering stations in accordance with 5S practices and applicable safety standards.

**What We're Looking For:**

* Associate degree in Electrical/Electronic Technology or a related field, or at least two years of equivalent hands-on electrical/electronic experience.
* Hands-on electrical harness and panel fabrication skills, including wire preparation, crimping, soldering, and assembly.
* Practical understanding of low-voltage DC electrical systems and troubleshooting techniques.
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, harness drawings, assembly prints, connector pinouts, PCB/PCA drawings, and component datasheets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including fluency in English.
* Effective time management and organizational skills, with the flexibility to adapt to changing priorities.

**What Sets You Apart:**

* Familiarity with electric forklift electrical systems or similar electric vehicle technologies.
* Exposure to C, C++, Python, or similar programming languages, including scripting, embedded systems, or test automation.
* Understanding of communication protocols and interfaces such as CANopen, RS-232, RS-485, and Ethernet.
* Familiarity with electrical and manufacturing standards, including IPC/WHMA-A-620, UL 583, UL 758, UL 62, NFPA 70/NEC, and NFPA 79.

**Where and When You'll Work:**

* This is an in-person role located at our Greene, NY site —ideal for those who thrive in a hands-on, team-oriented environment.

**What Your Total Compensation & Benefits Package will look like:**

**Wage** - $27.52 - $40.33 per hour. Compensation depends on the selected candidate's education and experience.

**Relocation:** This role may be eligible for relocation assistance.

**World Class Benefits:**

* Competitive Salary
* Performance Bonus
* Generous Paid Time Off and 13 Paid Holidays
* Affordable Medical plans and no-cost Dental & Vision options
* 100% 401(k) match up to 6%
* Company-Paid Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability
* Tuition Assistance Program
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with access to mental health care, legal support, and financial guidance
* Recognition and Kaizen (continuous improvement) Reward Programs
* Meaningful opportunities for personal and professional development
* Best in class work culture!

Toyota Material Handling North America (TMHNA), the industry leader in forklift sales, comprises two main brands: Toyota Material Handling and The Raymond Corporation. We believe investing in the best people, products, and processes will fuel our future success, and we will always be driven by our foundational principles of “respect for people” and “continuous improvement”. jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Broadcast Systems Engineer to design, integrate, commission, support, and evolve broadcast and media systems for live television, radio, studio production, contribution, and digital distribution.

The ideal candidate combines strong traditional broadcast engineering skills with expertise in modern IP media infrastructure, particularly SMPTE ST 2110, broadcast networking, IP routing, and system integration. This role works across the full media signal chain and requires strong troubleshooting skills, technical curiosity, and effective collaboration with engineering, operations, IT/networking teams, and vendors.

  
  

**We will expect you to:**

* Design, build, commission, maintain, and troubleshoot television, radio, studio, control room, remote production, and media distribution systems.

* Support contribution and distribution workflows across studios, bureaus, cloud environments, and external partners, including OTT/HLS,SRT, Zixi, transcoding, packaging, captioning, and monitoring.

* Troubleshoot issues spanning broadcast hardware, software, servers, networks, codecs, control systems.

* Develop installation plans, commissioning procedures, test plans, operational documentation, and engineering standards. Including ability to create and maintain AutoCAD drawings and create technical documentation.

* Evaluate new technologies, conduct proofs of concept, manage vendor technical issues, and support system upgrades, migrations, facility builds, and major production events.

* Improve system reliability, redundancy, monitoring, automation, and operational workflows while sharing technical knowledge across the engineering organization.

  
  

**You will need to have:**

* Professional experience in broadcast engineering, media technology, or systems integration.

* A working knowledge of SMPTE ST 2110, IP-based broadcast routing, and traditional SDI/baseband infrastructure.

* Strong understanding of video formats, frame rates, standards conversion, synchronization, embedding/de-embedding, latency, buffering, and audio/video timing.

* Knowledge of professional broadcast audio, including digital audio routing, consoles, IFB, mix-minus, and intercom systems.

* Experience with virtualization and cloud platforms such as VMware, AWS, Azure, or GCP

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Broadcast Technology, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline preferred, or equivalent professional experience. Extensive hands-on broadcast engineering and systems integration experience may be considered in lieu of a formal degree.

  
  

**Engineering Mindset & Attributes**

* Able to isolate complex issues across broadcast devices, IP networks, software, codecs, servers, cloud services, and transmission paths.

* Comfortable evaluating emerging technologies, building proofs of concept, and introducing new solutions safely into highly available production environments.

* Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and accountable, with the ability to work independently and collaborate across a global engineering organization.

* Comfortable working directly with vendors and balancing immediate production needs with long-term engineering objectives.

* Willing to support occasional off-hours maintenance, commissioning, and major production events.

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  
  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  
  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

-----------------------------

The IT Product Engineering team is critical to unifying Rippling's workforce management system, bridging the gap between HR and traditional IT administration. Our mission is to build software that enables businesses to manage employee devices, applications, and access security automatically, leveraging Rippling's single source of employee truth (the HRIS). We automate the complexity of IT management from the moment a new employee is hired to the moment they offboard.

We build the mission-critical software that simplifies IT for organizations, turning complex, manual processes into simple, one-click solutions. Our core product domains include:
