jobs.description:
Cambridge Design Partnership is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to operate as Technical Lead on a range of complex Electromechanical products for our clients. Working alongside a Project Manager to manage a multidisciplinary team, you will bring mechanical, electrical, firmware, and software elements together to ensure the complete product works as intended.

This is a practical, delivery-focused role. You will shape requirements and architecture, assess risks and technical options, plan integration and testing, and help resolve issues as ideas become working prototypes and production-ready designs. You should be just as comfortable discussing a design with a client as you are investigating a problem in the lab.

We are particularly interested in engineers with an electrical or mechatronics background who enjoy thinking beyond their own discipline. You will work with talented specialists across a variety of product development projects and take on technical responsibility appropriate to your experience.

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

Systems Engineering and Product Ownership

* Take a whole-product view of development, from initial feasibility and concept selection through detailed design, integration and verification.
* Turn stakeholder needs into practical requirements and trace them through to verification
* Manage Technical Risk and develop effective Risk Control Measures to ensure products are safe to use and meet regulatory constraints
* Comfortable managing mechanical, electronics, firmware, software and other specialists together so that individual subsystems work as one coherent product.
* Spot technical gaps and risks early, agree priorities with the team and drive engineering issues through to resolution.

Requirements, Architecture and Interfaces

* Take the lead on defining, reviewing and maintaining system requirements, making sure they are clear, testable and linked to the needs they address.
* Shape system architecture, data flow, and long-term technical roadmaps across multiple teams.
* Develop functional architectures, break products into manageable subsystems and agree technical responsibilities across engineering disciplines.
* Define interfaces between hardware, embedded software, controls and mechanical systems, including signals, power, communications and physical connections.
* Establish and assess key performance budgets, such as power, timing, accuracy or throughput, using analysis and test data to guide decisions.

Technical Problem Solving and Risk

* Take a hands-on approach to technical challenges, working with engineers to investigate unexpected behavior and find the root cause of problems.
* Plan and carry out focused feasibility work, experiments and prototype tests to answer important engineering questions early.
* Manage design reviews and risk assessments, helping the team make sound decisions on performance, reliability, safety and design maturity.
* Manage DFMEA and Risk Registers, assessing risk acceptability and tracing risks through Risk Control Measures to implementation

Integration, Test and Verification

* Plan how subsystems will be brought together and tested, with clear methods and acceptance criteria for demonstrating product performance.
* Support the build and integration of electromechanical prototypes, helping diagnose issues across electronics, controls, firmware, software and mechanisms.
* Prepare test methods and plans, participate in testing, interpret results and follow through on failures and design changes.

* Collaborate with suppliers and external partners to agree specifications, resolve interface issues and integrate their work into the product.

**Requirements**  

* Track record of at least 10 years' experience designing products in a highly regulated industry, preferably medical devices.
* Hands-on and practical engineering skills, willing and able to get stuck in to designing solutions and able to demonstrate a passion for engineering in and out of work.
* Able to see the complete product while still understanding enough technical detail to make informed engineering decisions at all levels and engineering disciplines.
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the curiosity and judgement to challenge assumptions and work through unfamiliar technical problems.
* Pragmatic and organized, able to bring structure to an ambiguous brief without creating unnecessary complexity or paperwork.
* Confident working across disciplines, with technical strengths in mechanical and electrical engineering or mechatronics.

* Able to balance performance, usability, cost, risk and development timescales when recommending engineering solutions.
* Proactive, collaborative and accountable, with the drive to take ownership and see technical issues through to completion.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
If you’re a hardware engineer at a large defense contractor and your ideas keep getting lost in layers of approval, this role puts you one step from the CTO. At Kraken Kinetics, you’ll design, build and test the electrical systems inside safe-and-arm and fuzing systems for unmanned platforms, technology that goes directly into the hands of US warfighters.

Kraken Kinetics designs and manufactures warheads and firing systems for unmanned and autonomous weapon platforms, and gets them to production quickly. In this hands-on role, you’ll report to the Director of Engineering/CTO and work across every electrical system the team builds, taking designs from schematic through prototype, test and qualification. You’ll have real ownership of your work, a direct line to leadership, and the space to bring forward ideas and see them built.

**This Role Suits You If:**

* You want to own your designs from concept to test, not hand them off and lose sight of them
* You have ideas that aren’t being heard where you are now
* You enjoy a fast pace and a team that moves quickly from decision to action
* You want your work to make a direct difference to warfighters in the field

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop electrical systems for ESADs, fuzing and related kinetic systems, from schematic capture to PCB layout
* Own PCB design for signal integrity, power distribution and thermal management
* Build prototypes and lead testing and qualification, including environmental and stress testing
* Write and debug microcontroller firmware in C/C++
* Troubleshoot hardware and carry out root cause analysis using JTAG, oscilloscopes and bench testing
* Work with mechanical, software and systems engineers on integration, interfaces and ICDs
* Ensure designs comply with MIL-STD-1316, MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-202 and IPC-2221
* Produce and maintain design specifications, test procedures and failure analysis reports under revision control
* Support assembly, testing and field deployment of prototype and production systems
* Mentor junior engineers and lead smaller projects or subsystems

**Experience Required:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering or a related field, with 5+ years of hands-on hardware design in defense, aerospace or other safety critical industries
* ESAD, fuzing, safe and arm, warhead or payload experience strongly preferred; engineers from avionics, munitions test, medical devices or other high-reliability electronics will also be considered
* Analog and digital circuit design, PCB layout (Altium or similar) and embedded C/C++ for microcontrollers (Preferred)
* Hands-on lab and debug skills, including oscilloscopes, JTAG, failure analysis and reliability testing
* Familiarity with MIL-STD-1316, MIL-STD-810 and MIL-STD-202 desirable
* US person; active security clearance, or the ability to obtain one, required

Pay: $115,000.00 - $165,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer- Electrical Engineering
jobs.description:
Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

The **Reliability Engineer (Electrical Engineering)** will lead electrical reliability, signal-integrity validation, and product qualification for cable backplane assemblies used in AI and hyperscale data centers. The role will develop scalable test strategies and automated systems, characterize high-speed channels and electrical interfaces, and identify failure mechanisms under electrical and environmental stress. In partnership with design, manufacturing, quality, and external laboratories, the engineer will drive root-cause resolution and design and process improvements. This position is based in Etters, PA or Raleigh, NC. Approximately 20% travel is expected.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop electrical reliability and validation strategies, test plans, acceptance criteria, and coverage across the product life cycle.
* Architect and validate automated electrical test systems, fixtures, breakout boards, and loopback setups for laboratory and manufacturing use.
* Characterize signal and electrical performance using TDR, VNA, BERT, oscilloscopes, source-measure units, and related equipment.
* Evaluate channel, power, ground, shielding, continuity, resistance, and dielectric performance before, during, and after environmental and accelerated-life testing.
* Apply DOE, MSA, reliability statistics, and data analysis to ensure test capability and identify degradation trends and failure thresholds.
* Lead electrical failure analysis and document results, risks, and recommendations for design, qualification, manufacturing, and customer decisions.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, electronics, or reliability engineering with an electrical focus; advanced degree preferred.
* 5+ years in electrical reliability, product validation, signal-integrity testing, or automated test-system development; interconnect experience preferred.
* Strong knowledge of circuit fundamentals, transmission lines, differential signaling, impedance, grounding, shielding, power integrity, and electrical failure mechanisms.
* Hands-on experience developing automated test systems, interpreting schematics and interconnect drawings, and troubleshooting intermittent or mixed-mode failures.
* Working knowledge of reliability statistics, DOE, MSA, sampling methods, data analysis, and cross-functional project execution.
* Ability to travel approximately 20% to manufacturing sites, laboratories, suppliers, and customer locations.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with high-speed serial channels, cable and connector validation, S-parameters, calibration, de-embedding, and simulation-to-measurement correlation.
* Automation experience using Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB, PLCs, or comparable control and data-acquisition tools.
* Experience with HALT, HASS, ALT, ORT, ESS, thermal cycling, vibration, and shock testing with in-situ electrical monitoring.
* Experience designing and validating electrical test boards, including schematics, component selection, layout review, and bring-up.
* Knowledge of AI data-center interconnects and applicable IPC, IEC, IEEE, Telcordia, or MIL-STD requirements; reliability certification is a plus.

Amphenol Corporation is proud of our reputation as an excellent employer. Our focus is to provide the highest level of support and responsiveness to both our employees and our customers, the world's largest technology companies. Amphenol Corporation offers the opportunity for career growth within a global organization. We believe that Amphenol Corporation is unique in that every employee, regardless of his or her position, has the ability to positively impact the business.

**z/OS, CICS, MQ and zCEE**
---------------------------

  

### **Position Overview-(Remote-Onsite)**

The Senior Mainframe Platform Engineer is responsible for the engineering, health, security, resiliency, connectivity, and performance of mission-critical mainframe platforms. This position provides technical leadership across z/OS, CICS, MQ, zCEE, networking, hardware, storage, performance management, and capacity planning within a Parallel Sysplex environment.

  

The successful candidate will lead complex engineering initiatives, develop platform roadmaps, troubleshoot critical incidents, support technology modernization, and establish standards that improve platform availability, scalability, and operational efficiency. This individual will also provide technical direction, education, and mentoring to engineers, programmers, analysts, and technical support associates.

  

This can be either a remote or onsite position.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain the overall health, security, resiliency, availability, connectivity, and performance of z/OS, CICS for z/OS, MQ for z/OS, and zCEE across multiple Sysplexes and central electronic complexes.
* Engineer, install, configure, customize, maintain, and support z/OS operating systems, application subsystems, independent software vendor products, and related mainframe technologies.
* Support CICS, CICSPLEX, MQ, zCEE, Workload Manager, Coupling Facility, SMF processing, DASD, hardware configurations, channels, IPL processes, storage management, and Parallel Sysplex environments.
* Design and support mainframe networking and connectivity, including TCP/IP, SNA/APPN, LU6.2, sockets, EXCI, TCP, UDP, ICMP, routing protocols, AT-TLS, IPsec, and z/VM SSL Server.
* Diagnose and resolve complex z/OS and z/VM connectivity, encryption, transmission, performance, and capacity issues.
* Execute and analyze packet traces, system dumps, traces, logs, and performance data to identify root causes and restore service.
* Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for high-priority CICS, MQ, zCEE, networking, and mainframe platform incidents.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate recurring issues, reduce mean time to recovery, and improve monitoring, automation, resiliency, availability, and scalability.
* Develop platform roadmaps, technical strategies, reference models, blueprints, implementation playbooks, operating standards, and technology lifecycle plans.
* Translate application and business requirements into technical definitions, engineering designs, integration requirements, and implementation plans.
* Develop, document, and deliver pre-implementation and post-implementation impact analyses for technology refreshes, hardware changes, software upgrades, and application releases.
* Create and maintain platform documentation, operational procedures, workflow diagrams, reports, key performance indicators, capacity plans, and technical support materials.
* Review and develop automation solutions that reduce manual, repetitive, or inefficient processes.
* Evaluate and prototype new platform features, third-party products, subsystem technologies, and engineering strategies.
* Lead or contribute to product evaluations, on-site assessments, proofs of concept, and enterprise adoption recommendations.
* Perform software installation and maintenance activities using SMP/E and related mainframe tools.
* Apply formal change-control practices within a regulated environment.
* Coordinate with application programmers, users, infrastructure teams, security partners, software vendors, and management to identify symptoms and deliver accurate problem resolution.
* Provide technical direction, training, and mentoring to engineers, programmers, analysts, and technical support associates.
* Influence technical activities and special initiatives without necessarily having direct reports.
* Manage multiple priorities and deliver work within established commitments in a complex, rapidly changing environment.
Participate in a rotating 24x7 on-call support schedule.  

  

### **Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Seven or more years of professional experience in z/OS or mainframe systems engineering.  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Significant hands-on experience with one or more of the following:
  + z/OS installation, customization, and maintenance
  + CICS for z/OS
  + MQ for z/OS
  + zCEE for z/OS
  + Mainframe networking
  + Performance management and capacity planning
  + Storage or hardware configuration
  + Independent software vendor product installation and maintenance

* Three or more years of experience in technical or project leadership, platform road mapping, or KPI development, with demonstrated success guiding technology strategy, owning platforms, planning portfolios, and developing engineering talent.

* Advanced experience with SMP/E.
* Experience diagnosing, debugging, tuning, and resolving complex mainframe platform issues.
* Experience supporting production systems through formal change-management and incident-management processes.
* Experience creating detailed technical documentation, procedures, standards, and implementation plans.Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical information to engineers, application teams, vendors, management, and executive stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple assignments and meet committed delivery dates.
* Expert knowledge of IBM Z and related technologies, including z/OS, CICS, CICSPLEX, MQ, zCEE, DB2 for z/OS, Parallel Sysplex, Coupling Facility, and GDPS.
* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, SNA/APPN, TCP, UDP, ICMP, routing, mainframe communications, and z/OS Communications Server.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™
  
  
​​ASRC Federal Advanced Research LLC (AFAR)​ is seeking an ​Electrical Engineer​ to join our ​Next Generation Weather Radar (NEXRAD) - Hardware Engineering​ team that supports the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). This is a ​full-time​ ​on-site​ position at the ​Radar Operations Center (ROC)​ in ​Norman, OK​.
  
  
​​The NEXRAD Hardware Engineering team at the Radar Operations Center (ROC) provides comprehensive hardware support for the Weather Surveillance Radar 1988 Doppler (WSR-88D), commonly known as NEXRAD. Their specialized work ensures the reliability of the radar's physical infrastructure by resolving complex issues across various critical components, such as the transmitter, receiver, and pedestal.​
  
  
Citizenship/Permanent Residency Requirement
  
  
All candidates must have the following to pass the Federal Background Investigation and obtain the FAA Public Trust security clearance.
  
  

* Be a US Citizen.
* Has resided in the US for three (3) consecutive years.
* RealID Driver’s License/ID or current US Passport.

Relocation Requirement
  
  
Candidate must reside or be willing to relocate within a commutable distance to the ​Radar Operations Center (ROC)​ in ​Norman, OK​.
  
  
Education & Experience Requirement
  
  
All non-US Degrees must have a US Equivalency Certificate provided by the candidate at the time of application.
  

* A/An ​Bachelors (ABET)​ degree in ​Engineering or related IT field, such as Physics, Aerospace, Chemistry, Computer Science, or Mathematics.​
* Experience with NAS facilities, systems, and equipment is ​desired​.
* 3 - 6​ years of related work experience.

Required Skills
  
  

* ​​Project management, coordination, scheduling, and management of engineering changes.
* Support and maintenance of lab hardware and ongoing lab activities.
* Knowledge of Printed Circuit Board (PCB) design and troubleshooting.
* Proficient in common serial communications protocols such as RS232.
* Familiarity with hardware system design, schematics, and interconnects.
* Strong technical aptitude in electrical engineering functions.
* Ability to work in multidisciplinary engineering areas including power systems, communications, RF, analog, and digital systems.
* Skilled in using oscilloscopes, multimeters, spectrum analyzers, and signal generators for diagnosing electrical issues.​
* Ability to:
* Work independently, as well as on a team, in an agile environment.
* Research, troubleshoot and problem solve quickly.
* Learn on the job/willing to self-teach.
* Communicate effectively through verbal and written communication with high organization.

Preferred Skills
  
  

* ​​Experience with MATLAB, Simulink, SPICE (LTspice, PSpice), or similar simulation software.
* Knowledge of C/C++, Python, or PLC programming (Ladder Logic) for embedded systems and automation.
* Ability to write clear documentation, test reports, and specifications for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Familiarity with Altium Designer, Eagle, KiCad, or OrCAD.
* Oversight of electrical engineering projects from feasibility studies and cost estimation to manufacturing and deployment​.

Essential Daily Job Duties
  
  

* ​​Perform market research and evaluate needs for updating end-of-life hardware.
* Coordinate, draft, review, and edit technical reports and drawings for final approval and distribution.
* Identify needs and drive the development and implementation of major processes.
* Handle and document trouble calls from product end users.
* Run simulations and physical tests using laboratory equipment to ensure system efficiency under varied conditions.
* Perform root-cause analysis on hardware failures in harsh environments.
* Design ruggedized solutions to protect sensitive electronics.
* Ensure all technical documentation and testing meet required standards for field distribution.​

Work Environment
  
  

* Standard flexible work schedule.
* Travel is ​< 10%​.
* Cubicle environment.

We invest in the lives of our employees, both in and out of the workplace, by providing competitive pay and benefits packages. Benefits offered may include health care, dental, vision, life insurance; 401(k); education assistance; paid time off including PTO, holidays, and any other paid leave required by law. The salary offered will depend on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, internal equity, business needs, and other factors permitted by law. Posted pay ranges are a general guideline only and are not a guarantee of compensation or salary.
  
  
EEO Statement
  
ASRC Federal and its Subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, gender, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identification, national origin, religion, marital status, ancestry, citizenship, disability, protected veteran status, or any other factor prohibited by applicable law.

jobs.description:
**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**

We have an exciting Automation Engineering Supervisor opportunity in our Guymon processing facility. In this highly impactful role, you will lead a team of automation specialists who are responsible for supporting all automation equipment installations, routine preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs in a fresh pork processing facility that processes over 22,000 animals per day. This position provides oversight and supervision to ensure activities and tasks are completed and improved and maximizes department efficiencies, workflow optimization, and staffing deployment. Ensures all maintenance and preventive maintenance activities conducted by the automation team adhere to all workplace and food safety protocols.

**ABOUT US**

At Seaboard Foods, we create the most sought-after pork. A top U.S. pork producer/processor and leading exporter to 30+ countries, we are committed to bringing excellence to the table, seeking a better way to produce wholesome pork, and connecting every step between our farms and family tables. More than 5,400 employees in five states work on our farms, feed mills, and processing plant to produce Prairie Fresh® pork, ensuring the well-being of our animals, the environment, our employees, and the communities we call home. Our commitment to sustainability is reflected in our renewable gas projects on our farms creating renewable energy. Owned by Seaboard Corporation, a Fortune 500 company, and nominated as one of the “Best Places to Work” by Kansas City's Business Journal, we have a dynamic culture where our employees can contribute and understand why they matter.

* Provide technical oversight of PLC programming, HMI configurations, robotic systems, control-system modifications, and automation-related troubleshooting to ensure work is performed accurately, consistently, and in accordance with established engineering standards.
* Ensure Automation Technicians maintain accurate maintenance records, troubleshooting documentation, equipment configurations, program backups, and other technical documentation necessary to support reliable system operation and future maintenance activities.

* Maintain effective communication with plant operations, maintenance leadership, engineering personnel, and management regarding equipment conditions, maintenance priorities, operational disruptions, and corrective-action progress.

**Decision Quality & Problem Solving**

Evaluates complex equipment failures, identifies root causes, prioritizes corrective actions, and implements effective solutions to improve equipment reliability and minimize operational disruptions.

**Develops Talent & Ensures Accountability**

Leads, coaches, and develops technical personnel through clear expectations, effective work assignments, performance feedback, and ongoing training. Holds team members accountable for work quality, safety, productivity, and adherence to established procedures while promoting continuous improvement and technical excellence.

* A minimum of five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in industrial automation, electrical controls, robotics, or industrial control systems in lieu of formal technical education.
* Strong technical knowledge of industrial electrical systems, motor controls, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), human-machine

jobs.title: Data Center Controls Engineer, AMER US West Controls
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.
  
  
Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.
  
  
Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
  
  
Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
  
  
Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.
  
  
Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers.
  
  
Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholders’ management.
  
  
Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
  
  
Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.
  
  
Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
  
  
Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
  
  
Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.
  
  
Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation and/or under construction data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.
  
  
A day in the life  
As a Data Center Controls Engineer, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who depend on you to deliver reliable, well integrated Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). The problems you solve are technical: modifying controls logic to address operational issues, developing Methods of Procedure (MOPs) for firmware upgrades, or investigating complex alarm discrepancies across monitoring systems. For new builds, you own the controls scope from vendor submittal review through commissioning and turnover. You manage vendor relationships, budgets, and schedules for both service contracts and capital projects. Your internal stakeholders include your Controls Manager, Controls Technicians you provide technical direction to, and partner teams (Construction, Critical Projects Implementation, Commissioning, DCEO).
  
  
About the team  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Why AWS
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer- Electrical Engineering
jobs.description:
Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

The **Reliability Engineer (Electrical Engineering)** will lead electrical reliability, signal-integrity validation, and product qualification for cable backplane assemblies used in AI and hyperscale data centers. The role will develop scalable test strategies and automated systems, characterize high-speed channels and electrical interfaces, and identify failure mechanisms under electrical and environmental stress. In partnership with design, manufacturing, quality, and external laboratories, the engineer will drive root-cause resolution and design and process improvements. This position is based in Etters, PA or Raleigh, NC. Approximately 20% travel is expected.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop electrical reliability and validation strategies, test plans, acceptance criteria, and coverage across the product life cycle.
* Architect and validate automated electrical test systems, fixtures, breakout boards, and loopback setups for laboratory and manufacturing use.
* Characterize signal and electrical performance using TDR, VNA, BERT, oscilloscopes, source-measure units, and related equipment.
* Evaluate channel, power, ground, shielding, continuity, resistance, and dielectric performance before, during, and after environmental and accelerated-life testing.
* Apply DOE, MSA, reliability statistics, and data analysis to ensure test capability and identify degradation trends and failure thresholds.
* Lead electrical failure analysis and document results, risks, and recommendations for design, qualification, manufacturing, and customer decisions.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, electronics, or reliability engineering with an electrical focus; advanced degree preferred.
* 5+ years in electrical reliability, product validation, signal-integrity testing, or automated test-system development; interconnect experience preferred.
* Strong knowledge of circuit fundamentals, transmission lines, differential signaling, impedance, grounding, shielding, power integrity, and electrical failure mechanisms.
* Hands-on experience developing automated test systems, interpreting schematics and interconnect drawings, and troubleshooting intermittent or mixed-mode failures.
* Working knowledge of reliability statistics, DOE, MSA, sampling methods, data analysis, and cross-functional project execution.
* Ability to travel approximately 20% to manufacturing sites, laboratories, suppliers, and customer locations.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with high-speed serial channels, cable and connector validation, S-parameters, calibration, de-embedding, and simulation-to-measurement correlation.
* Automation experience using Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB, PLCs, or comparable control and data-acquisition tools.
* Experience with HALT, HASS, ALT, ORT, ESS, thermal cycling, vibration, and shock testing with in-situ electrical monitoring.
* Experience designing and validating electrical test boards, including schematics, component selection, layout review, and bring-up.
* Knowledge of AI data-center interconnects and applicable IPC, IEC, IEEE, Telcordia, or MIL-STD requirements; reliability certification is a plus.

Amphenol Corporation is proud of our reputation as an excellent employer. Our focus is to provide the highest level of support and responsiveness to both our employees and our customers, the world's largest technology companies. jobs.description:
**ABOUT FIREFLY AEROSPACE**
===========================

**Firefly Aerospace is a space and defense technology company that enables our world to launch, land, and operate in space – anywhere, anytime. As the partner of choice for critical space missions, Firefly is the only commercial company to launch a satellite to orbit with 24-hour notice and the only company to achieve a successful Moon landing. Our launch vehicles, lunar landers, and orbital vehicles provide government and commercial customers with full mission services from low Earth orbit to the Moon and beyond. Headquartered in north Austin, Texas, Firefly is looking for passionate, hardworking innovators to join our team and help fuel our successful trajectory into space.**


**SUMMARY**

In this role you will help design, develop, test, and integrate the embedded flight software for Firefly spacecraft. You will work in a group of software engineers through all stages of spacecraft software development processes and collaborate with other engineering teams.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, develop, and test embedded firmware for microcontrollers and microprocessors in bare-metal or RTOS environments.
* Architect and implement low-level drivers, communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, etc.), and system-level firmware for real-time applications.
* Collaborate with hardware engineers to define system architecture, debug hardware/firmware interactions, and ensure seamless integration.
* Optimize firmware for power efficiency, performance, and memory constraints in resource-limited embedded systems.
* Participate in code reviews, maintain high-quality code standards, and document firmware designs and processes.
* Contribute to system-level debugging, performance profiling, and validation of embedded systems.
* Optionally, support FPGA integration, including firmware interfacing with FPGA designs, or contribute to custom OS builds using tools like Yocto or Buildroot.

QUALIFICATIONS

**Required**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 5+ years of professional experience in embedded firmware development in Linux environments.

**Important:** This position is based in our **Houston, TX office near Hobby Airport**, and **both the position and interview process require candidates to be available to work and interview in our Houston office.** This is a primarily hands-on role supporting our engineering, laboratory, and manufacturing operations.

**About the Role**
------------------

Heath Consultants is seeking an experienced Senior Embedded Engineer to join our Product Engineering team. In this role, you will play a key part in the design, development, testing, and support of sophisticated **embedded electronic instrumentation and systems used in the natural gas utility industry**.

This is a hands-on engineering position for someone who enjoys working across the boundaries of **electronics, embedded firmware, instrumentation, sensing, and systems engineering**. You will have the opportunity to take products from concept and design through prototype, testing, manufacturing, and ongoing product improvement.

As an Electrical Engineer III, you will serve as an experienced technical contributor and help shape engineering decisions through sound technical judgment, hands-on problem solving, and collaboration with teams across the organization.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Hexium is modernizing Atomic Vapor Laser Isotope Separation (AVLIS) into a scalable industrial technology for domestic isotope production. We are designing and building complex systems combining high-power lasers, electro-optics, precision controls, instrumentation, and custom electronics.

Our engineers work directly on the hardware, from initial design and prototyping through integration and testing. As an Electrical Engineer, you'll build systems that are central to Hexium's technology and to critical U.S. energy and national-security supply chains.

**Role**

We're looking for an Electrical Engineer to design, build, and test the power electronics, power supplies, and control hardware behind our laser and separation technology, including high-temperature and induction heating hardware. This is a hands-on, iterative design role within our Technology Development group, with a focus on developing reliable, multi-kilowatt power systems for complex experimental environments. Beyond power systems, you'll contribute to instrumentation, diagnostics, and lab controls work across the company.

The ideal candidate has practical experience designing and testing power electronics. They're comfortable around high-voltage hardware and enjoy solving hard problems through hands-on experimentation and close collaboration with scientists and mechanical engineers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and test power electronics and power supplies, including inverters and their control and protection circuitry
* Iterate hardware from bench-scale prototypes to robust, multi-kilowatt lab systems
* Develop control, feedback, and safety interlock systems for power and thermal processes
* Evaluate, specify, and integrate commercial power equipment alongside in-house designs
* Contribute to instrumentation and diagnostics projects, including sensor signal conditioning and data acquisition (DAQ)
* Own the hardware development cycle: schematic capture, PCB layout, prototyping, bench testing, and iteration
* Work directly with scientists and mechanical engineers to turn requirements into working hardware
* Support installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of electrical and control hardware

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field (e.g., Engineering Physics, Computer Engineering)
* 3+ years of hands-on electrical hardware design experience
* Hands-on design and test experience in power electronics (inverters, motor drives, power supplies, induction heating)
* Experience with schematic capture and PCB design (Altium, KiCad, Allegro, or similar) and circuit simulation (SPICE, PLECS, or similar)
* Confident with lab test equipment (oscilloscopes, differential and current probes, power analyzers) and with iterative, trial-and-error hardware development
* Able to work safely with high-voltage equipment
* Able to work on-site in Austin, TX
* Candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance
* This role will be exposed to export-controlled information and requires compliance with applicable export control laws and regulations

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of hands-on electrical hardware design experience
* Experience with induction heating or resonant power converters (series/parallel resonant, LLC, soft switching)
* Experience with IGBT or SiC MOSFET power stages, gate drivers, magnetics design (Litz wire, matching transformers), and water-cooled power hardware
* Electromagnetic or thermal simulation (COMSOL, ANSYS Maxwell, or similar) for coil and load design
* Low-noise analog design: transimpedance or charge amplifiers, lock-in amplifiers, or ion detection and spectrometry electronics
* High-temperature measurement and control (thermocouples, pyrometers, closed-loop temperature control)
* Embedded or lab control experience (microcontrollers, PLCs, LabVIEW, or Python for DAQ)
* Background in a national lab, university research group, or hardware startup
* Currently holds an active DOE Q or DoD TS clearance

**Physical Requirements**

* Extended periods at a lab bench performing fine-motor tasks (soldering, board assembly, probing) requiring sustained hand-eye coordination and dexterity
* Ability to work near energized high-power and high-temperature equipment and in laser-controlled areas under lab safety protocols (may require laser safety training/certification and PPE use)
* Occasional lifting/carrying of test equipment up to 30 lbs
* Frequent close-vision work (component-level inspection, microscope/magnification use)

**Work Environment**

On-site role based in Austin, TX. Primarily lab-based, split between electronics benches, high-power test areas, and a controlled laser lab. This is an on-site, hands-on role with limited remote flexibility given the equipment and hardware dependencies. Work in laser-controlled areas requires lab safety training (LSO-administered), and high-power work follows Hexium's electrical safety procedures.

**Benefits**

* Stock Options
* Paid Time Off
* 401(k) Matching
* Medical, Dental, Vision insurance
* HSA & FSAs

  

**E-Verify:** Hexium Inc. participates in E-Verify. All new hires are required to complete the I-9 employment eligibility verification form and provide documentation to confirm their identity and authorization to work in the United States.

**Screening**: Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

**ABOUT FIREFLY AEROSPACE**
===========================

**Firefly Aerospace is a space and defense technology company that enables our world to launch, land, and operate in space – anywhere, anytime. As the partner of choice for critical space missions, Firefly is the only commercial company to launch a satellite to orbit with 24-hour notice and the only company to achieve a successful Moon landing. Our launch vehicles, lunar landers, and orbital vehicles provide government and commercial customers with full mission services from low Earth orbit to the Moon and beyond. Headquartered in north Austin, Texas, Firefly is looking for passionate, hardworking innovators to join our team and help fuel our successful trajectory into space.**


**About the Role**

Join Firefly's Ground Systems team as a Level III Instrumentation & Controls Engineer and become the technical authority for the systems that make launch, orbit, and landing possible. As a Level III engineer, you are the subject matter expert and technical leader. Your control architectures will span all of Firefly's test stands, test fixtures, and launch sites. Your technical decisions will influence and shape the evolution of rapidly evolving launch and in-space programs. * Design and implement PLC-based control systems for test stands, launch infrastructure, and ground support equipment

You'll own robotic cells end-to-end - from path planning and EOAT integration to commissioning and cycle-time optimization - and serve as the dedicated robotics owner the team needs as we scale. * Lead on-floor commissioning, troubleshooting, and handover of production cells.

* Familiarity with machine vision, sensors, pneumatics, and safety systems.
* Understanding of how robotics integrate with PLC/motion control (Beckhoff a plus).
* Strong troubleshooting skills on live production equipment.
* BS in Robotics, Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics Engineering, or equivalent.

### **Extra points for the following:**

* Both ABB and Fanuc programming experience.
* Offline programming / simulation (RobotStudio, Roboguide).

===========================

**Firefly Aerospace is a space and defense technology company that enables our world to launch, land, and operate in space – anywhere, anytime. As the partner of choice for critical space missions, Firefly is the only commercial company to launch a satellite to orbit with 24-hour notice and the only company to achieve a successful Moon landing. **SUMMARY**

A Firefly Electrical Engineer - Spacecraft Avionics is responsible for the design, development, and testing of avionics systems on our spacecraft. In this role, you develop the avionics systems, requirements verifications, and component/system level test campaigns. You also help developed and design the HIL system in order to verify functionality before spacecraft integration, interfacing with software, mechanical, propulsion, fluids, and structures teams to ensure the proper functionality of the integrated solution. You are responsible for developing and executing development schedules, system-level test and operations plans, and supporting launch day and on-orbit operations. * Write and execute vehicle assembly procedures and electrical system functional validation processes
* Lead high-level, functional design and development of avionics systems for the current and future spacecraft

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. Our unmatched expertise, partnership, and breadth of products allow us to fine-tune solutions that meet the specific needs of everyone from solo practitioners to larger practices. With AI-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community.

**Job Description**

Ensora Health builds software that helps therapists and clinicians run successful practices, and we’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help shape how we build it. You’ll bring deep PHP and object-oriented expertise, plus fresh ideas for using AI to change how our team designs, writes, tests, and ships code.  
  
This isn’t a maintain-the-status-quo role. We want someone who looks at how we work with PHP today, says “here’s a better way,” and then proves it. You’ll lead technical projects, work directly with leadership to define requirements, and raise the bar for the engineers around you.

**What you’ll do**

* Lead the design, build, and deployment of features and services using object-oriented principles and modern PHP practices.
* Challenge our current PHP patterns, tooling, and workflows, and champion improvements that make our code faster to ship, easier to maintain, and more secure.
* Explore and prototype new ways to use AI in our development lifecycle, such as AI-assisted code generation, refactoring, test creation, code review, and root-cause analysis. Then turn what works into repeatable team practices.
* Evaluate AI-assisted tools and set guidelines for using them responsibly, with human review, strong testing, and security standards.
* Work with leadership and product partners to define software requirements and translate business needs into sound technical plans.
* Take the lead on operational and technical projects, from scoping and estimation through delivery.
* Shape architecture decisions, designing reusable, testable components that scale.
* Diagnose and resolve complex bugs and performance issues, using logs, metrics, and traces to find root causes.
* Drive automated testing, including unit and integration tests, and improve coverage across the codebase.
* Lead by example in code reviews, give constructive feedback, and mentor engineers at every level.

jobs.title: Electronics Engineering Technician – PCB Repair & Failure Analysis
jobs.description:
**About the Position**

This position combines electronics troubleshooting, PCB repair, prototype development and manufacturing support.

You'll work directly with our engineering, production and customer support teams to diagnose electrical problems, repair boards, test new hardware and help improve the reliability of our products.

We're looking for someone who can identify the root cause of a problem, not just replace parts until something works.

This is a hands-on position in our Houston manufacturing facility, working with real hardware every day.

Key Responsibilities

**Electronics Troubleshooting & Repair**

* Diagnose and repair electronic circuit boards at the component level.
* Perform precision soldering, hot-air rework and surface-mount component replacement.
* Troubleshoot power supplies, MOSFET drivers, microcontrollers and electronic control circuits.
* Investigate intermittent electrical failures using oscilloscopes, multimeters and other diagnostic equipment.
* Support production technicians with electrical troubleshooting to minimize manufacturing downtime.

**Prototype Development & Testing**

* Assemble, modify and test prototype electronic assemblies.
* Build, modify and troubleshoot wiring harnesses.
* Program, flash and test PCBs.
* Assist engineering with new hardware development and prototype validation.
* Develop and maintain test fixtures, diagnostic tools and production test procedures.

**Failure Analysis & Quality Improvement**

* Investigate electronic failures reported by manufacturing and customer support.
* Document failure symptoms, diagnostic findings, root causes and corrective actions.
* Track recurring failures and recommend improvements.
* Perform incoming inspection and first-article testing of electronic assemblies.
* Work with engineering to verify hardware improvements and design revisions.
* Maintain clear repair documentation and troubleshooting procedures.

Required Qualifications

* At least 3 years of hands-on electronics troubleshooting, PCB repair or related experience, or equivalent technical education and practical experience.
* Strong soldering and surface-mount rework skills, including fine-pitch components.
* Experience diagnosing electronic circuits at the component level.
* Proficiency with oscilloscopes, digital multimeters and bench power supplies.
* Ability to read and interpret electronic schematics, PCB layouts and wiring diagrams.
* Experience troubleshooting switching power supplies, microcontrollers and electronic drivers.
* Familiarity with wiring harness assembly, connectors and crimping.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to document technical findings clearly and work collaboratively with engineering and manufacturing teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with embedded electronics, firmware programming or debugging.
* Familiarity with RP2040/RP2350 microcontrollers, UART, SWD or similar interfaces.
* Experience with automated testing, Python or custom test fixtures.
* Background in industrial electronics, robotics, arcade equipment, amusement devices or electronics manufacturing.
* Knowledge of electrical safety, EMI/EMC considerations and production quality testing.
* Pinball repair experience is a plus, but not required.

What We're Looking For

We want someone who enjoys getting their hands dirty, working at the bench and solving difficult technical problems.

The ideal candidate is methodical, curious and takes pride in understanding why something failed and how to prevent it from happening again.

You'll be joining a growing American manufacturer where your work has a direct impact on the products we build and the customers who enjoy them.

Position Details

* **Location:** Houston, Texas

* **Compensation:** Based on experience, with pay range confirmed during the hiring process
* **Benefits:** Details provided during the hiring process

Please submit your resume along with a brief description of a challenging electronics problem you've diagnosed and repaired.

We'd particularly like to hear about an intermittent electrical failure you successfully tracked down, how you diagnosed it and what ultimately resolved the problem.

Examples of previous electronics projects, repair work or technical documentation are welcome.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:

At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI-powered future.
  
  
AI Fearlessly.

  
  
  

Job Description:

  

LOCATION

On-site / Hybrid (Austin, TX)

  

Position Summary

TrendAI is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to lead the architectural evolution of our on-premises network security management appliance and its bridge to our cloud microservices platform. The role is anchored in the appliance backend, a mature Java codebase running on WildFly (EJBs, JPA, JMS, JAX-RS, SOAP, and REST) with MariaDB and ColumnStore data tiers. You will lead the modernization of this monolith, untangling complex subsystems and optimizing high-throughput, multi-threaded services.

This is a full-stack technical leadership role. You will deliver modern web management surfaces with React and TypeScript, and expand into companion cloud microservices built with Go and Node on AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, AWS IoT). As a Staff IC, you will own technical direction, mentor engineers across teams, and champion AI-augmented development workflows to accelerate delivery while maintaining enterprise reliability.

  

Responsibilities

1. Lead backend architecture and engineering across our flagship on-premises management appliance, evolving a large-scale Java codebase that handles distributed device configuration, policy compilation, health monitoring, and high-volume event ingestion.

2. Modernize and modularize legacy subsystems within the Java EE / WildFly monolith: refactor tight couplings into clean, testable service boundaries and well-defined internal interfaces without disrupting customer upgrade paths or operational uptime.

3. Own data tier architecture and performance across relational and analytical data stores (MariaDB, ColumnStore, RDS), including query optimization, connection pooling, transactional integrity, and automated schema migrations across release boundaries.

4. Deliver cohesive full-stack capabilities, partnering backend APIs with modern web user interfaces (React, TypeScript) to provide responsive, enterprise-grade fleet management experiences.

5. Design and evolve high-performance RESTful APIs alongside long-standing SOAP services, ensuring robust backward compatibility and interoperability between on-premises appliances, endpoints, and external management consumers.

6. Progressively architect, build, and integrate companion cloud microservices (primarily Go, alongside Node.js and Python) on AWS using event-driven and serverless architectures (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, AWS IoT) to connect on-prem appliance fleets into the broader cloud platform.

7. Investigate and resolve high-complexity distributed systems failures, concurrency issues, memory leaks, thread contention, and performance bottlenecks across the stack using JVM profilers, database query analyzers, thread/heap dumps, and Linux system telemetry.

8. Establish and champion AI-augmented software engineering practices: direct agentic coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code) on complex refactoring and feature tasks, set architectural guardrails, and mandate rigorous validation standards so AI velocity enhances codebase health.

9. Architect resilience and fault tolerance into fleet-management subsystems, including high availability (HA), failover semantics, cluster replication, and disaster recovery.

10. Author comprehensive automated test suites spanning JUnit backend unit/integration tests, Go testing packages, database test tiers, contract tests (Pact), and end-to-end browser workflows (Playwright), raising code quality across legacy and modern repositories.

11. Collaborate across organizational boundaries, partnering with architects, Product Management, QA, and Sustaining to scope technical initiatives, negotiate interface contracts, and align engineering roadmaps.

12. Mentor and elevate engineers across the organization through deep design reviews, high-leverage code reviews, architectural RFCs, and technical brownbags.

  

Qualifications

1. 8+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and maintaining enterprise-grade production software, with significant depth in backend systems.

2. Deep expertise in Java and the JVM ecosystem in large, multi-threaded, high-concurrency codebases (memory management, garbage collection tuning, thread safety, profiling).

3. Solid experience with enterprise Java architectures (WildFly or comparable application servers; Java EE / Jakarta EE technologies such as EJBs, JPA, JMS, JAX-RS).

4. Strong relational and analytical database architecture skills (MariaDB, MySQL, ColumnStore, or PostgreSQL): schema design, index optimization, complex query tuning, transaction management, and safe, zero-downtime migration strategies.

5. Proven full-stack capabilities: hands-on experience designing and implementing modern front-end applications (React, TypeScript, modern CSS/build tooling) alongside RESTful APIs.

6. Experience designing and maintaining both RESTful APIs and SOAP-based service paradigms with strict backward-compatibility guarantees.

7. Track record of successful refactoring in large, mature codebases: untangling legacy monoliths, introducing abstraction boundaries, and applying design patterns (e.g., strangler fig, clean architecture) without breaking backward compatibility.

8. Solid Linux systems programming and networking fundamentals: POSIX concepts, process lifecycle, inter-process communication, sockets, TCP/IP, and diagnostic tooling.

9. Demonstrated experience integrating agentic AI

**Job Description**  
Join the BAE Systems' team and help shape National Security as a member of the Infrastructure Management Center. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in electrical engineering, extensive project experience, and exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional team environment. They will be adept at navigating complex organizational structures, building and maintaining relationships with stakeholders across multiple departments, prioritizing tasks, and allocating resources effectively. Additionally, they will possess a strong understanding of Agile methodologies and digital tools, and be able to communicate clearly with team members, stakeholders, and customers. This role offers opportunities for career growth and development through resource sharing across multiple programs and departments, enabling critical career broadening activities.
  
  
Additional requirements:

* Work with a multi-discipline engineering team to perform plant and project engineering. Select construction materials and methods, write specifications, supervise and prepare electrical drawings, control cost, and manage work to meet project schedules.
* Perform electrical engineering analyses/calculations for one or more of the following: Medium Voltage Power Distribution systems, Sensors, AC<->DC Systems, PLC’s and Controls systems.
* Electronic panel design for small- and large-scale systems, component selection and layout (AutoCAD Electrical, Inventor, ETAP or other related software experience).
* Power calculations for low and medium voltage equipment (0-600V) (1000-35 kV). Understanding of 3 phase and single-phase equipment.
* Conduct inspections of existing electrical infrastructure for code compliance and safety.
* Support development of plans and schedules for the construction phase of projects ensuring that materials, equipment, and personnel will be available to meet project schedules.
* Ensure that work is performed in accordance with codes, specifications, and plans within cost and schedule.
* Create detailed project proposals, scopes of work, and estimates.
* Review and approve design packages from equipment suppliers and design firms.
* Execute commissioning plans and maintain documentation as needed.
* Consider safety in all aspects of work and design.
  

  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (may consider a closely related degree).
* 5 yrs technical experience (3yrs with MS) in Infrastructure electrical design and construction
* Broad electrical engineering experience in at least one of these areas: high voltage substation design, facility electrical supply, and/or electrical hardware (motor and pump) integration.
* Ability to peer review documentation such as, but not limited to: schematics, diagrams, equipment data sheets, hazard area classification drawings, and electrical analysis or studies developed by other engineers and designers.
* Working knowledge of, and ability to correctly interpret applicable codes and standards.
* Working knowledge of electrical design software (AutoCAD Electrical, ETAP, MATLAB, etc.).
* Ability to direct design teams and create required engineering documentation using Microsoft Office Suite.
* Ability to interface effectively with site operations and maintenance teams.

* Professional Engineer License

* Knowledge of Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC), Unified Facilities Guide Specification (UFGS)

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

Full-Time Salary Range: $107359 - $182510
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.

BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. jobs.title: Principal RF Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
HawkEye 360 is seeking a Principal RF Electrical Engineer and Team Lead on the Space Team. The Space Team's mission is to design, build, and test small commercial satellites that provide revolutionary RF geospatial analytics.

You will lead electrical and RF design of our space platforms, with emphasis on digital, analog, and power electronics design as well as RF payloads including Software Defined Radios (SDRs), RF front ends, and antenna systems. You'll oversee PCB design from schematic capture through layout and manufacturing while also defining and executing performance tests to verify mission requirements. You will lead a small team of RF and Electrical Engineers, providing technical guidance and mentorship while remaining hands-on with design and test activities.

This role requires strong Electrical and RF Engineering expertise, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work cross-functionally with mechanical, software, payload, and systems engineering teams.

**Your main responsibilities will be:**

* Design digital, analog, and power electronics for satellite flight hardware while overseeing team execution of schematic capture, PCB layout, RF chain design, and power subsystem development to ensure technical accuracy and on‑schedule delivery.
* Lead PCB design and layout activities with attention to RF design considerations including controlled impedance, grounding, shielding, power distribution, and signal integrity.
* Establish engineering best practices, design standards, and review processes to maintain high reliability and consistency across all hardware designs.
* Facilitate root‑cause analyses and corrective action efforts, aligning engineering teams around data‑driven problem solving for flight hardware anomalies.
* Manage task planning, delegation, and technical roadmapping to ensure the RF/EE team meets program milestones from concept through flight qualification.
* Work closely with PCB Contract Manufacturers (CMs) to ensure quality control and timely delivery of flight hardware.
* Design and develop RF payload architectures and Software Defined Radio systems for space-based RF collection missions.
* Develop test procedures and automation scripts to characterize SDR and RF front-end Performance.
* Support spacecraft integration and testing efforts, including the design of Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE), flatsats for functional testing, and satellite flight hardware testing.
* Perform first article hardware unit testing, including reception inspection, burn-in testing, thermal validation, and hardware checkouts.

**Your skills and qualifications:**  
**Essential education and experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in RF/Electrical Engineering or related field.
* 10+ years of hands-on experience designing and testing RF electronics, including SDRs, mixers, filters, amplifiers, and receiver chains.
* Expertise in PCB design and layout (Altium or similar) including schematic capture, component selection, and layout for mixed-signal and RF applications.
* Strong Understanding of power electronics, high-speed digital design, and analog circuit design.
* Strong understanding of RF fundamentals (impedance matching, S-parameters, noise figure, linearity, etc.) and software-defined radio architectures.
* Experience using lab equipment such as Spectrum Analyzers, Network Analyzers, Signal Generators, Noise Figure Analyzers, and RF test chambers.
* Hands-on flight hardware experience (satellite integration, RF lab testing, prototyping, troubleshooting).
* Experience handling ESD-sensitive components and operating in cleanroom environments.
* Strong communication skills to explain complex technical concepts to cross-functional stakeholders.
* 1+ years of technical leadership, project leadership, or team lead experience.

**Desirable:**

* Experience working in the smallsat or space industry with RF payloads or communication systems.
* Experience designing for radiation environments (TID and Proton)
* Experience with version control (git) and modern engineering workflows.
* Proficiency with Python, MATLAB, C++, or other coding languages for RF analysis and test automation.
* Experience with RF simulation tools (ADS, CST, Genesys, HFSS, Scikit-RF, Emerge, or similar) and RF modeling.
* Familiarity with CAD (NX, SolidWorks, etc.) to support electro-mechanical integration.

**Company Overview:**

HawkEye 360 is equipping defense, intelligence, and national security leaders with mission-critical signals intelligence to enable faster, better decision making. By detecting, geolocating, and characterizing radio frequency emissions worldwide, HawkEye 360 delivers trusted domain awareness and early warning indicators to the US Government and allied partners. Our space-based collection, proprietary signal processing, and AI-powered analytics transform knowledge of RF spectrum into a strategic advantage. Proven by operational mission success, HawkEye 360 is redefining how signals intelligence strengthens national and global security.

*HawkEye 360 is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.*

**Responsibilities:**

* Be INSCOM G7's primary technical expert on terrestrial sensor programs (e.g., TLS-BCT, TLS-Echelons Above Division) at GO/FO level forums, PM (Program Manager) reviews, and Joint/Army modernization working groups.
* Lead the development, drafting, and staffing of terrestrial sensor requirements documents (CDDs, ICDs) and operational concepts to influence the JCIDS process and future Army acquisitions.
* Synchronize terrestrial sensor integration with INSCOM G3 (Operations), G6 (Communications/IT), and Army Cyber Command to ensure sensor data feeds seamlessly into the wider intelligence architecture.
* Provide feasible and actionable recommendations to INSCOM G7 leadership via white papers, technical assessments, and Army Memos regarding emerging terrestrial sensing technologies, capability gaps, and material solutions.
* Oversee the alignment of terrestrial sensor systems with the Intelligence/SIGINT/Cyber enterprise, ensuring local sensor data is ingestible by advanced analytics platforms and cloud environments.

  

**Qualifications**

**Required Education:**

* Bachelors and nine (9) years or more experience; Masters and seven (7) years or more experience ; PhD or JD and four (4) years or more experience.

**Qualifications**:

* Deep technical knowledge of Army terrestrial sensing platforms, to include Tactical Land Signals Intelligence (SIGINT), Electronic Warfare (EW), Cyberspace, and electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) sensors.
* Demonstrated experience integrating terrestrial sensors into broader networks and processing systems (e.g., PM EW&C systems, DCGS-A, tactical communications fabrics, and cloud-based data lakes).
* Proven track record navigating the Army Requirements Determination, JCIDS, and Defense Acquisition System pathways specifically for intelligence or electronic sensor payloads.
* Expert understanding of tactical data dissemination, sensor-to-shooter links, and processing/analytics principles that turn raw terrestrial sensor data into combat-ready intelligence.
* Exceptional ability to translate highly complex technical specifications (e.g., frequency ranges, gain, sensor processing limitations) into plain-language mission impacts for senior military leaders.
* Capacity to independently identify capability gaps in current terrestrial fleets, evaluate emerging commercial/defense tech, and formulate mitigation strategies.

**Clearance:**

* Candidate must have an active TS/SCI clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI Poly.

Target salary range: $140,001 - $180,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.
