jobs.title: Senior Principal Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today's five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Principal Systems Engineer to join our growing team in Lanham, MD. This is a senior technical leadership role with system-level authority across multiple programs: owning system architecture, setting technical direction, resolving the most complex cross-cutting issues, and developing the next generation of systems engineering leads.

The ideal candidate brings a record of leading systems engineering on complex space or comparable programs from concept through launch and operations, is trusted by executives, customers, and engineers alike, and thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment where no two days look the same.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the technical authority for systems engineering across multiple programs, owning system architecture and technical direction from concept through verification, validation, launch, and on-orbit operations.
* Define and own system architectures and mission concepts, leading trade studies and making and defending key technical decisions in response to customer and internal needs.
* Establish top-level system requirements and govern their allocation, flow-down, and interface control across subsystems, suppliers, and organizations.
* Own technical budgets and margin philosophy (mass, power, link, thermal, schedule) at the program and constellation level, and ensure rigorous tracking across subsystems.
* Drive system-level integration across engineering disciplines (RF, software, mechanical, electrical, GNC, operations) and lead resolution of the most complex cross-cutting technical issues and anomalies.
* Provide technical leadership for proposal and business development efforts, including solution architecture, basis-of-estimate development, and cost/schedule inputs, and represent AST in technical engagements with customers and government partners.
* Serve as senior technical lead for major design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) and technical interchange meetings (TIMs), presenting to executive leadership, customers, and independent review boards.
* Lead technical risk management: identify and quantify top program and technical risks, drive mitigation, and advise leadership on risk-informed decisions.
* Define and evolve systems engineering processes, standards, practices, and drive their adoption across the organization.
* Mentor and develop SE leads and engineers, serve as a technical coach across the department, and contribute to hiring and talent growth.
  

**Qualifications**

**Education:**

Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field required; Master's degree or PhD strongly preferred

**Experience:**

A minimum of 12 years of systems engineering experience, with at least 5 years serving as SE Lead, Chief Engineer, or equivalent on a program of record or flight program, including end-to-end lifecycle experience on at least one program through launch and on-orbit operations

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in a relevant engineering discipline.
* Experience in space, satellite, or defense programs, ideally satellite communications, phased array, or RF payload systems.
* Experience establishing or leading SE practices and configuration control processes at the program or organizational level.

**Soft Skills:**

* Proven ability to lead and influence without direct authority across cross-functional teams and at the executive level.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to brief and build trust with executive, customer, and government audiences.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity: able to define the path forward and make sound decisions when requirements are incomplete or roles are fluid.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with the judgment to balance technical rigor against schedule and cost.
* Ability to manage multiple competing priorities across programs in a dynamic, fast-moving environment.
* Demonstrated mentor who builds technical talent and raises the bar for the team.
* Self-starter who takes ownership and drives issues to closure without close supervision.

**Technology Stack:**

* Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for documentation, analysis, and reporting.
* Requirements management tools: DOORS, Jama, or equivalent, with experience defining requirements management practices.
* MATLAB / Simulink for analysis and trade studies (preferred).
* Confluence and Jira for program tracking and collaboration.
* STK (Systems Tool Kit) for mission analysis (preferred).

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to work in a standard office environment and use a computer for extended periods.
* Occasional travel to other AST SpaceMobile facilities or customer/government sites (up to 20%).

*This job description may not be inclusive to the duties and responsibilities listed. Additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time or the scope of the job may change as needed by business demands**.*

AST SpaceMobile is an Equal Opportunity, at will Employer; employment is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Our Engineers have the privilege of working on complex, highly engineered machines and are involved at all stages of the aircraft life cycle, from product development to manufacturing and direct support to our airline customers. If you’re interested in designing, creating, and testing the present and future of Airbus products across the globe, join our mission to connect the world.

Nestled in the heart of the stunning Columbia River Gorge in Bingen, WA, our workplace offers innovation and the ability to contribute to game-changing solutions while enjoying the flexibility to spread your wings. Whether it's solving complex challenges, or celebrating victories, you’ll be part of a cohesive crew that thrives on innovation and the beauty that the Pacific Northwest has to offer!

* **Work/Life Balance:** Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.

* Contribute to the development of Ground Control Station (GCS) software, including user interfaces, telemetry, and mission tools
* Write reliable, maintainable, and well-documented code in C++, C, Python and/or MATLAB

* Implement and test communication protocols such as UART, CAN, TCP/IP, UDP, and serial
* Design, develop and support software tools for UAV system configuration
* Develop software modules and system services targeting embedded Linux platforms, including process management, device interfaces, and inter-process communication

**Testing & Integration (~20%)**

* Support testing and debugging in both lab environments and during field flight tests
* Collaborate with hardware, electrical, and systems engineers to bring up and integrate new UAV platforms

**Documentation & Architecture (~10%)**

* Document internal designs, software architecture, and interfaces to support maintainability and team alignment

**Support & Maintenance (~10%)**

* Maintain and support existing embedded and ground control software
* Support software tools for UAV system configuration

* Stay current with UAV industry developments and continuously grow your skillset
* Collaborating with other software developers
* Regularly report on activities and progress

* 2+ years of experience in embedded software development, either through industry roles or substantial project work
* Experience with C++.
* Experience with Python.
* Familiarity with embedded Linux or real-time operating systems (RTOS)
* Exposure to UAV flight control concepts, sensor integration, or telemetry systems
* Experience using Git and development tools such as Gitlab or similar
* Strong focus on writing clean, well-documented code with an emphasis on maintainability
* Familiarity with modern UI software architecture and development practices (e.g., Qt, PyQt, or similar frameworks)
* Able to work legally in the US (valid work visa and work authorization)

**Preferred Education/Skills:**

* M.S in Embedded System Engineering, Software Engineering, Control System Engineering
* Experience with UAV autopilot software

* Awareness of aerospace safety standards or robust software validation practices

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to grow the ability to deploy new offerings and HW infrastructure on time, in high volume with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance.

The Silicon and Cloud Hardware Infrastructure Engineering Firmware Development team is responsible for design and development of Server and Rack Infrastructure Firmware for Microsoft's online services. We work closely with Microsoft product groups, industry partners and researchers to architect and develop server hardware solutions that meet the requirements for our cloud services platforms at the lowest possible cost of ownership (TCO). We need to be willing to lean into uncertainty, take risks and move quickly when we make mistakes, recognizing failure happens along the way to mastery. #azurehwjobs #SCHIE #schiefwcoe

**Qualifications**

* Doctorate in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 3+ years technical engineering experience OR Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience OR equivalent experience.

**Other Qualifications:**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* BS or MS in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent industry experience.
* 10+ years of professional experience in design/development, integration, validation, or system level debugging in embedded systems.
* Experience utilizing programing in Python or C or C++
* Demonstrated experience in system level debug and validation (including validation infrastructure setup) for complext embedded systems (Boards, FPGA, Emulation, Simulation etc.).

* Familiarity with silicon bring-up and validation flows.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Google manages one of the largest data center infrastructures in the world and continues to expand at an incredible pace, meeting increased demand for ML training and inference hardware. Our team's mission is to provide the optimal global data center demand and supply plans for Google and ensure adequate data center capacity for customers, enabling the fleet to keep up with the incredible scale of internal and external ML demand. We measure our success in the gigawatts, and every decision & software optimization we make has massive impact for the company.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III - Backend & Data Systems (AI Solutions)
jobs.description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

**About the Role**
------------------

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations — which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance — supporting Manufacturing and Supply Chain across all Blue Origin facilities. You will sit on the software team within Operations that builds tools in direct support of our Manufacturing Engineers.

We are returning humankind to the Moon, and Blue Origin's Manufacturing Engineers build the hardware that gets us there. On our small AI Solutions team, you will own the backend and data layer behind the tools a 100+ person Manufacturing Engineering organization depends on. Several enterprise systems describe the same products from different angles, and they do not always agree. Your work turns that into one trusted picture of the product: the data models, integrations, and APIs our applications and AI features are built on. This is a systems-design role at its core, and the best engineers here also make a point of understanding the people they build for, so you will spend time on the floor with Manufacturing Engineers to learn the work before building for it.

  

**Special Mentions**
--------------------

* Shifts: 1st | Mon–Fri (8am–5pm)
* Location: Renton, WA (fully onsite / "work from work," co-located with the Manufacturing Engineering organization and production floor)
Relocation: Available  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the backend services, APIs, and data models behind the tools our team builds, primarily in Python, holding the technical-design and code-review bar as they grow.
* Build integrations that bring product data together from our enterprise systems, reconciling sources that describe the same things in different ways.
* Improve, harden, and modernize existing applications — not just greenfield work — including auth, data integrity, testing, and technical debt.
* Shape our product data so AI features can actually use it: structure, naming, and context a model can navigate reliably — plus human-in-the-loop safeguards and the evaluations that show whether those features are working.
* Deploy and operate the team's services on our cloud infrastructure (AWS), including CI/CD, monitoring, day-to-day reliability, and a share of on-call.
* Spend time with Manufacturing Engineers to learn how their work actually flows, and use data to validate that what you ship is actually helping the engineers who use it.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production backend services
* Strong backend and API development in Python or a comparable language (REST and/or GraphQL), including interfaces that applications and AI agents both build on
* Depth in relational data modeling and SQL — changing a schema and migrating data in production without breaking the applications built on it
* Experience integrating multiple systems of record: reconciling identifiers, handling incomplete or inconsistent data, and building pipelines that recover cleanly from partial failure
* Hands-on experience deploying and running applications on AWS and containerized infrastructure
* Comfortable integrating LLMs into products, with judgment about what data a model can actually work with and whether an AI-assisted system is genuinely working — designing evaluations, questioning flattering results, and reviewing AI-generated code for correctness
Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration; able to work directly with non-technical users to turn their needs into working software  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience designing a shared data model or service that multiple applications depend on
* Experience preparing data for retrieval or agentic use, where the data's shape rather than the prompt was what made it work
* Experience modeling complex hierarchical data, such as product structures or bills of materials
* Experience connecting documents and engineering artifacts into structured workflows
* Prior experience building software in, or in direct support of, a manufacturing, aerospace, hardware production, or operations environment
* Familiarity with manufacturing execution systems (MES), work-order/work-instruction authoring systems, or PLM — or a demonstrated habit of learning a domain deeply before building for it
* Experience building internal tools that other engineers or operators actually adopted
Experience with lakehouse and analytics platforms (e.g., Databricks, Spark SQL)  

  
  

Base Pay Range for:

WA applicants is $164,652.00 - $230,512.80

**Other site ranges may differ**

  

**Culture Statement**

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Working within project teams and established software standards, the role focuses on writing clean, maintainable machine software on challenging, diverse projects.

Below are additional duties and responsibilities:

* Execute the software design, development, and debug of multi-station automated assembly and test systems
* Design, structure, and develop PLC application code on Rockwell (Studio 5000), Beckhoff (TwinCAT) or similar - clean, modular, reusable, and well-documented

* Develop software design specifications from requirements

**Job Description**

We have an exciting opportunity for a **Lead Software Engineer** at UL Research Institutes , within our Digital Safety Research Institute (DSRI) . Th is is a REMOTE opportunity

The **Lead Software Engineer** is a major contributor to the development and maintenance of complex software systems of Digital Safety. The Lead Software Engineer provides technical guidance, mentorship, and leadership to the team while collaborating with stakeholders to deliver high-quality software solutions.

**UL** **Research Institute** **s:**

At UL Research Institutes (ULRI) , we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge.

**Digital Safety Research Institute:**

The Digital Safety Research Institute (DSRI) addresses unresolved safety risks and emerging dangers in the world’s digital ecosystem. We aim to help protect people from unwanted access to personal devices and privacy, algorithms , and disinformation threats by working to create a new digital safety ecosystem.

DSRI is committed to sharing digital safety insights, collaborating with key stakeholders, and offering extensive outreach and education to help support safer digital environments for people everywhere.

**What** **you’ll** **learn** **and** **achieve:**

As the **Lead Software** **Engineer,** you will play a key role in the rapid growth of UL as you:

* Lead, define, and develop full-stack software systems and platforms that enable large-scale research, evaluation, and dissemination of safety insights

* Implement service boundaries, data model evolution, integration patterns between our platforms, and the pipelines and evaluation frameworks they feed

* Set technical direction across projects, aligning architecture and data frameworks with DSRI’s evolving research priorities and the broader AI evaluation ecosystem

* Iterative design of complex, ambiguous, cross-cutting systems where the problem isn’t fully understood

* Ensure consistency in engineering practices and set the standard for AI-assisted engineering on the team, including the use of Claude Code on large refactors, greenfield work, and adopted code from external organizations; developing patterns and documentation to accelerate software engineering.

* Provide feedback to teams using AI coding tools in a dangerous, inappropriate, or inefficient way.

* Provide guidance and informal mentorship to junior engineers to support skill development and knowledge sharing.

* Foster a collaborative and positive work environment, promote knowledge sharing and professional growth within the team.

* Assist in hiring, onboarding, and training new software engineers, ensuring a smooth integration into the team.

* Represent technical work across the organization and in select external settings

* Contribute to and/or lead other department specific and cross-functional initiatives.

**What makes you a great fit:**

**While no one candidate will embody every quality, the successful candidate will bring many of the following professional competencies and personal attributes** **:**

* Deep expertise in software engineering, applied across the systems that support research and data-driven analysis (i.e., React in production at meaningful scale or complexity, Python services, async patterns, careful data handling, sensible API design, PostgreSQL, designing and implementing complex data structures, and working knowledge of the systems layer underneath, including containers, deployment, and observability).

* Architectural judgment built on real experience (i.e., able to make choices from experience and articulate trade-offs, and able to know when not to introduce a new service, abstraction, or dependency).

* Sophisticated use of AI coding tools, including integrating Claude Code or similar tools into substantial, non-trivial work and the ability to structure context, decompose problems, review generated code, and recover when the tools do not function properly.

The engineer will work on automation projects ranging from equipment upgrades and control panel design to complete industrial automation.

Optivolt’s mission is to overshoot humanity’s energy supply by reimagining solar.

America is at an inflection point. We need reliable energy fast. The grid is aging. And solar, the only technology that deploys quickly enough, is still constrained by technology frozen in time.

To close this gap, we build intelligent solar systems that think and adapt to real world conditions. Optivolt solar systems understand the sun, the weather, shading, harsh conditions, and optimize energy flow in real time. Every Optivolt panel is designed with an aerospace power electronics brain sealed inside to make solar more powerful and cost effective than ever in any condition.

The next step is putting it everywhere. In the home as Optivolt Home Solar and in the field as Optivolt Solar Fields. Hyper performant, controllable, reliable solar that works for everyone, everywhere.

Optivolt is a team of some of the best builders and doers in the world, drawing from incredible talent pools in aerospace, electrical engineering, design-led organizations. We ultimately will win by designing and building the world’s best solar energy products.

But chiefly important, our organization is a lab for those devoted to solving some of the toughest problems in energy. Everyone is expected to contribute to the mission meaningfully. Clear communication, rapid iteration, and strong work ethic is the floor for anyone on our team.

To date we’ve shipped over 20,000 units and have companies worth billions of dollars relying on our solar architecture.

**Why we are looking for you**
------------------------------

As an Electrical Engineer at Optivolt, you will design and develop the hardware systems that power, control, and connect our intelligent solar products. You will work across embedded electronics, system architecture, communications, sensing, and power management, including our Hub, which coordinates and controls distributed power electronics systems.

This is a hands-on role with significant ownership. You will design, build, test, debug, and iterate on real hardware, working closely with firmware, mechanical, test, and manufacturing teams to bring products from concept through production.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* **Own the electronics behind our Hub.** Design embedded control boards, communications interfaces, sensing circuits, and power-management hardware.
* **Design the system, not just the board.** Own Hub electrical architecture, including microcontrollers, connectivity, battery and power supply interfaces, and controls interfaces to distributed devices.
* **Take designs from schematic to working hardware.** Develop schematics, select components, lay out PCBs, and lead hardware design reviews.
* **Make our devices communicate reliably.** Integrate wired and wireless communications, including PLC, Bluetooth, and other relevant protocols.
* **Get hands-on in the lab.** Bring up and debug prototypes; investigate hardware, firmware, and system-level faults.
* **Make thoughtful design tradeoffs.** Optimize for low power, reliability, thermal performance, cost, and manufacturability.
* **Work closely with firmware.** Collaborate with firmware and software engineers on interfaces, controls, telemetry, and system integration.
* **Prove the hardware is ready for the field.** Develop validation procedures and support environmental testing, certification, and manufacturing ramp.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* **You have shipped hardware.** 3+ years of hands-on electrical engineering experience developing physical hardware products.
* **You know your circuit fundamentals.** Strong analog and digital circuit fundamentals, embedded electronics, and PCB design experience.
* **You understand embedded electronics.** Experience with microcontrollers, communications interfaces, and power-management circuits.
* **You can own a PCB design.** Proficiency in schematic capture and PCB tools such as Altium.
* **You are comfortable at the bench.** Comfort with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power supplies, and board bring-up.
* **You understand how devices communicate.** Knowledge of UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet, or similar interfaces.
* **You follow through from design to validation.** Ability to independently deliver validated hardware from requirements through prototype.

**Preferred skills**
--------------------

* **Experience with PLC, Bluetooth, wireless or** IoT hardware.
* **Experience with battery-powered,** low-power, or self-powered systems.
* **Familiarity with solar,** energy storage, and distributed energy controls.
* **Experience with outdoor electronics,** EMC/EMI, and high-volume production.

**Additional requirements**
---------------------------

* Willingness to work extended hours as needed to support critical milestones
* Everyone at Optivolt is required to participate in on call support for customers
* Must be based in San Francisco, CA

**Pay and benefits**
--------------------

The estimated starting base salary range for this role is $150K-210K depending on level, location and experience, plus a generous pre-IPO equity package

Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, unlimited PTO, plus extra fun perks!

**Summary:**

**What to Expect**

The Tesla Energy Device Software team is looking for a Software Engineer to design and maintain the internal tooling and simulation infrastructure that lets residential energy firmware teams move faster with higher confidence. You will work across Powerwall, Backup Gateway, Wall Connector, and related home energy products—building Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) environments that approach real-world behavior, and the visualization and debugging tools that make complex multi-process systems understandable.

Device software is only as good as the feedback loop around it. Our goal is tooling that shortens the path from idea to validated behavior: high-fidelity SIL, field-trace capture and replay, rich reports and dashboards, control-flow and system visibility, and extensible instrumentation (traces, hooks, probes). As products, revisions, capabilities, and regional variants grow—including market-specific configurations such as external companion hardware—you will regularly extend the platform so new and existing products can be brought into the same validation and debugging workflow.

 **What You'll Do**

* Design, implement, and maintain internal SIL, harness, and developer tooling (primarily Python and Go) that improves correctness, debuggability, and release confidence for residential energy device software
* Build and evolve close-to-real-life SIL environments for multi-process embedded Linux systems; close gaps between simulation and field behavior where they matter most
* Develop visualization and debugging tools—including report generation, SIL-driven dashboards, control-flow visualization, and related analysis views—so engineers can understand system behavior without spelunking logs alone
* Implement and support trace/hook/instrumentation systems that reach into device software (Go, Rust, C/C++); enable capture of traces in the field and faithful replay in SIL

Company Overview:

Imagine an air taxi that takes-off vertically and quietly, carries you and your fellow passengers across the city streets below, bringing you to the people and places you want to spend time with via the uncongested electric sky. Since 2009, our team has worked steadily to make this dream a reality. We’ve designed and tested many generations of prototype aircraft capable of serving in the urban environment. We’re looking for talented, committed individuals to join our team as we push toward certifying the Joby aircraft, scaling our manufacturing, and launching our initial commercial service.

Overview:

As a Flight Control Systems Engineer, you will be implementing and improving the flight control algorithm, running simulations and analysis to validate control law design, drafting tests to verify system level behavior in labs and on-aircraft. You will work alongside the system test team to debug and verify system performance and failure handling. You will help certification engineers draft and manage requirements and review test cases and procedures. You will work with the modeling team to create simulations and analysis frameworks for collecting and presenting critical design data. You will collaborate with the Aircraft, Safety, Avionics, Loads, Performance, and Rotor Dynamics teams to identify deficiencies and refine the aircraft design. You will work with test pilots to define desirable handling and flying characteristics, participate in mission planning, scenario simulations, and provide in-person support during envelope expansion flight testing. You will work with software engineers to ensure relevant tests are run and relevant artifacts are produced, stored, and linked.

  
Responsibilities:

* Simulation and analysis of aircraft responses
* Development and implementation of flight control features
* Data review from flight test and other testing platforms
* Test case authorship
* Tool development and continuous integration improvement
* Requirement authorship and management

Required:

* B.S. + 3 years of experience, or M.S. in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, computer science, or a related field

* Knowledge in multi-body dynamics, aerodynamics, and electrical powertrain

***Job Title: Senior Specialist, Electrical Engineer- Mixed-Signal DSP Hardware Engineer***

***Job Code: 46257***  
***Job Location: San Diego, CA***  
***Job Schedule: 9/80 1st Shift***

**Job Description:**

L3Harris is seeking a Senior Hardware Engineer to develop mixed-signal, high-speed digital, and DSP-oriented hardware for Tracking, Telemetry, and Command products used in airborne and space-based electronic systems. The role includes architecture, detailed design, verification, troubleshooting, integration, and production support for converter-based receiver, transmitter, direct-conversion, and modem subsystems incorporating high-speed ADCs, DACs, AFEs, PLLs, clock distribution, FPGA or ASIC interfaces, power supplies, and GHz-class signal interfaces. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in timing, synchronization, throughput, signal integrity, power integrity, noise performance, and hardware/software partitioning across modem and signal-processing systems.

**Essential Functions:**

* Lead the design and development of mixed-signal, high-speed digital, and DSP hardware for advanced electronic systems, including receiver, transmitter, direct-conversion, and modem signal chains, with responsibility for architecture, schematic capture, component selection, derating, worst-case analysis, and hardware documentation.
* Design hardware that supports or implements DSP functions, including high-speed digital data paths, converter interfaces, synchronization, and throughput-critical processing chains, and optimize digital hardware platforms used to execute, accelerate, or interface with DSP algorithms.
* Guide PCB layout and board-level implementation for high-speed mixed-signal designs, including stack-up definition, placement, controlled impedance, grounding, isolation, power distribution, and design considerations for signal integrity, power integrity, dynamic range, jitter, phase noise, and overall noise performance.
* Conduct trade studies, simulations, hardware bring-up, debugging, design verification, and troubleshooting to the component level to support architecture selection, clocking strategy, hardware/software partitioning, and product performance through integration, test, manufacturing, and production.
* Collaborate closely with FPGA, ASIC, RF, DSP, software, systems, mechanical, and manufacturing engineering teams, and provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior engineers.

* Strong understanding of direct-conversion, modem, and related communications and signal-processing architectures, including timing, synchronization, clocking, throughput, and converter interfaces such as JESD204.
* Experience optimizing hardware platforms for DSP algorithms and working at the hardware/software boundary, including partitioning functions across hardware, programmable logic, embedded processing, and software-defined modem implementations.
* Experience with signal integrity, power integrity, low-noise power design, and GHz-class board-level implementation, including design and implementation of point-of-load power supplies for FPGAs, ADCs, DACs, AFEs, and other high-performance devices.
* Familiarity with RF principles as applied to converter-based and high-frequency modem systems.
* Experience with schematic capture, design analysis, laboratory debug, and design verification testing.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering environment.
* Experience with direct RF sampling, integrated AFEs, modern converter-based system architectures, PLLs, synthesizers, jitter-cleaning clocks, clock buffering, and phase-coherent timing systems.
* Experience with SI/PI simulation, PCB layout guidance for high-speed mixed-signal hardware, and familiarity with performance metrics such as EVM, SNR, SFDR, ENOB, phase noise, I/Q imbalance, and LO leakage.
* Experience with RF and high-frequency modem architecture, DSP integration, partitioning of functions between hardware, FPGA or ASIC resources, firmware, and software, and modem implementation as part of a complete communications subsystem.
* Experience supporting high-reliability, military, or aerospace hardware development.

new_jobs.title: Hardware Engineer, Precision Instrumentation
new_jobs.description:
**About Astera**
----------------

Astera is a private foundation on a mission to steer science and technology toward a better future. We believe the coming years will bring an era of unprecedented scientific and technological advancement as exponential progress in AI converges with central advances in other fields to accelerate innovation. This inflection point provides an unparalleled opportunity to fundamentally rethink the institutions, systems, and tools that drive progress. We have committed a $3.5B endowment to that work and fit the form of our support to the function it serves: grants, investments, and in-house research programs. We accept meaningful risk in the research we back and expect some of it to fail because transformative ideas are rarely the ones already proven. Our projects, and the foundation itself, operate like high-velocity startups, with a high performance bar and competitive compensation to match. We are searching for leaders who are compelled by the challenge of driving high-impact change in the way science is funded, conducted, and communicated. You can read more about our mission, vision, and programming at astera.org/vision.

**Company Overview**
--------------------

Astera Neuro seeks to understand and engineer consciousness. We believe consciousness is the process by which the brain builds a coherent internal model of the world and the self. We aim to understand this model and to develop the technologies to write experience directly into the brain. By combining large-scale neural recording, causal perturbation, and brain-based AI, we seek to move neuroscience from observing correlates of experience to engineering it. The same tools carry direct therapeutic promise for neurological and psychiatric diseases that alter perception, thought, and sense of self. Because the science and tools required do not yet exist, we are assembling a founding team of neuroscientists, theorists, and engineers to create them. We do high-risk, high-reward science in a well-resourced, collaborative environment with competitive pay, and share everything openly under Astera's Open Science Policy.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

As a Hardware Engineer, you will design and build the physical systems our experiments depend on, most of which don't exist commercially. Working directly with scientists, you will take a project from a well-specified plan or a rough idea through design, fabrication, and iteration until it works for the experiment. The work crosses mechanical design, fabrication, electronics, and optics, often within a single project.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Design precision mechanical systems for experiments, such as titanium microfixtures, micrometer-precision electrode drives, and custom machined jigs.
* Build components for custom microscopes and optical systems, including alignment and mounting hardware.
* Design and iterate custom laboratory instrumentation and surgical or experimental robotics alongside the scientists who depend on them.
* Develop electronics and control hardware that interface mechanical systems with data acquisition and the rest of the research stack.
* Help build the design and prototyping facility itself — the tooling, workflows, and fabrication capabilities that determine how fast the team can move.

**Who You Are**
---------------

***Required:***

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in mechanical, electrical, or biomedical engineering, physics, or a related field, with a track record of building precision hardware in a high-precision industry (e.g., medical devices, robotics, aerospace, semiconductor capital equipment, or commercial scientific instrumentation).
* Experience designing and building hardware that other people relied on for real work, and keeping it running.
* Resourcefulness about getting things built quickly: comfortable machining one part, 3D-printing the next, and outsourcing what's better made elsewhere.
* Comfort working from a rough idea rather than a finished spec, figuring out the path to a working instrument together with the people who need it.
* Deep fundamentals in mechanical design and fabrication, with real working ability in electronics or optics; you do not restrict yourself to what is familiar.
* Intellectual curiosity, collaborative instincts, and eagerness to learn the science around you.
* A track record of owning complex instruments end-to-end, from concept through fabrication, integration, and reliable operation.
* Experience making and defending design tradeoffs across performance, manufacturability, cost, and timeline.
* Experience equipping and running a workshop, makerspace, or prototyping facility.

***Preferred/Nice to Have:***

* Experience with small precise parts, difficult materials, tight tolerances, precision motion, or optical alignment.
* Hands-on electronics design experience (PCB layout, embedded systems, sensor/actuator integration).
* Familiarity with electrophysiology or other low-volume, high-complexity hardware environments.
* CAD/CAM proficiency with hands-on machining (CNC, lathe, mill) and 3D printing.
* Experience integrating hardware with data acquisition systems (DAQ, TTL synchronization, serial/SPI protocols).

**Why Join Us**
---------------

Join a founding-caliber hardware team building instruments that don't exist anywhere else, in service of understanding how the brain works. You'll own complex builds end-to-end, work shoulder-to-shoulder with the scientists who use what you make, and help shape the engineering culture, tools, and standards of our design and prototyping facility as the team grows.

*Astera Neuro provides a comprehensive benefits package and total compensation that is competitive and commensurate with the level of experience and qualifications.*

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity and inclusion!*

Compensation Range: $200K - $300K

**Who we are**

Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America's drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment.

As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We're hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years.

**What you will be doing**

As an Electrical Engineer III, Design Assurance at Neros, you will bring up, characterize, and validate the circuit boards that go into our next generation airside and groundside platforms. You will write and run test plans, contribute to worst-case circuit analysis from schematic through bench validation, and design the fixtures and automated test setups behind that work. You will work with design engineers during product development to get results back into the design.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Bring up, characterize, and validate new circuit boards against requirements
* Contribute to worst-case circuit analysis, from schematic-level calculations and simulation through post-layout checks and bench validation, feeding measured results back into the analysis
* Write and execute test plans, procedures, and reports
* Design and build test fixtures, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) setups, and automated test scripts
* Run qualification and reliability testing, including thermal, vibration, and HALT/HASS, and support root-cause analysis on failures
* Provide design-for-test (DFT) input to design engineers during product development

**You should have the following:**

* 4+ years of experience in electrical hardware engineering, with hands-on bench validation of circuit boards
* Board bring-up and characterization experience, including writing your own test plans and reports
* Proficiency with bench instrumentation: oscilloscopes, logic and protocol analyzers, power supplies, electronic loads, DMMs, and spectrum analyzers
* Board-level design experience: schematics and PCBs you designed yourself. Test fixtures and test boards count
* Circuit analysis across analog, digital, and power supply circuits, including hand calculations, tolerance analysis, and SPICE simulation (LTspice or similar)
* Test automation and data analysis in Python or similar
* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related field

**Nice to have:**

* Signal and power integrity simulation (HyperLynx, SIwave, or similar) and bench measurement (TDR, VNA, eye diagrams)
* Hands-on WCCA and component derating on production hardware
* Previous HALT/HASS, environmental, or EMC pre-compliance testing experience
* Production test development with a contract manufacturer
* Background in UAV, aerospace, automotive, defense, or medical device hardware

$136,500 - $191,500 USD

Roblox's data infrastructure processes petabytes of data daily, powering analytics, ML, and product decisions for a platform serving 200M+ daily active users. Our team directly owns and operates **StarRocks** and **Apache Druid**, driving high-throughput streaming ingestion and low-latency MPP query processing. * **Architect Streaming Ingestion Pipelines**: Design, build, and optimize real-time data ingestion paths leveraging **Apache Kafka**, **Apache Flink** and native engine load mechanisms.

* **Advance Autonomous Interfaces**: Integrate AI/ML and LLM-driven capabilities within our query platforms to enable automated self-serve mechanisms and intelligent data discovery for engineers.

* **Streaming & Ingestion Architecture**: Proven track record implementing high-volume streaming ingestion using **Apache Kafka**, **Apache Flink**, Routine Load / Broker Load, or Debezium/CDC pipelines.

* Software Literacy: Practical familiarity with Python with the ability to review code, understand system/software interfaces, and collaborate closely with software developers.

* Experience mapping formal requirements to software test cases or verification matrices.

* Write technical documentation for the design and use of equipment

* Proficiency in Python is required, knowledge of programming languages and fieldbus protocols such as the following: PLC programming, TCP/IP, MQTT, IIoT, Modbus, RS232, SCADA, Motion Control.
* Experience with electrical, software, and/or mechanical systems. Familiarity with manufacturing processes or quality control systems
* Strong communication and data presentation skills, with the ability to effectively communicate data through text, graphics, and images to audiences of all experience levels. Experience with data visualization tools or with HMI (Human Machine Interface) development.
* Familiarity with computer vision systems and image processing, and experience with industrial automation environments, understanding of industrial networking protocols

### **Company Description**

**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

### **Job Description**

We have an opening for a **Software Engineer** to design, build, and operate secure applications and platforms that help scientists and engineers manage and analyze mission critical data. You will own software across its lifecycle - from architecture and implementation through testing, deployment, and operations - while modernizing existing systems and creating reusable capabilities for multiple LLNL programs.

The work spans Python services and REST APIs, modern web interfaces, containerized deployments, scientific visualization, databases, and CI/CD automation. You will partner with scientists, data engineers, and application teams to translate complex workflows into reliable, maintainable software. This is an opportunity to exercise broad technical ownership, influence architecture, and see your work directly support national security missions.

You will join a collaborative software engineering team and work across organizational boundaries on shared tools, standards, and integration approaches. Because some work occurs in secure environments, this position requires an on-site presence approximately three to four days per week. This position is in the Applications, Simulations, and Quality Division (ASQ) within the Computing Directorate, supporting Strategic Deterrence application and data management programs.

This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities and qualifications will apply if hired at the higher level.

* Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain secure software applications and services supporting scientific and engineering workflows.
* Own features and technical improvements across the software lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through implementation, documentation, release, and operational support.
* Design and implement well-documented REST APIs, including appropriate approaches to data modeling, authentication, authorization, versioning, and error handling.
* Develop usable web interfaces and scientific visualization capabilities using modern frameworks and libraries.
* Build, deploy, and troubleshoot containerized applications, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, observability, and deployment automation.

* Perform other duties as assigned.

BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems (SMS) is seeking a Lead Systems Engineer to provide Element-level systems engineering leadership for advanced technological system development. This position is for an experienced individual who can work in and lead a multi-disciplinary team through every stage of program’s lifecycle to develop, maintain, verify and communicate the technical baseline for a program or part of a program that includes Segment, Element. and/or Subsystems level ownership. You’ll coordinate with Customers, the Program Management Office, the Chief Systems Engineer, the Chief Engineer and other engineering disciplines, suppliers, and partners as applicable to lead the architectural development, technical integration, and verification of space systems and their associated ground and launch systems as necessary.
  
  
The Engineering, Science and Analysis (ESA) Strategic Capabilities Unit comprises the technical talent and organizational leadership that enables the successful delivery of high-impact discriminating technologies for our customers’ missions. Our collaborative, cross-functional teams are committed to innovation, integrity, continual learning and strong execution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**

* The Lead Systems Engineer is the authority for the technical requirements baseline of a program and will supervise and lead a team of Systems Engineers to define mission objectives, identify stakeholders, and establish system architecture during the development, design, integration, and V&V of a mission.
* Work with Engineering Management and the PMO to manage the staffing assignments for a team of Systems Engineers.
* Work closely together with the PMO and CSE to balance technical performance with programmatic constraints.
* Provide systems engineering leadership of technical teams in the development, verification, delivery, and operations of Segments, Elements, and Subsystems of space-based missions.
* Support the proper allocation, traceability, and verification of requirements at all levels through the lifecycle of the program.

* Use Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) for architecture to requirements traceability and interface development in coordination with Customers
* Own the System-level technical budgets.
* Mentor other system engineers assigned to the team.
* Support the program Risk & Opportunity Management and ERB processes.
* Prepare and give presentations to peers, management, and customers.
* Maintain a regular and predictable work schedule.
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships within the department, the Strategic Business Units, Strategic Capabilities Units and the Company. Interact appropriately with others in order to maintain a positive and productive work environment.
* Perform other duties as necessary.

**Working Conditions:**

* Work is performed in an office, laboratory, production floor, or cleanroom, outdoors or remote research environment.
* May occasionally work in production work centers where use of protective equipment and gear is required.
* May access other facilities in various weather conditions.
  

  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* BS degree or higher in Engineering or a related technical field is required plus 6 or more years related experience.
* Each higher-level degree, i.e., Master’s Degree or Ph.D., may substitute for two years of experience. Related technical experience may be considered in lieu of education. Degree must be from a university, college, or school which is accredited by an agency recognized by the US Secretary of Education, US Department of Education.
* A current, active TS/SCI security clearance is required with ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI Polygraph.
* Experience using requirements database tools (DOORS, Jama, Cameo Requirements Modeler, e.g.)
* Experience with Cameo Enterprise Architecture, SysML and DoDAF/UAF/UPDM.
* Demonstrated ability to manage effective and verifiable requirements – detail oriented.

Join Foxtronics — Where Precision Meets Opportunity

Are you looking to build your career with a company that truly values its employees and rewards excellence? At Foxtronics, we don’t just offer jobs—we provide opportunities for growth, stability, and meaningful work. ***\*Must be a U.S. Citizen or Green Card Holder in compliance with*** ***U.S. ITAR regulations.***

Who We Are

Founded in 1989, Foxtronics is a full-service electronic manufacturing services (‘EMS”) platform serving middle-market OEM’s across a variety of industries, including ag-tech, medical devices, industrial and aerospace sectors.

Why Work With Us?

At Foxtronics, our people are our greatest asset. We are committed to creating an environment where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to succeed.

We Offer

* Competitive compensation that reflects your skills and contributions
* Comprehensive benefits designed to support your health and well-being: Foxtronics pays the majority of the premiums for health, dental and vision insurance and provides 401k with a match and generous paid time off
* A collaborative, team-focused culture
* Opportunities for career growth and professional development
* The chance to work with cutting-edge manufacturing technology

We are seeking a detail-oriented Electrical Engineer to support our electronics manufacturing and engineering teams at three locations: Milford, CT; Windsor CT; and Jacksonville, IL.

This role focuses on troubleshooting, testing, and validating electrical assemblies and systems. The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of electrical and electronic principles, hands-on lab experience, and the ability to analyze and resolve technical issues in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Responsibilities:**

* Perform testing, troubleshooting, and validation of electronic assemblies and PCBs to ensure functionality and reliability.
* Work extensively with microcontroller-based systems (8-bit to 32-bit) and peripherals including RTC, Timers, ADC, DAC, PWM, Interrupts, DMA, Capture/Compare, and UART.
* Program and configure C compilers, work with and without RTOS environments, and interface with USB, TCP/IP, CAN, and Modbus RTU communication stacks.
* Support design-for-manufacturing activities, including PCB layout review (2–6 layers), component placement, and high-current/high-voltage considerations.
* Operate and maintain engineering pick-and-place equipment, including loading components, adjusting for odd shapes, and verifying placement accuracy.
* Perform fine-pitch SMT soldering and rework down to 0402 components using both leaded and lead-free solder.
* Assemble, test, and debug prototypes and pre-production units, ensuring alignment with engineering requirements.
* Develop and build test jigs, simulators, and fixtures, including wiring schematics, panel layouts, and safe use of hand tools.
* Operate and interpret results from oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, waveform generators, spectrum analyzers, and high-voltage power supplies.
* Create and refine Bills of Materials (BOMs) by cross-referencing general components (resistors, capacitors, ICs, diodes, etc.) to in-house part numbers, ordering prototypes, and applying appropriate scrap factors.
* Maintain accurate, repeatable test data and assist in root cause analysis for production or field issues.
* Install and troubleshoot engineering software, firmware tools, and driver issues as needed for testing or production support.
* Perform data collection, feasibility analysis, and assist in process or product improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering, production, and quality teams to support builds, testing, and continuous improvement.
* Use Outlook, Word, Excel, SolidWorks, CAB, and online databases to locate technical documentation, data sheets, and component specifications.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

* Legally authorized to work in the U.S. in compliance with ITAR regulations.
* 8+ years of experience in electronics testing, troubleshooting, or manufacturing support.
* Solid understanding of microcontroller architectures, embedded systems, and communication protocols.
* Skilled in use of test and measurement equipment for signal tracing and circuit validation.
* Hands-on experience with SMT soldering, rework, and prototype assembly.
* Strong mechanical aptitude and fine motor skills for working with small components and lab tools.
* Excellent documentation, organization, and communication skills.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

new_jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

"We Power the Magic!" That's our motto at Disney Experiences Technology (DXT). Our team creates world-class immersive digital experiences for the Company's premier vacation brands, including Disney's Parks & Resorts. We are responsible for the end-to-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology and digital-led initiatives across Food & Beverage, and Merchandise lines of business.

This role sits within the Retail & Restaurant Technology organization and supports the Point of Sale (POS) platform — the system that powers every merchandise and dining transaction across our parks and resorts. Our platform is a large-scale, distributed, event-driven system. We work with a polyglot stack (PHP, Go, Python, Java) that we are actively modernizing, and we need engineers who embrace the platform as it is while helping shape what it becomes. The main client of our services is the POS terminal itself — an Android-based hardware device used by thousands of Cast Members every day — so reliability, performance, and thoughtful API design directly impact the Guest and Cast experience.

The Lead Software Engineer will report to the Manager, Software Engineering.

What You Will Do

* Lead and personally build (hands-on coding expected) scalable, well-documented backend services and APIs across our polyglot platform — PHP and Go microservices today, with a growing Java/Spring footprint — from technical specification through production delivery.
* Set architectural direction for the POS platform: translate complex functional, technical, and business requirements into solution and system designs, produce architecture diagrams and proof-of-concepts, evaluate technology choices, and ensure new solutions integrate cleanly with surrounding Disney systems.
* Drive the modernization roadmap, playing a leading technical role in the migration of existing PHP and Go microservices into Java/Spring applications — defining migration patterns, sequencing, coexistence strategies, and quality gates so we modernize without disrupting daily park operations.
* Own the full software development life cycle for your team's deliverables: planning, estimation, design reviews, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, release management, production support, and post-incident root-cause analysis.
* Lead and mentor a team of backend Software Engineers — provide day-to-day technical direction, unblock engineers, review designs and code, grow junior talent, and foster a culture of engineering excellence and psychological safety.
* Assess and communicate risk: identify technical, delivery, and operational risks early; give clear direction on trade-offs; and escalate to leadership with well-formed options and recommendations when decisions exceed the team's authority.
* Design and operate event-driven and streaming integrations using Amazon Kinesis and RabbitMQ, ensuring our transaction, inventory, and reporting flows are resilient, idempotent, and observable.
* Steward our data layer, designing performant schemas and access patterns on Amazon Aurora (MySQL-compatible), guiding ORM usage, and safeguarding transactional integrity for a system where every record represents real money and a real Guest.
* Champion AI-assisted engineering, embedding tools such as Claude, Cursor, and Codex into the team's daily workflow — from design and coding to testing and troubleshooting — and shaping responsible adoption practices that raise both velocity and quality.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with product owners, program management, architecture, QA, hardware/terminal teams, and vendor partners to align solutions with current and future business needs, and represent the team in tactical and strategic forums with all levels of leadership.
* Support production, participating in on-call rotations and go-lives for a platform where availability matters most during the moments our Guests are creating memories.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* 7+ years of progressive experience designing, building, and operating large-scale, high-volume backend systems and services, including 2+ years leading engineers or serving as technical lead across the full software development life cycle.
* Strong hands-on expertise in PHP (modern PHP 8+; experience with a major framework such as Laravel or Symfony) and Go (idiomatic Go for microservices; familiarity with common toolkits such as Gin, Echo, or gRPC-Go).

We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.

 **Job Description**

Avaloq’s R&D Lab is building a SaaS, API-first, composable banking platform. You will help develop its Rust backend, creating financial technology where precision, quality and scalability matter, while working closely with engineers in Fort Lauderdale and Zurich.

These 3 roles are among the first engineering roles at our new Fort Lauderdale development center, offering significant scope for ownership as the team grows. You will work directly with clients, see how your solutions are used and bring those insights back into the product. The role includes onboarding with the Zurich team, collaborative mornings and productive afternoons, with regular travel to Switzerland and occasional travel to client sites.

**Our stack**

Rust with Tokio and the AWS SDK for Rust. Serverless-first on AWS, using Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS and S3, with GitHub Actions for CI/CD. Clients integrate through our APIs and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We do not run containers.

**Useful domain experience**

Depending on the role, relevant experience may include wealth and asset management, discretionary portfolio management, investment performance and attribution, portfolio valuation and rebalancing, benchmarks and fees, or US investment taxation, including tax lots, cost basis, holding periods, wash sales, corporate actions, withholding and tax reporting.

What you'll do:

* Design, develop and test Rust backend services for complex financial products, with a focus on accuracy, scalability and reliability.
* Translate complex financial rules and mathematical concepts into precise, efficient and testable software, accounting for numerical precision and edge cases.
* Build scalable solutions using historized, non-relational data models and asynchronous, event-driven architectures.
* Contribute to technical specifications, design discussions and code reviews, using AI coding agents while maintaining rigorous review standards and accountability.
* Own features through the development lifecycle, from implementation and automated testing to deployment and monitoring, working alongside Platform and SRE engineers.
* Work directly with clients and domain specialists to analyse product questions, solve problems and bring insights back into product development.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Strong programming foundations in a statically typed language such as Rust, C++, Java, Scala, Kotlin, C#, Go or TypeScript.
* Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, mathematics, physics or a related quantitative field.
* Strong modelling skills, including experience or understanding of historized data, effective dating, immutability and audit trails.
* Strong analytical ability and intellectual curiosity, with the ability to quickly learn new technologies and complex financial domains.
* Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts effectively to both technical and business audiences.
* Ability to work independently within a distributed team and travel to Switzerland and client sites when required.

It would be a real bonus if you have:

* Production Rust experience, or experience with another systems/strongly typed language such as C++, Haskell, OCaml or Scala.
* Experience in wealth or asset management technology, including investment performance, portfolio construction/rebalancing, or tax, accounting and other rule-heavy financial software.
* Experience with AWS serverless and event-driven architecture, particularly Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, S3 and API Gateway, or related distributed-systems technologies.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering, client-facing product development, research or open-source software.

  
**Additional Information**

This role includes onboarding with the existing team in Zurich, regular travel to Switzerland and occasional travel to client sites.

The Applied Embedded Systems (AES) division of the Electronic Systems Laboratory (ELSYS) supports multiple research products and projects in concert with development teams who are building complex, multi-faceted embedded and electronic systems. The Embedded Software/Firmware Engineer develops designs based on embedded firmware systems, such as Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA), Digital Signal Processors (DSPs), microcontrollers/computers, Application-Specific Integrated Circuits/systems (ASICs), and or Graphics Processor Units (GPUs). These designs also require development of documentation to support future reviews of design and enhancements. This position requires extensive knowledge of development environments for Xilinx and Altera (Intel) technologies, software development and configuration skills, and computer operating systems. The Embedded Software/Firmware Engineer applies engineering principles to firmware software creation and implementation of real-time hardware interface firmware and analysis, debugging, and testing of these systems.

>10%

new_jobs.title: Flight Controls Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Astria is a custom heavy-lift drone that combines lift motors with a cyclorotor for lateral force. It runs our own Simulink-built controllers on PX4-based flight hardware. It flies real installs on utility lines today. You'll contribute to controller changes from idea to flight. That means modeling the vehicle, designing and tuning the controller, testing it on the stand, flying it with our pilots, and reading the logs to find out what actually happened. It's a small team, so you'll be in the shop and in the field, not just at a desk. We're an AI-driven company. AI tooling runs throughout our engineering workflow, including MATLAB and Simulink work, log analysis, and simulation.

### **About Pitch Aeronautics Inc.**

Pitch Aeronautics (www.pitchaero.com) is a rapidly growing startup creating game-changing solutions for the utility industry. Pitch has developed a drone to install our line sensor, bird diverters, and other equipment on power lines. Our drone-deployable line sensors wirelessly transmit environmental and line characteristics to an online secure API to help utilities push more power through existing lines, prevent wildfires, and improve grid reliability.

At Pitch we’ve fostered a collaborative, fun, “get-stuff-done” working environment. We believe in moving fast and creating products and prototypes rapidly. If you’re looking for a place where you can make a difference on day one, be empowered to achieve, and love working in small teams, we want to meet you!

### **Description**

**Responsibilities**

* Design, model, and tune flight controllers (attitude, position, altitude, yaw, trim) in MATLAB/Simulink and deploy them to PX4-based flight hardware.
* Build and maintain vehicle dynamics models, including the cyclorotor, and extend our simulation capability (e.g., Gazebo, SITL).
* Write test plans and run test-stand and flight tests with the drone ops crew.
* Analyze flight logs (PX4 ULog) for tracking error, motor saturation, and vibration, and build tools that make that analysis faster.
* Make the controller robust to estimator events such as EKF resets, IMU switches, and GPS dropouts.
* Characterize propulsion (thrust vs. RPM, motor and prop selection) and fold the results back into the control code.
* Develop control for aerial manipulation: precise lateral positioning, wind rejection, and contact with the conductor during sensor install and removal.
* Configure and integrate motor controllers over DroneCAN.
* Document controller design decisions and changes, manage control code in Git, and post clear updates for the team.
* Mentor technicians and interns, and work with pilots on how the aircraft feels to fly.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with a focus on controls.
* 3+ years designing and testing control systems for UAVs, aircraft, or robots, or a graduate degree with significant hands-on flight-test work.
* Strong MATLAB/Simulink skills, including code generation for embedded targets.
* Solid grounding in classical control: PID/PD design, feedforward, saturation and anti-windup, rate and jerk limiting, and frequency-domain analysis.
* Hands-on flight or hardware testing experience, including reading logs to diagnose problems.
* Python for data analysis and tooling; Git.
* Clear technical writing.
* Able to work on-site in Boise and travel occasionally for field tests and installs.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot internals (uORB, EKF2) and Pixhawk/Cube hardware.
* Multirotor or unconventional rotorcraft dynamics; cyclorotor experience is a big plus.
* Aerial manipulation or contact control.
* State estimation and sensor fusion.
* Simulation with Gazebo, SITL, or HITL.
* CAN/DroneCAN and motor controller integration.
* FAA Part 107 certificate or piloting experience.
* Master's or PhD in controls, robotics, or aerospace.
* Fluency with AI assistants in engineering work, and enough depth to catch them when they're wrong.

**Benefits**

* 120 hrs of paid time off
* Health Insurance
* Dental & Vision Insurance
* Short-term disability insurance
* Long-term disability insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Paid holidays
* Flexible work schedule

In accordance with applicable federal regulations and requirements Pitch Aeronautics does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, disability, or age.
