Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**Working at Abbott**

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year
* An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists

**The Opportunity**

As a Staff Software Engineer, this seasoned professional will demonstrate competence and creativity in a wide range of technical areas. This role will have a lead role in the design, development, and testing of software applications for Abbott Cancer Diagnostics, creating expert design concepts and foolproof debugging.

This role will be able to resolve most issues and problems effectively with minimal oversight, communicate effectively with business stakeholders, and mentor junior team members. This role will routinely make key decisions for the team, be accountable for application quality, and be highly productive.

This position can be based in our Madison, WI, or Redwood City, CA, office location.

**What You'll Work On**

  

* Demonstrate strong working knowledge, skills, and understanding of practices for complex programs and initiatives, demonstrating creativity and substantial understanding of specialized techniques, processes, and procedures.
* Troubleshoot issues and problems of medium complexity for major software applications; break down complex tasks, make reasonable decisions, investigate and fix bugs, and operate independently.
* Initiate independent designs that impact and influence the department’s delivery and approach. Lead reviewing design alternatives, problems, and solutions with an eye on limiting the need for later problem solving.
* Consistently influence and make significant decisions within a project, demonstrating good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions based in a solid understanding of business strategy and best practices with minimal instructions for difficult or unpredictable situations.
* Contribute individual capabilities to the achievement of group objectives, and work effectively with others in a group setting. This includes mentoring, coaching, and technical guidance for junior members of the team.
* Build successful internal and external partnerships with peers, SMEs, stakeholders, and decision-makers.
* Communicate clear and concise project plans/designs and status updates for a project.
* Ability to work nights and/or weekends, as needed.
* Uphold company mission and values through accountability, innovation, integrity, quality, and teamwork.
* Support and comply with the company’s Quality Management System policies and procedures.
* Maintain regular and reliable attendance.
* Ability to act with an inclusion mindset and model these behaviors for the organization.

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or Engineering; or High School Diploma/General Education Degree and 4 years of relevant experience as outlined in the essential duties .
* Complete knowledge and full understanding of software development design and development, and relevant domain specific skills.
* Understanding of and significant experience with object-oriented programming.
* RESTful web services, Relational Databases (Postgres, SQL Server), and ORM technologies (JPA2, Hibernate, Entities Framework).
* Demonstrated experience designing and developing apps that access and or utilize cloud-based frameworks (e.g., Azure, Amazon AWS Services/SDKs, etc.).
* Agile development tools; including, but not limited to, JIRA, Confluence repository.
* C++, Java, JavaScript, Python, SQL, PL/SQL, .NET, Google Web Toolkit.
* Applicants must be currently authorized to work in country where work will be performed on a full or part-time basis. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.
* Demonstrated ability to perform the essential duties of the position with or without accommodation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* 7+ years of experience in the Software Engineering discipline
* Strong knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR.
* Experience using Java as a core language
* Experience using Spring Boot or Spring to support Microservices
* Experience using Maven
* Experience using Kafka or other queuing systems

new_jobs.title: Structural and Dynamic Systems Engineer - Analytical
new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

This entry level/early career professional, applied science position conducts numerical computations via third party and in-house tools to determine structural performance of components and systems. The results from the computer models are used to determine the validity of the design to meet the customer requirements. Design recommendations are then provided as needed.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Investigates product and system problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members Main focus is on the execution and improvement of established processes primarily documented in detailed local and global work instructions (EPs) that are required in Engineering Standard Work (ESW) and/or Design Validation Plans (DVP&R). This is accomplished through standard, as well as development of specialized computational tools and methods that are required to support the Design and Validation processes and enable high confidence decision making. Obtains input from Design, Thermal Sciences, Materials and Product Validation and delivers computer models and results for key structural performance parameters like motion, load, natural frequencies, stress, design margin, life, sound power to Design and Product Validation. Uses formal training like Statics, Dynamics, Machine Design, Mechanics of Materials, Failure Analysis, Engineering Materials and others along with tool specific training (ANSYS, FE-Safe, GT, AVL) to make Design decisions based on numerical predictions of structural performance of components and systems. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.

**Competencies:**

Applies Principles of Dynamics and Vibration - Determines motion of components and systems via numerical modeling and/or physical measurements; evaluates rigid and flexible body motion, natural frequencies, mode shapes, displacements, velocities, accelerations, friction, and wear to draw conclusions that influence design decisions with internal and external customers.

Applies Principles of Fatigue and Durability - Determines life of components and systems via numerical modeling and/or physical measurements; evaluates component temperatures, natural frequencies, mode shapes, displacements, strains/stresses, wear, and fatigue life to draw conclusions that influence design decisions with internal and external customers.

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Systems Modeling and Simulation - Identifies representation of a system or system element by using suitable analytical tools and techniques in order to derive knowledge about the real system; defines the strategy for modeling, simulation, and analysis of a system or system element by considering specifics of a given situation or nature of the system of interest in order to derive insights for making quality decisions.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

We are hiring a Senior Principal Platform Engineer to build and run the on-prem Kubernetes platform that teams across Clarity Innovations depend on. Half of this job is software: you will own our in-house cluster provisioning tool as a product. The other half is operations: you will keep the clusters, storage, networking and hardware underneath it healthy.

Rapid Capabilities is the product development org at Clarity Innovations, home of the Aurora Enterprise and Manifest product suites. We run lean, in Extreme Programming (XP) teams, so you will pair with engineers daily and ship in small, tested increments.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Own the provisioning tool as a software product**

* Develop and maintain our in-house automated cluster provisioning solution so every cluster is reproducible and consistent.

* Gather requirements from internal teams and turn them into a roadmap for the provisioning platform.

* Integrate the tool with CI/CD, observability, secrets management and access control.

* Plan, run and regularly test backup, disaster recovery and etcd maintenance.

**Manage the infrastructure underneath**

* Manage bare-metal and virtualized infrastructure, working with data center and IT teams on hardware provisioning and replacement.
* Design and maintain infrastructure across on-prem data centers and AWS / Azure, using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi or similar) wherever possible.
* Implement observability for metrics, logging, tracing and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry or similar).

**Build security in**

* Embed security and compliance into the platform: secrets management, IAM, policy-as-code and supply chain security.

* Join planning, stand-ups and retrospectives, and pair with engineers on implementation every day.

new_jobs.title: Senior Principal Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today's five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Principal Systems Engineer to join our growing team in Lanham, MD. This is a senior technical leadership role with system-level authority across multiple programs: owning system architecture, setting technical direction, resolving the most complex cross-cutting issues, and developing the next generation of systems engineering leads.

The ideal candidate brings a record of leading systems engineering on complex space or comparable programs from concept through launch and operations, is trusted by executives, customers, and engineers alike, and thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment where no two days look the same.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the technical authority for systems engineering across multiple programs, owning system architecture and technical direction from concept through verification, validation, launch, and on-orbit operations.
* Define and own system architectures and mission concepts, leading trade studies and making and defending key technical decisions in response to customer and internal needs.
* Establish top-level system requirements and govern their allocation, flow-down, and interface control across subsystems, suppliers, and organizations.
* Own technical budgets and margin philosophy (mass, power, link, thermal, schedule) at the program and constellation level, and ensure rigorous tracking across subsystems.
* Drive system-level integration across engineering disciplines (RF, software, mechanical, electrical, GNC, operations) and lead resolution of the most complex cross-cutting technical issues and anomalies.
* Provide technical leadership for proposal and business development efforts, including solution architecture, basis-of-estimate development, and cost/schedule inputs, and represent AST in technical engagements with customers and government partners.
* Serve as senior technical lead for major design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) and technical interchange meetings (TIMs), presenting to executive leadership, customers, and independent review boards.
* Lead technical risk management: identify and quantify top program and technical risks, drive mitigation, and advise leadership on risk-informed decisions.
* Define and evolve systems engineering processes, standards, practices, and drive their adoption across the organization.
* Mentor and develop SE leads and engineers, serve as a technical coach across the department, and contribute to hiring and talent growth.
  

**Qualifications**

**Education:**

Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field required; Master's degree or PhD strongly preferred

**Experience:**

A minimum of 12 years of systems engineering experience, with at least 5 years serving as SE Lead, Chief Engineer, or equivalent on a program of record or flight program, including end-to-end lifecycle experience on at least one program through launch and on-orbit operations

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in a relevant engineering discipline.
* Experience in space, satellite, or defense programs, ideally satellite communications, phased array, or RF payload systems.
* Experience establishing or leading SE practices and configuration control processes at the program or organizational level.

**Soft Skills:**

* Proven ability to lead and influence without direct authority across cross-functional teams and at the executive level.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to brief and build trust with executive, customer, and government audiences.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity: able to define the path forward and make sound decisions when requirements are incomplete or roles are fluid.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with the judgment to balance technical rigor against schedule and cost.
* Ability to manage multiple competing priorities across programs in a dynamic, fast-moving environment.
* Demonstrated mentor who builds technical talent and raises the bar for the team.
* Self-starter who takes ownership and drives issues to closure without close supervision.

**Technology Stack:**

* Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for documentation, analysis, and reporting.
* Requirements management tools: DOORS, Jama, or equivalent, with experience defining requirements management practices.
* MATLAB / Simulink for analysis and trade studies (preferred).
* Confluence and Jira for program tracking and collaboration.
* STK (Systems Tool Kit) for mission analysis (preferred).

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to work in a standard office environment and use a computer for extended periods.
* Occasional travel to other AST SpaceMobile facilities or customer/government sites (up to 20%).

*This job description may not be inclusive to the duties and responsibilities listed. Additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time or the scope of the job may change as needed by business demands**.*

There is no better time to join this domain as we evolve to the next generation of low voltage power strategy, innovation, and capability for EVs, ICE and every product GM has to offer!

  

We are seeking creative, highly motivated, agile thinkers with passion and expertise in embedded controls. The selected candidate will learn, modify existing and develop new innovative controls strategies, which will be at the core of all vehicles within the General Motors portfolio and essential to keeping General Motors at the forefront of low voltage related technologies.

* Lead development and implementation of controls development for complex low voltage related features in embedded C and C++. Universal Logistics is a leading provider of customized transportation and logistics solutions, offering a comprehensive suite of services including transportation, value-added, intermodal, and specialized services utilized throughout entire supply chains.
  
Universal has immediate career opportunities in your area. Apply today to become part of the Universal team!

**Position Description**
------------------------

The Industrial Robotics Engineer will be based in Warren, MI and will develop, engineer, and launch industrial and collaborative robotic automation across Universal Logistics operations and customer facilities.

This role focuses on robotic applications including material handling, sequencing, kitting, palletizing, depalletizing, machine tending, packaging, and other automation solutions designed to improve safety, quality, productivity, ergonomics, and process consistency.

  

The Industrial Robotics Engineer will serve as a hands-on manufacturing and automation engineer and project owner. This position will work with robotic cells, end-of-arm tooling, machine vision, controls, safety systems, equipment suppliers, customers, and cross-functional teams to take projects from concept and process development through build, commissioning, production ramp-up, and final handoff to operations.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop industrial and collaborative robotic concepts and manufacturing processes.
* Conduct feasibility, cycle-time, capacity, layout, ergonomic, process-flow, and technical trade-off studies to determine the appropriate automation solution.
* Define technical requirements, RFQs, and Statements of Work (SOWs) for robotic cells, including: Robot selection End-of-arm tooling Fixtures Machine vision Sensors Guarding and safety devices Controls Conveyance Equipment interfaces
* Manage automation projects with system integrators and equipment suppliers from concept and design through build, FAT, installation, SAT, commissioning, and production ramp-up.
* Manage project timing, cost, scope, risks, and technical deliverables.
* Serve as the engineering interface between customers and cross-functional teams, including Operations, Controls, IT, Safety, Quality, Maintenance, and Facilities.
* Lead design reviews, process reviews, FMEA activities, risk assessments, and site-readiness planning.
* Support robot and cobot programming, PLC/HMI integration, machine vision, sensors, and end-of-arm tooling.
* Troubleshoot and debug equipment while validating safety, quality, cycle time, throughput, uptime, process capability, and production readiness.
* Develop acceptance criteria, operating standards, training, spare-parts requirements, preventive-maintenance requirements, and lessons learned.
Complete formal project handoffs to Operations and help standardize successful automation designs for future applications.  

  

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Mechatronics, Robotics Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical field.
* 2+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, automation engineering, robotics integration, controls, or equipment launch within a manufacturing, warehousing, or logistics environment.
* Working knowledge of industrial and/or collaborative robots, end-of-arm tooling, PLC/controls, machine vision, sensors, safety systems, and integrated robotic cells.
* Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, layouts, and technical specifications.
* Experience with cycle-time analysis, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and project coordination.
* Ability to manage suppliers, schedules, technical deliverables, and launch-related issues.
Willingness to travel and support non-standard hours during critical installation, commissioning, and production launch periods.  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong self-starter with a manufacturing engineering mindset and the ability to independently own projects, work directly with customers, coordinate cross-functional teams, and drive technical issues to resolution.
* Hands-on experience with industrial robot or cobot platforms such as FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots, or similar systems, including programming, simulation, or commissioning.
* Experience with Allen-Bradley/Rockwell PLCs and HMIs, safety PLCs, industrial networking, servo systems, and robotic equipment integration.
* Experience with machine vision, force/torque sensing, grippers, vacuum tooling, fixtures, quick-change tooling, and other end-of-arm tooling technologies.
* Understanding of industrial and collaborative robot safety requirements, machine guarding, risk assessments, lockout/tagout, and applicable ANSI/RIA and ISO standards.
* Experience with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, robot simulation, virtual commissioning, FAT/SAT, run-at-rate validation, Lean/Six Sigma, automotive manufacturing, or other high-volume production environments.

new_jobs.title: Lights Out Automation Engineer
new_jobs.description:
At the interface of design, engineering and supply logistics, REHAU Automotive and SRG Global combine to form RESRG - a leading global supplier of coated exterior systems and components. With a combined track record of over 160 years across four continents and 22 production sites, RESRG's 10,000 skilled team members manufacture the latest exterior systems and components for the world's leading automotive manufacturers.
  
  
We are looking for you to join our team as a Lights Out Automation Engineer at our Portageville, Missouri facility!
  
  
Your Job
  
You will help create one of the most advanced manufacturing operations in North America.
  
This is an opportunity to help define and deploy the next generation of manufacturing where robotics, AI, machine vision, autonomous material flow, advanced controls, and digital technologies work together to enable increasing levels of autonomous production and ultimately support our Lights-Out Manufacturing roadmap.
  
As part of RESRG's Operations Transformation team, you will lead the design, programming, deployment, and optimization of robotic and automation systems that directly advance our lights-out strategy. You will help transform Portageville into a showcase facility where innovative automation technologies deliver new levels of safety, quality, productivity, and operational excellence.
  
If you are passionate about robotics, enjoy solving difficult engineering challenges, and want to build technology that changes how factories operate, we want to hear from you.
  
  
What You Will Do in Your Role
  

* Design, build, program, commission, and optimize advanced robotic manufacturing systems.
* Develop next-generation automation solutions supporting our Lights-Out Manufacturing vision.
* Program and integrate industrial robots, PLCs, HMIs, servos, drives, and motion control systems.
* Implement advanced machine vision and AI-driven inspection technologies.
* Develop autonomous material handling solutions utilizing AGVs, AMRs, and intelligent logistics systems.
* Lead automation projects from concept through production launch.
* Partner with plant operations, maintenance, quality, and manufacturing engineering teams to identify and execute high-impact automation opportunities.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and help shape the future automation roadmap for Portageville and other RESRG facilities.
* Troubleshoot complex system issues and continuously improve equipment performance, reliability, and OEE.
* Contribute to new standards, automation architectures, and best practices that will be replicated across the enterprise.
* Serve as a technical leader for robotics and controls initiatives that accelerate OAMI advancement.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)
  

* BS/MS in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics Engineering, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience implementing industrial automation systems.
* Strong hands-on experience programming industrial robots and PLC-based control systems.
* Experience integrating vision systems, sensors, drives, and automation components.
* Ability to lead projects from concept through startup and production stabilization.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and a passion for continuous improvement.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

What Will Put You Ahead
  

* FANUC robot programming and vision experience.
* Allen-Bradley Studio 5000, ControlLogix, FactoryTalk, and PowerFlex expertise.
* Experience with AI-enabled inspection systems.
* Experience with AGVs, AMRs, autonomous logistics, or warehouse automation.
* Automation simulation and digital twin experience.
* Experience commissioning highly automated manufacturing cells or production lines.
* Automotive manufacturing experience.
* Knowledge of Industry 4.0, IIoT, MES integration, and smart factory technologies.

Join the Team Building the Future
  
At RESRG Automotive, we believe the next generation of manufacturing will be defined by intelligent automation, digital connectivity, and autonomous operation. If you're excited by the challenge of helping build a Lights-Out Manufacturing environment and advancing one of the industry's most aggressive automation roadmaps, Portageville is where you can make your mark.
  
About the Company
  
We are a fast-growing global manufacturer with a strong internal culture that values respect, diversity, and purposeful work. We offer career paths that enable professional growth, a team-focused environment, and a commitment to safety and wellness.

Our goal is for each employee and their family to live fulfilling and healthy lives. new_jobs.description:
Description:

**Job Summary:**

The Staff Platform Engineer sets the technical direction for the platform and solves infrastructure problems that span teams. The role stays hands-on — writing and reviewing infrastructure code and operating production systems — but most of its impact comes from shaping how the whole engineering organization builds, deploys, and runs software, without formal management authority. Staff engineers may also serve as a team's Tech Lead, a role that carries no change in title, band, or bonus.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Regularly audit and evaluate the platform's architecture, and lead the design and delivery of major
* architectural changes across teams on an annual basis.
* Write technical proposals for those changes and build agreement on them with product and engineering
* stakeholders.
* Set org-wide standards for infrastructure patterns, delivery practices, tooling, and technology choices.
* Partner with Buyer and Cargo engineering leadership so the platform supports what their teams need to build
* next.
* Define observability, reliability, and incident standards, and take on the hardest production problems: systemic
* bottlenecks, performance crises, and failures under heavy contention.
* Plan and carry out large migrations, such as database moves, network re-architecture, and project
* restructuring, without disrupting live auctions.
* Own the platform's security, cost, and capacity strategy.
* Mentor senior engineers and act as a force multiplier, influencing direction without formal authority.

Requirements:

**Qualifications / Requirements:**

* **Autonomy:** Leads strategy — defines technical direction without day-to-day oversight.
* **Technical Depth:** Visionary — deep expertise with the ability to see and shape the broader technical landscape.
* **Leadership Impact:** Force multiplier and system architect — makes entire teams more effective.
* **Business Impact:** Strategic — future-proofs systems and drives technical decisions that enable business growth.
* **Experience:** 7-10+ years of professional engineering experience, with a demonstrated record of infrastructure or platform impact across teams.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Advanced study in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline (Master's or equivalent graduate-level work) is a strong differentiator at this level.

**Technical Skills**

* **Languages:** Expert-level proficiency in TypeScript and strong proficiency in Go or Python.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Sets standards for infrastructure as code — state management, resource lifecycle, refactoring and aliasing, and reusable component design. Pulumi in TypeScript is a strong plus.
* **Cloud:** GCP architecture expertise — designs for reliability, cost efficiency, and scale across GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, and BigQuery.
* **Networking:** Network architecture expertise — multi-project VPC design, private service connectivity, load balancing, mTLS, and traffic management.
* **Databases:** Deep expertise in operating MySQL, PostgreSQL, and distributed SQL — replication, connection pooling, schema evolution at scale, and zero-downtime migrations.
* **Observability:** Designs and owns observability strategy — alerting, SLOs/SLAs, and distributed tracing.
* **Security:** Understands security at the architecture level — auth patterns, secrets management, network security, IAM, and defending against abusive traffic.
* **Technical Fundamentals:** Expert-level distributed systems knowledge — consensus, replication strategies, concurrency control under write contention, exactly-once semantics, and fault-tolerant design; OS and runtime internals relevant to performance (GC behavior, syscall overhead, context switching); systems design fluency — can decompose and reason about large-scale distributed architectures from first principles.

**Nice to Have**

* Temporal or other durable workflow orchestration.
* CockroachDB, PgBouncer, or large-scale database migration and replication.
* Cloud Armor, WAF, or bot-mitigation experience.
* Vertex AI or other ML serving infrastructure.
* Experience architecting systems with heavy write contention, such as many users acting on the same records at once in bidding, inventory, or payments.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to remain seated or stationary for extended periods while working at a computer.
* Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, mouse use, and other computer-related tasks.
* Ability to communicate effectively in person, by phone, and through electronic communication.
* Ability to occasionally stand, walk, bend, reach, or move about the office.
* Ability to occasionally lift and carry office equipment or materials up to 10–15 pounds.
* Visual ability sufficient to read computer screens, documents, and other work-related materials.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

* Proven ability to lead technical discussions and drive design decisions

**Job Description**  
We are seeking a mid-career Electrical Engineer to support our Electronic Attack Systems and related technologies. If selected, you will be part of the Hardware Team supporting development programs in the Franchise Program Portfolio – a major piece of our Electronic Attack Solutions product line.
  
Key Responsibilities could include:

* Translate system requirements into successful system architectures and complex printed board assembly designs.
* Create system schematic and layouts
* Perform trade studies and prototyping to down select critical components, develop optimized electronic architectural solutions (SWAP), verify complex custom circuit blocks of an overarching system
* Support System Integration and Test in labs and directly on platforms
* Provide electrical engineering support for critical test events
* Document design verification tests and design review documentation
* Actively participate in knowledge-sharing culture via mentoring
* Work within schedule and budget constraints and elevate concerns if challenges arise.
  

  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering
* Minimum of four years of relevant experience in related industry (i.e. defense, electronics) or two years with a Master’s Degree
* Solid understanding of fundamentals of digital, analog, power, and mixed-signal electronics and interface/communication standards such as UART, SPI, QSPI, I2C, USB, Ethernet, ARINC 429, MIL-STD-1553, PCIe
* PCB/CCA design experience, with an emphasis on DFA and DFM optimization, for complex rigid and rigid-flex mixed-signal HDI PCBs.
* Proficient at testing and troubleshooting analog, digital, and power supply-based circuits in a lab setting using oscilloscopes, bench supplies, vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, frequency counters, arbitrary waveform generators, function generators, logic analyzers
  

  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, or equivalent
* Familiarity designing with FPGAs, System-On-Chips (SoC), and/or CPLDs using VHDL and/or Verilog
* Familiarity designing and writing embedded SW for microcontroller-based systems and modules
* Knowledge of system level EMI mitigation techniques along with proper grounding/shielding architecture
* Experience with high-speed mixed signal HDI PCB design, constraints management, and proper routing for interfaces with lane rates exceeding 1Gbps
* Hands-on experience with high voltage testing with an emphasis on measurement safety
* Experience with low noise, wide bandwidth, low power, Analog Front-End systems
* Understanding of SPICE simulators and simulation methods, preferably using LTSpice, TINA, PSpice Experience with the following PCB and CCA design features: micro-via and blind/buried vias, stacked micro-vias, via-in-pad and via fill/cap processes, controlled impedances, backdrilling, high pin count / fine-pitch BGAs, Chip-on-Board (COB), QFNs/DFNs, LGAs, and other advanced IC package types
* Familiarity with phase/gain margin stability analysis and other small signal analysis techniques, as it applies to analog circuit design and switch-mode power supply design
* Familiarity with Signal Integrity and Power Integrity, as it applies to proper layout techniques
* Active DoD Security Clearance – Top Secret with SCI
  

  
  
**Pay Information**
  
Full-Time Salary Range: $118095 - $200762

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**We believe that great healthcare is an essential safeguard of human dignity.**

At Laborie, we know the work we do matters – it’s what fuels our motivation and contributes to our success. If you’re ready to make a positive impact in the lives of patients across the globe, we’d like to meet you.

We support and empower our employees to grow their careers in an environment that encourages a sense of belonging and a connection to doing good. We’re not afraid to roll up our sleeves to make our goals a reality and work together to solve for our customers. We reward and recognize our employees based on our values of **Aspire to Greatness, Respect All, Own It, Working Together, Persist with Passion.**

**Who We’re Looking For:**

As a key member of the R&D team, the Senior Software Engineer is responsible for the full lifecycle of designing, developing, modifying, testing, debugging, and supporting new and existing Laborie software as well as integrating the software into Laborie medical devices. Working independently under limited supervision, performing highly complex and specialized software project activities. Can function as a leader on project teams and may oversee other engineers. Applying engineering and scientific principles to the evaluation and solution of technical problems in a creative manner unique to each project.

**About the Role:**

* Responsible for design and implementation of system software, from concept phase through design transfer / product launch.
* Act as a mentor for new or lower-level software Engineers, as well as for
* all the members of the development team.
* Train junior software engineers.
* Assist in the collection and documentation of user requirements, software development plans, software development time estimates, and resource efforts.
* Integrate and support communication between different software development teams, projects, system engineering, Operations/Mfg., and the larger R&D team.
* Complete software design and development documents in compliance with Laborie QMS, ISO and other relevant standards.
* Work with the Software Test Team to develop test methods/cases, unit testing and/or V&V pass criteria and where viable assist with the development of automated test scripts.
* Design modular software that is flexible and appropriate to a growing, multi-year program. Anticipate the software needs of future products and extensions.
* Manages assigned work items according to provided priorities.
* Maintains high standards of software quality by closely following the department's Quality Plan.
* Estimates progress and reports on status of assigned projects.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science and/or equivalent and 10+ years of experience.
* Solid track record of designing and developing production ready software, knowledge of software implementation best practices and deployment strategies
* Practical programming experience developing software (at least one modern OO language) for a medical device (IEC 62304).
* Experience with unit- and integration-level testing and automated testing is recommended.
* Experience in the following areas:
* C#/.NET/ SQL/Entity Framework/ADT/WPF/WCF/Unit Testing (NUnit, Moq)
* Visual Studio /MS SQL Server
* Automation Build, Testing and Deployment (TestStack. White and/or CodedUI)
* TFS and related API
* Strong knowledge of design patterns and OO concepts
* Ability to quickly learn new technology and apply knowledge to solve technical and business problems.
* Highly organized with well-developed time-management skills and processes for managing multiple priorities.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
* A meticulous working style with the ability to focus on details while holding the end goal in clear sight.
* Strong technical writing capability and excellent oral communication skills.
* Motivated self-starter with the ability to determine when to act and when to ask for support.
* Ability to work both independently and within a team in a fast-paced, changing environment.

**Why Laborie:**

Our Mission every day is to operate as a world-class specialist medical company making and advancing technologies that preserve and restore human dignity. We do that today by helping people with pelvic and gastrointestinal conditions live normal lives, and by helping mothers and babies have safe deliveries.

* Paid time off and paid volunteer time
* Medical, Dental, Vision and Flexible Spending Account
* Health Savings Account with Company Funded Contributions
* 401k Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Parental Leave and Adoption Services
* Health and Wellness Programs and Events

We are interested in a qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we will not be sponsoring work visas for this position, at this time.

*Laborie* *provides equal employment opportunities and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person’s race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**  
We put our customers first – exemplified by our mission: “We Protect Those Who Protect Us®."
  
  
Our employees work on the world’s most advanced electronics. Spanning air, land, sea, and space, we are developing the technology of tomorrow, delivered today. Drawing strength from our differences, we’re innovating for the future. And you can, too.
  
  
Are you a Software Engineer with 8 to 20+ years of experience looking for the next step to grow your career? Do you want to design and write software that really matters and be a part of a cause greater than yourself? Then, help us protect those that protect us by developing next generation electronic systems products and solutions. We need your talent, motivation, and vision to join our growing team in Wayne, New Jersey.
  
  
BAE Systems is seeking a talented Principal level Software Engineer to help us create the world’s most advanced solutions in Communications, Navigation and Electronic Warfare for our defense related customers.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Software Engineer to be a key contributor to the development, integration, and deployment of complex software systems essential to national security. You will operate as a hands-on engineer, guiding software engineering teams, resolve challenging issues, and serve as a trusted technical interface with both internal stakeholders and our customers. You will be empowered to influence technical direction and drive innovation within a collaborative and fast-paced program environment.
  
  
BAE Systems offers competitive pay, benefits, and important work-life balance initiatives including every other Friday Off and Flextime. BAE also believes in a culture of recognition for the extraordinary contributions of our skilled employees.
  
  
Because this role involves a combination of collaborative/in-person and independent work, it will take the form of a hybrid work format, with time split between working onsite and remotely.  
  
  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Bachelor’s Degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field and a minimum of 8+ years work experience.
* Background in embedded and/or application software development in C++
* Foundation in Object-Oriented design and implementation principles
* Experience performing software testing, validation, and verification activities
* Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership and guide engineering teams
* Has experience with Agile Development
* Has experience with source code control systems, such as Git.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and strong presentation skills.
* Must be eligible for a US DoD security clearance
  

  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Experience with signal processing techniques and filtering algorithms
* Knowledge of Linux-based development and deployment environments
* Experience with DevSecOps
* Experience with Containers including Docker and Kubernetes
* Experience with scripting languages and development of automation
* Experience developing Defense, Aerospace, Military or Mission-Critical systems
* Experience integrating software across distributed, networked, embedded or real-time computing environments
* Experience working directly with Government or Defense Industry customers
  

  
  
**Pay Information**
  
Full-Time Salary Range: $145049 - $246584
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  
  
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.

This individual will work in a team environment to manage the development of highly complex waveforms that require the design, implementation, and integration of embedded General Purpose Processor (GPP), Cryptographic Sub System (CSS), Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) and/or Digital Signal Processing (DSP) software solutions for radio and/or other communications products. The successful candidate will be expected to possess a thorough understanding of technical challenges including both the development methods as well as enforcing organizational behaviors to ensure quality. Experience working in collaborative software design/development/test teams ranging in size from 3 to 30 engineers is desired.

* Plan and manage project execution to align with scope, budget and schedule
* Management of the entire product development cycle including system/software requirements analysis, high level and detailed design, implementation, testing, integration, documentation, and government certification of embedded software designs.
* Detailed understanding and knowledge of best practices for design processes, software design, code development processes, release processes for simultaneous release of multiple devices.
* Functional management of a small group of developers for high assurance communications products in the tactical military radio domain.
* Manage staffing allocations against defined engineering resource demands.
* Effective interpersonal skills, ability to convey technical and business matters in a clear and logical manner.
* Ability to manage and make trade-offs between product recurring cost, budget, schedule and technical solutions.
* Support organizational development through recruiting, mentoring, career development, talent assessments and performance reviews of staff to ensure engineering skill sets and resource capacity to meet organization demands.
* Work collaboratively with product design, test, manufacturing, logistics engineering teams, product and program management and other groups, and external customers as needed to define and execute radio product development projects and deliver high-quality radio products.
* Ensure the conversion of customer requirements, including informal requirements, into total systems solutions that balance the technical, schedule and cost constraints of the program.
* Support collection and analysis of metrics related to project execution and software performance
* Support new business pursuits, proposals, and Basis of Estimates (BOE)
* Identify and implement engineering process improvements, promoting cross-team and cross-functional collaboration and re-use.
* Ability to obtain a US Security Clearance

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 9 years prior related experience. Graduate Degree with a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience in Software Engineering.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Experience leading teams of 5+ engineers, managing their efforts including budget and scheduling of activities
* Experience with all phases of the software project development life cycle, including software analysis, design, development, testing (including software unit testing), and automation tools.
* Experience in agile software development methodologies using an iterative, time-boxed development process (SCRUM).
* Highly motivated, a self starter, and able to operate with little supervision in diverse environments.
* A successful track record in planning, executing, and tracking personal and team’s task assignments.
* Demonstrated ability and experience leading small product development engineering teams and mentoring other engineers.
* Mentoring and directing the activities of small groups of engineers.
* Managing activities in disparate geographic locations.
* Experience/knowledge of Capability Maturity Model (CMM)/Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI) sys

new_jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

#### **What We're Doing**

The coolest jobs on this planet… or any other… are with Lockheed Martin!

At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems in Owego, NY, we develop mission‑critical embedded software and advanced technologies for complex defense and aerospace systems. Our software supports safety‑critical avionics, mission computers, embedded processing, and secure systems where reliability and performance matter.

#### **The Work**

As a Level 2 Software Engineer, you’ll get hands-on experience across the software lifecycle while working alongside experienced engineers to build the next generation of mission computers for safety-critical avionics systems. You’ll help turn ideas and requirements into reliable, flight-ready software and see your work move from development to integration, test, and certification.

You’ll have the opportunity to:

* Design, develop, integrate, test, debug, and maintain product line application software for aircraft navigation systems.
* Analyze requirements and develop software solutions that run on Real‑Time Operating Systems and hypervisors such as LynxOS, Windriver VxWorks, or Green Hills Integrity.
* Perform hands‑on software/hardware integration, verification, troubleshooting, and system‑level debugging using target hardware and laboratory instrumentation.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and develop creative solutions.
* Apply software engineering tools, processes, and best practices.
* Support integration, verification, and validation activities in a lab environment.
* Produce technical documentation and software artifacts to support quality and safety certification.
* Learn new technologies and take on increasingly complex challenges.
* Support modern DevSecOps practices, including CI/CD and automated testing.
* Participate in peer reviews and technical design discussions.
* Bring fresh ideas that can improve products and processes.

#### **Who We Are**

RMS Owego brings together software, systems, hardware, and integration expertise to develop advanced mission solutions. Our engineers work with real mission hardware in onsite laboratories, taking software from architecture and design through integration, test, and delivery.

#### **Who You Are**

You’re curious, motivated, and ready to build. You like solving problems, learning how things work, and turning ideas into working software. You can work independently, collaborate with a team, ask questions, and take ownership of your work.

#### **Why Join Us**

Build your skills while building technology that matters. At Lockheed Martin, you’ll get challenging technical experiences, learn from experienced engineers, and have opportunities to grow your career.

Bring your curiosity. Bring your ideas. Let’s build what’s next.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* 2+ years related experience with an Associates Degree in STEM related field or 1+ years related experience with a Bachelors degree in a STEM related field.
* Experience developing C/C++ code for embedded systems.
* Familiar with developing and debugging software that controls hardware devices.
* Experience developing, integrating, and debugging software within a Real-Time Operating System (RTOS) or embedded Linux environment (e.g., Wind River VxWorks, LynxOS, Green Hills Integrity, or similar).
* Must be a US Citizen; this position will require a DoD government security clearance at the Secret level.

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Bachelors degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent STEM computing field with 2+ years related professional experience or at least 1 year of related experience required with a related Masters degree
* Experience working with communication protocols such as ARINC 429, MIL-STD 1553, RS 422 Serial.
* Experience writing device drivers and product line software
* Familiarity with open architecture initiatives and modular design standards (e.g., FACE, OMS, SOSA)
* Familiarity with safety-critical software development processes (e.g., DO-178C)
* Experience developing test plans and procedures for software verification
* Experience with Git/GitLab, SonarQube, or Atlassian products

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $91200.00 - $169400.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

**Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

* Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
* For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Anthropic is looking for a Staff+ Software Engineer to work on the vector search infrastructure behind Claude. Retrieval is how Claude learns about the world. Web search across claude.ai, the API and agentic surfaces, memory across conversations, and the reinforcement learning workloads that train our next models all depend on fast, cheap, high-recall nearest-neighbor search over billions of vectors.

You'll join a small team responsible for the vector database layer that serves Claude's retrieval workloads: its architecture, performance, scalability and cost. This is a foundational role. The team is small, core architectural decisions are still open, and the engineers who join now will shape how the system evolves.

The role sits in our Databases organization and works day to day with the Search Platform team, which owns web search indexing, retrieval and serving, and the Memory & Search team, which owns search and memory inside claude.ai.

We're looking for someone who has built vector or search systems that ran in production, at scale, with real users and a real on-call. You'll be hands-on in the code, and you'll also be the person deciding how the pieces fit together.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the core of Anthropic's vector database layer: index structures, storage layout, query execution and the serving layer
* Own production readiness - benchmarking against exact search, capacity planning, onboarding new workloads, and the operational tooling to run it at scale
* Drive the recall, latency and cost trade-offs - quantization, filtered search, index build and refresh strategy, and how compute and storage are separated and scaled
* Scale throughput by an order of magnitude as research and training demand grows, and work out whether the bottleneck is architecture, hardware or engineering bandwidth
* Extend the retrieval stack toward hybrid retrieval - lexical search and fused ranking alongside vector search
* Set the evaluation methodology for the system - recall targets, latency objectives, cost per query, and the regression detection that keeps them honest
* Set technical direction for a growing team - lead design reviews, make architectural decisions others build on, and mentor the engineers joining the effort
* Share the on-call for the systems you own

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Direct experience building a vector database or approximate nearest-neighbor search system that ran in production at scale
* Deep knowledge of ANN index structures (graph-based, clustering-based or disk-resident approaches), vector quantization and filtered search
* Experience with search relevance and ranking
* Strong systems programming skills in a language such as Rust, C++ or Go, including performance-critical and memory-intensive code
* Experience designing and operating large-scale distributed storage or serving systems with strict latency and reliability requirements
* A track record of independently scoping and delivering ambiguous, multi-quarter technical projects
* Strong written and verbal communication, with experience driving alignment across teams with different priorities
* Interest in AI safety and Anthropic's mission

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with object-storage-backed or disaggregated compute and storage database designs
* Experience building or operating full-text search engines (inverted indexes, BM25) or hybrid retrieval systems
* Familiarity with embedding models and the retrieval demands of LLM training and inference
* Experience using GPUs or other accelerators for index build or search
* Prior experience as a technical lead on a database or search infrastructure team

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$320,000 - $485,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Join our team as an **Electrical Engineering Technician** and put your electrical expertise to work supporting the development, integration, and testing of electric forklift systems and components.

* Operate electrical test equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes, current clamps, thermocouple loggers, strain gauges, and voltage/current data loggers.
* Troubleshoot electrical systems on electric forklifts, test fixtures, and prototype equipment using standard and specialized diagnostic tools.
* Support electrical system integration by installing, calibrating, and testing motor controllers, vehicle wiring harnesses, sensors, and other electrical components.
* Build and support test stands and fixtures used for electrical system integration and testing.
* Document testing, troubleshooting, and integration activities using Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and PTC Creo Schematics.

* Associate degree in Electrical/Electronic Technology or a related field, or at least two years of equivalent hands-on electrical/electronic experience.
* Hands-on electrical harness and panel fabrication skills, including wire preparation, crimping, soldering, and assembly.
* Practical understanding of low-voltage DC electrical systems and troubleshooting techniques.
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, harness drawings, assembly prints, connector pinouts, PCB/PCA drawings, and component datasheets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including fluency in English.

* Exposure to C, C++, Python, or similar programming languages, including scripting, embedded systems, or test automation.

This is a practical, delivery-focused role. * Manage Technical Risk and develop effective Risk Control Measures to ensure products are safe to use and meet regulatory constraints

* Spot technical gaps and risks early, agree priorities with the team and drive engineering issues through to resolution.

Requirements, Architecture and Interfaces

* Manage DFMEA and Risk Registers, assessing risk acceptability and tracing risks through Risk Control Measures to implementation

Integration, Test and Verification

new_jobs.title: Reliability Engineer- Electrical Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

The **Reliability Engineer (Electrical Engineering)** will lead electrical reliability, signal-integrity validation, and product qualification for cable backplane assemblies used in AI and hyperscale data centers. The role will develop scalable test strategies and automated systems, characterize high-speed channels and electrical interfaces, and identify failure mechanisms under electrical and environmental stress. In partnership with design, manufacturing, quality, and external laboratories, the engineer will drive root-cause resolution and design and process improvements. This position is based in Etters, PA or Raleigh, NC. Approximately 20% travel is expected.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop electrical reliability and validation strategies, test plans, acceptance criteria, and coverage across the product life cycle.
* Architect and validate automated electrical test systems, fixtures, breakout boards, and loopback setups for laboratory and manufacturing use.
* Characterize signal and electrical performance using TDR, VNA, BERT, oscilloscopes, source-measure units, and related equipment.
* Evaluate channel, power, ground, shielding, continuity, resistance, and dielectric performance before, during, and after environmental and accelerated-life testing.
* Apply DOE, MSA, reliability statistics, and data analysis to ensure test capability and identify degradation trends and failure thresholds.
* Lead electrical failure analysis and document results, risks, and recommendations for design, qualification, manufacturing, and customer decisions.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, electronics, or reliability engineering with an electrical focus; advanced degree preferred.
* 5+ years in electrical reliability, product validation, signal-integrity testing, or automated test-system development; interconnect experience preferred.
* Strong knowledge of circuit fundamentals, transmission lines, differential signaling, impedance, grounding, shielding, power integrity, and electrical failure mechanisms.
* Hands-on experience developing automated test systems, interpreting schematics and interconnect drawings, and troubleshooting intermittent or mixed-mode failures.
* Working knowledge of reliability statistics, DOE, MSA, sampling methods, data analysis, and cross-functional project execution.
* Ability to travel approximately 20% to manufacturing sites, laboratories, suppliers, and customer locations.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with high-speed serial channels, cable and connector validation, S-parameters, calibration, de-embedding, and simulation-to-measurement correlation.
* Automation experience using Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB, PLCs, or comparable control and data-acquisition tools.
* Experience with HALT, HASS, ALT, ORT, ESS, thermal cycling, vibration, and shock testing with in-situ electrical monitoring.
* Experience designing and validating electrical test boards, including schematics, component selection, layout review, and bring-up.
* Knowledge of AI data-center interconnects and applicable IPC, IEC, IEEE, Telcordia, or MIL-STD requirements; reliability certification is a plus.

Amphenol Corporation is proud of our reputation as an excellent employer. Our focus is to provide the highest level of support and responsiveness to both our employees and our customers, the world's largest technology companies. Amphenol Corporation offers the opportunity for career growth within a global organization. We believe that Amphenol Corporation is unique in that every employee, regardless of his or her position, has the ability to positively impact the business.

Amphenol is an “Equal Opportunity Employer” - Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin. For additional company information please visit our website at https://www.amphenol-cs.com/

new_jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
new_jobs.description:
ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™
  
  
​​ASRC Federal Advanced Research LLC (AFAR)​ is seeking an ​Electrical Engineer​ to join our ​Next Generation Weather Radar (NEXRAD) - Hardware Engineering​ team that supports the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). This is a ​full-time​ ​on-site​ position at the ​Radar Operations Center (ROC)​ in ​Norman, OK​.
  
  
​​The NEXRAD Hardware Engineering team at the Radar Operations Center (ROC) provides comprehensive hardware support for the Weather Surveillance Radar 1988 Doppler (WSR-88D), commonly known as NEXRAD. Their specialized work ensures the reliability of the radar's physical infrastructure by resolving complex issues across various critical components, such as the transmitter, receiver, and pedestal.​
  
  
Citizenship/Permanent Residency Requirement
  
  
All candidates must have the following to pass the Federal Background Investigation and obtain the FAA Public Trust security clearance.
  
  

* Be a US Citizen.
* Has resided in the US for three (3) consecutive years.
* RealID Driver’s License/ID or current US Passport.

Relocation Requirement
  
  
Candidate must reside or be willing to relocate within a commutable distance to the ​Radar Operations Center (ROC)​ in ​Norman, OK​.
  
  
Education & Experience Requirement
  
  
All non-US Degrees must have a US Equivalency Certificate provided by the candidate at the time of application.
  

* A/An ​Bachelors (ABET)​ degree in ​Engineering or related IT field, such as Physics, Aerospace, Chemistry, Computer Science, or Mathematics.​
* Experience with NAS facilities, systems, and equipment is ​desired​.
* 3 - 6​ years of related work experience.

Required Skills
  
  

* ​​Project management, coordination, scheduling, and management of engineering changes.
* Support and maintenance of lab hardware and ongoing lab activities.
* Knowledge of Printed Circuit Board (PCB) design and troubleshooting.
* Proficient in common serial communications protocols such as RS232.
* Familiarity with hardware system design, schematics, and interconnects.
* Strong technical aptitude in electrical engineering functions.
* Ability to work in multidisciplinary engineering areas including power systems, communications, RF, analog, and digital systems.
* Skilled in using oscilloscopes, multimeters, spectrum analyzers, and signal generators for diagnosing electrical issues.​
* Ability to:
* Work independently, as well as on a team, in an agile environment.
* Research, troubleshoot and problem solve quickly.
* Learn on the job/willing to self-teach.
* Communicate effectively through verbal and written communication with high organization.

Preferred Skills
  
  

* ​​Experience with MATLAB, Simulink, SPICE (LTspice, PSpice), or similar simulation software.
* Knowledge of C/C++, Python, or PLC programming (Ladder Logic) for embedded systems and automation.
* Ability to write clear documentation, test reports, and specifications for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Familiarity with Altium Designer, Eagle, KiCad, or OrCAD.
* Oversight of electrical engineering projects from feasibility studies and cost estimation to manufacturing and deployment​.

Essential Daily Job Duties
  
  

* ​​Perform market research and evaluate needs for updating end-of-life hardware.
* Coordinate, draft, review, and edit technical reports and drawings for final approval and distribution.
* Identify needs and drive the development and implementation of major processes.
* Handle and document trouble calls from product end users.
* Run simulations and physical tests using laboratory equipment to ensure system efficiency under varied conditions.
* Perform root-cause analysis on hardware failures in harsh environments.
* Design ruggedized solutions to protect sensitive electronics.
* Ensure all technical documentation and testing meet required standards for field distribution.​

Work Environment
  
  

* Standard flexible work schedule.
* Travel is ​< 10%​.
* Cubicle environment.

We invest in the lives of our employees, both in and out of the workplace, by providing competitive pay and benefits packages. Benefits offered may include health care, dental, vision, life insurance; 401(k); education assistance; paid time off including PTO, holidays, and any other paid leave required by law. The salary offered will depend on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, internal equity, business needs, and other factors permitted by law. Posted pay ranges are a general guideline only and are not a guarantee of compensation or salary.
  
  
EEO Statement
  
ASRC Federal and its Subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, gender, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identification, national origin, religion, marital status, ancestry, citizenship, disability, protected veteran status, or any other factor prohibited by applicable law.

We have an exciting Automation Engineering Supervisor opportunity in our Guymon processing facility. This position provides oversight and supervision to ensure activities and tasks are completed and improved and maximizes department efficiencies, workflow optimization, and staffing deployment. Ensures all maintenance and preventive maintenance activities conducted by the automation team adhere to all workplace and food safety protocols.

* Strong technical knowledge of industrial electrical systems, motor controls, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), human-machine
