new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.
  
  
Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.
  
  
Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
  
  
Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
  
  
Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.
  
  
Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers.
  
  
Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholders’ management.
  
  
Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
  
  
Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.
  
  
Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
  
  
Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
  
  
Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.
  
  
Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation and/or under construction data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.
  
  
A day in the life  
As a Data Center Controls Engineer, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who depend on you to deliver reliable, well integrated Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). The problems you solve are technical: modifying controls logic to address operational issues, developing Methods of Procedure (MOPs) for firmware upgrades, or investigating complex alarm discrepancies across monitoring systems. For new builds, you own the controls scope from vendor submittal review through commissioning and turnover. You manage vendor relationships, budgets, and schedules for both service contracts and capital projects. Your internal stakeholders include your Controls Manager, Controls Technicians you provide technical direction to, and partner teams (Construction, Critical Projects Implementation, Commissioning, DCEO).
  
  
About the team  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Why AWS
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

new_jobs.title: Reliability Engineer- Electrical Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. The **Reliability Engineer (Electrical Engineering)** will lead electrical reliability, signal-integrity validation, and product qualification for cable backplane assemblies used in AI and hyperscale data centers. The role will develop scalable test strategies and automated systems, characterize high-speed channels and electrical interfaces, and identify failure mechanisms under electrical and environmental stress. In partnership with design, manufacturing, quality, and external laboratories, the engineer will drive root-cause resolution and design and process improvements. This position is based in Etters, PA or Raleigh, NC. Approximately 20% travel is expected.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop electrical reliability and validation strategies, test plans, acceptance criteria, and coverage across the product life cycle.
* Architect and validate automated electrical test systems, fixtures, breakout boards, and loopback setups for laboratory and manufacturing use.
* Characterize signal and electrical performance using TDR, VNA, BERT, oscilloscopes, source-measure units, and related equipment.
* Evaluate channel, power, ground, shielding, continuity, resistance, and dielectric performance before, during, and after environmental and accelerated-life testing.
* Apply DOE, MSA, reliability statistics, and data analysis to ensure test capability and identify degradation trends and failure thresholds.
* Lead electrical failure analysis and document results, risks, and recommendations for design, qualification, manufacturing, and customer decisions.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, electronics, or reliability engineering with an electrical focus; advanced degree preferred.
* 5+ years in electrical reliability, product validation, signal-integrity testing, or automated test-system development; interconnect experience preferred.
* Strong knowledge of circuit fundamentals, transmission lines, differential signaling, impedance, grounding, shielding, power integrity, and electrical failure mechanisms.
* Hands-on experience developing automated test systems, interpreting schematics and interconnect drawings, and troubleshooting intermittent or mixed-mode failures.
* Working knowledge of reliability statistics, DOE, MSA, sampling methods, data analysis, and cross-functional project execution.
* Ability to travel approximately 20% to manufacturing sites, laboratories, suppliers, and customer locations.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with high-speed serial channels, cable and connector validation, S-parameters, calibration, de-embedding, and simulation-to-measurement correlation.
* Automation experience using Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB, PLCs, or comparable control and data-acquisition tools.
* Experience with HALT, HASS, ALT, ORT, ESS, thermal cycling, vibration, and shock testing with in-situ electrical monitoring.
* Experience designing and validating electrical test boards, including schematics, component selection, layout review, and bring-up.
* Knowledge of AI data-center interconnects and applicable IPC, IEC, IEEE, Telcordia, or MIL-STD requirements; reliability certification is a plus.

new_jobs.title: Firmware Engineer III
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT FIREFLY AEROSPACE**
===========================

**Firefly Aerospace is a space and defense technology company that enables our world to launch, land, and operate in space – anywhere, anytime. As the partner of choice for critical space missions, Firefly is the only commercial company to launch a satellite to orbit with 24-hour notice and the only company to achieve a successful Moon landing. Our launch vehicles, lunar landers, and orbital vehicles provide government and commercial customers with full mission services from low Earth orbit to the Moon and beyond. Headquartered in north Austin, Texas, Firefly is looking for passionate, hardworking innovators to join our team and help fuel our successful trajectory into space.**


**SUMMARY**

In this role you will help design, develop, test, and integrate the embedded flight software for Firefly spacecraft. You will work in a group of software engineers through all stages of spacecraft software development processes and collaborate with other engineering teams.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, develop, and test embedded firmware for microcontrollers and microprocessors in bare-metal or RTOS environments.
* Architect and implement low-level drivers, communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, etc.), and system-level firmware for real-time applications.
* Collaborate with hardware engineers to define system architecture, debug hardware/firmware interactions, and ensure seamless integration.
* Optimize firmware for power efficiency, performance, and memory constraints in resource-limited embedded systems.
* Participate in code reviews, maintain high-quality code standards, and document firmware designs and processes.
* Contribute to system-level debugging, performance profiling, and validation of embedded systems.
* Optionally, support FPGA integration, including firmware interfacing with FPGA designs, or contribute to custom OS builds using tools like Yocto or Buildroot.

QUALIFICATIONS

**Required**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 5+ years of professional experience in embedded firmware development in Linux environments.
* Proven track record of delivering real-world industry projects involving embedded firmware developed as bare-metal or RTOS applications (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar).
* Strong programming skills in C/C++ for embedded systems, with experience in assembly language as a plus.
* Experience with communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB, Ethernet, etc.) and real-time system constraints.
* Familiarity with debugging tools (JTAG, SWD, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) and embedded development environments.

**Desired**

* Experience developing C++ applications for embedded systems.
* Proficiency in CI/CD workflow development for embedded firmware projects (e.g., Teamcity, GitLab CI, or similar).
* Experience with FPGA development, including firmware integration with FPGA designs.
* Familiarity with custom OS builds using Yocto, Buildroot, or similar embedded Linux build systems.

**Firefly offers outstanding benefits for our employees, including generous health, dental and vision plans with low plan deductibles, parental leave, relocation benefits, educational reimbursement, short term disability, and flexible PTO options.**
=========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Firefly Aerospace, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Firefly is governed based on merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

new_jobs.description:
**Important:** This position is based in our **Houston, TX office near Hobby Airport**, and **both the position and interview process require candidates to be available to work and interview in our Houston office.** This is a primarily hands-on role supporting our engineering, laboratory, and manufacturing operations.

**About the Role**
------------------

Heath Consultants is seeking an experienced Senior Embedded Engineer to join our Product Engineering team. In this role, you will play a key part in the design, development, testing, and support of sophisticated **embedded electronic instrumentation and systems used in the natural gas utility industry**.

This is a hands-on engineering position for someone who enjoys working across the boundaries of **electronics, embedded firmware, instrumentation, sensing, and systems engineering**. You will have the opportunity to take products from concept and design through prototype, testing, manufacturing, and ongoing product improvement.

As an Electrical Engineer III, you will serve as an experienced technical contributor and help shape engineering decisions through sound technical judgment, hands-on problem solving, and collaboration with teams across the organization.

You’ll work closely with **firmware, software, mechanical engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, repair, and product management** to develop reliable products that serve real-world customer needs in the gas utility market.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Electronics & Embedded Systems**

* Develop embedded and real-time systems using **C, C++, Python, and/or MATLAB**.
* Apply electrical engineering principles across **analog, digital, power, and embedded firmware** systems.
* Design and support **low-power electronics for portable, handheld instruments**, including wired and wireless connectivity.
* Lead or contribute to electronics architecture and design, including **schematics, PCB layouts, board bring-up, design reviews, and product release support**.
* Perform PCB designs and edits as well as guide local and remote PCB designers by establishing clear layout requirements and constraints, including:
  + Board stack-up
  + Component placement
  + Grounding
  + Power routing
  + High-speed routing
  + Design for Manufacturing (DFM)

### **Firmware, Software & Simulation**

Hexium is modernizing Atomic Vapor Laser Isotope Separation (AVLIS) into a scalable industrial technology for domestic isotope production. We are designing and building complex systems combining high-power lasers, electro-optics, precision controls, instrumentation, and custom electronics.

Our engineers work directly on the hardware, from initial design and prototyping through integration and testing. As an Electrical Engineer, you'll build systems that are central to Hexium's technology and to critical U.S. energy and national-security supply chains.

**Role**

We're looking for an Electrical Engineer to design, build, and test the power electronics, power supplies, and control hardware behind our laser and separation technology, including high-temperature and induction heating hardware. This is a hands-on, iterative design role within our Technology Development group, with a focus on developing reliable, multi-kilowatt power systems for complex experimental environments. Beyond power systems, you'll contribute to instrumentation, diagnostics, and lab controls work across the company.

The ideal candidate has practical experience designing and testing power electronics. They're comfortable around high-voltage hardware and enjoy solving hard problems through hands-on experimentation and close collaboration with scientists and mechanical engineers.

* Design, build, and test power electronics and power supplies, including inverters and their control and protection circuitry

* Evaluate, specify, and integrate commercial power equipment alongside in-house designs
* Contribute to instrumentation and diagnostics projects, including sensor signal conditioning and data acquisition (DAQ)

new_jobs.title: Senior Robotics Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you've come to the right place!

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.

We're intentional, we're unapologetically curious and we're 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.

The E-Space Manufacturing team builds the world's most advanced aerospace products at high rate and high precision.

As a Senior Robotics Engineer, you'll program and integrate the ABB and Fanuc robots that assemble our satellites. You'll own robotic cells end-to-end - from path planning and EOAT integration to commissioning and cycle-time optimization - and serve as the dedicated robotics owner the team needs as we scale. This is a hands-on role for someone who has deployed industrial robots in production and wants to build a robotics function from a strong foundation. This position reports to the Manufacturing Engineering leadership team.

### **What you'll be doing:**

* Program, simulate, and deploy ABB and Fanuc robots for assembly, pick-and-place, and material-handling applications.
* Own robotic cells from concept through commissioning, including path planning, EOAT integration, and safety.
* Optimize cycle time, reliability, and throughput of production robotic cells.
* Integrate robots with Beckhoff controls, vision systems, sensors, and end-of-arm tooling.
* Develop and maintain robot programs, frames, and tooling calibrations.
* Lead on-floor commissioning, troubleshooting, and handover of production cells.
* Mentor junior robotics engineers and set programming standards.

### **What you will bring to this role:**

* 5+ years programming and integrating industrial robots in production - ABB and/or Fanuc.
* Hands-on experience with robot cell design, EOAT integration, and commissioning.
* Familiarity with machine vision, sensors, pneumatics, and safety systems.
* Understanding of how robotics integrate with PLC/motion control (Beckhoff a plus).
* Strong troubleshooting skills on live production equipment.
* BS in Robotics, Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics Engineering, or equivalent.

### **Extra points for the following:**

* Both ABB and Fanuc programming experience.
* Offline programming / simulation (RobotStudio, Roboguide).
* Machine-vision and force-control integration.
* Aerospace, PV/solar, or thin-film manufacturing background.

### **Closing**

This is a full time, exempt position, based out of our Arlington, TX facility.

We are redefining how satellites are designed, manufactured and used - so we're looking for candidates with passion, deep knowledge and direct experience. If that's your experience, then we'll be immediately wow-ed.

E-Space is not currently able to provide employment sponsorship for candidates who do not hold work authorization for the location of this role.

**Why E-Space is right for you:**

As a member of our team, you will play a crucial role in driving our success. Our team members have a strong sense of dedication and responsibility; this includes a strong commitment to our mission to create an entirely new suite of global capabilities to improve lives, business efficiencies and build a smarter planet. This means that there will be times when extra hours, including nights and weekends, may be needed to meet critical deadlines and mission goals. In return, we offer a dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development and the chance to make a meaningful impact in a high-growth industry.

We want you to make the most of your journey at E-Space. That's why we support and invest in the physical, emotional and financial well-being of our team members and their families. Some of what you can expect when working at E-Space:

* An opportunity to really make a difference

* Innovative thinking is encouraged

2. Modernize and modularize legacy subsystems within the Java EE / WildFly monolith: refactor tight couplings into clean, testable service boundaries and well-defined internal interfaces without disrupting customer upgrade paths or operational uptime.

3. Own data tier architecture and performance across relational and analytical data stores (MariaDB, ColumnStore, RDS), including query optimization, connection pooling, transactional integrity, and automated schema migrations across release boundaries.

4. Deliver cohesive full-stack capabilities, partnering backend APIs with modern web user interfaces (React, TypeScript) to provide responsive, enterprise-grade fleet management experiences.

5. Design and evolve high-performance RESTful APIs alongside long-standing SOAP services, ensuring robust backward compatibility and interoperability between on-premises appliances, endpoints, and external management consumers.

6. Progressively architect, build, and integrate companion cloud microservices (primarily Go, alongside Node.js and Python) on AWS using event-driven and serverless architectures (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, AWS IoT) to connect on-prem appliance fleets into the broader cloud platform.

7. Investigate and resolve high-complexity distributed systems failures, concurrency issues, memory leaks, thread contention, and performance bottlenecks across the stack using JVM profilers, database query analyzers, thread/heap dumps, and Linux system telemetry.

8. Establish and champion AI-augmented software engineering practices: direct agentic coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code) on complex refactoring and feature tasks, set architectural guardrails, and mandate rigorous validation standards so AI velocity enhances codebase health.

9. Architect resilience and fault tolerance into fleet-management subsystems, including high availability (HA), failover semantics, cluster replication, and disaster recovery.

10. Author comprehensive automated test suites spanning JUnit backend unit/integration tests, Go testing packages, database test tiers, contract tests (Pact), and end-to-end browser workflows (Playwright), raising code quality across legacy and modern repositories.

11. Collaborate across organizational boundaries, partnering with architects, Product Management, QA, and Sustaining to scope technical initiatives, negotiate interface contracts, and align engineering roadmaps.

12. Mentor and elevate engineers across the organization through deep design reviews, high-leverage code reviews, architectural RFCs, and technical brownbags.

  

Qualifications

1. 8+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and maintaining enterprise-grade production software, with significant depth in backend systems.

2. Deep expertise in Java and the JVM ecosystem in large, multi-threaded, high-concurrency codebases (memory management, garbage collection tuning, thread safety, profiling).

3. Solid experience with enterprise Java architectures (WildFly or comparable application servers; Java EE / Jakarta EE technologies such as EJBs, JPA, JMS, JAX-RS).

4. Strong relational and analytical database architecture skills (MariaDB, MySQL, ColumnStore, or PostgreSQL): schema design, index optimization, complex query tuning, transaction management, and safe, zero-downtime migration strategies.

5. Proven full-stack capabilities: hands-on experience designing and implementing modern front-end applications (React, TypeScript, modern CSS/build tooling) alongside RESTful APIs.

6. Experience designing and maintaining both RESTful APIs and SOAP-based service paradigms with strict backward-compatibility guarantees.

7. Track record of successful refactoring in large, mature codebases: untangling legacy monoliths, introducing abstraction boundaries, and applying design patterns (e.g., strangler fig, clean architecture) without breaking backward compatibility.

8. Solid Linux systems programming and networking fundamentals: POSIX concepts, process lifecycle, inter-process communication, sockets, TCP/IP, and diagnostic tooling.

9. Demonstrated experience integrating agentic AI

new_jobs.title: Principal RF Electrical Engineer
new_jobs.description:
HawkEye 360 is seeking a Principal RF Electrical Engineer and Team Lead on the Space Team. The Space Team's mission is to design, build, and test small commercial satellites that provide revolutionary RF geospatial analytics.

You will lead electrical and RF design of our space platforms, with emphasis on digital, analog, and power electronics design as well as RF payloads including Software Defined Radios (SDRs), RF front ends, and antenna systems. You'll oversee PCB design from schematic capture through layout and manufacturing while also defining and executing performance tests to verify mission requirements. You will lead a small team of RF and Electrical Engineers, providing technical guidance and mentorship while remaining hands-on with design and test activities.

This role requires strong Electrical and RF Engineering expertise, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work cross-functionally with mechanical, software, payload, and systems engineering teams.

**Your main responsibilities will be:**

* Design digital, analog, and power electronics for satellite flight hardware while overseeing team execution of schematic capture, PCB layout, RF chain design, and power subsystem development to ensure technical accuracy and on‑schedule delivery.
* Lead PCB design and layout activities with attention to RF design considerations including controlled impedance, grounding, shielding, power distribution, and signal integrity.
* Establish engineering best practices, design standards, and review processes to maintain high reliability and consistency across all hardware designs.
* Facilitate root‑cause analyses and corrective action efforts, aligning engineering teams around data‑driven problem solving for flight hardware anomalies.
* Manage task planning, delegation, and technical roadmapping to ensure the RF/EE team meets program milestones from concept through flight qualification.
* Work closely with PCB Contract Manufacturers (CMs) to ensure quality control and timely delivery of flight hardware.
* Design and develop RF payload architectures and Software Defined Radio systems for space-based RF collection missions.
* Develop test procedures and automation scripts to characterize SDR and RF front-end Performance.
* Support spacecraft integration and testing efforts, including the design of Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE), flatsats for functional testing, and satellite flight hardware testing.
* Perform first article hardware unit testing, including reception inspection, burn-in testing, thermal validation, and hardware checkouts.

**Your skills and qualifications:**  
**Essential education and experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in RF/Electrical Engineering or related field.
* 10+ years of hands-on experience designing and testing RF electronics, including SDRs, mixers, filters, amplifiers, and receiver chains.
* Expertise in PCB design and layout (Altium or similar) including schematic capture, component selection, and layout for mixed-signal and RF applications.
* Strong Understanding of power electronics, high-speed digital design, and analog circuit design.
* Strong understanding of RF fundamentals (impedance matching, S-parameters, noise figure, linearity, etc.) and software-defined radio architectures.
* Experience using lab equipment such as Spectrum Analyzers, Network Analyzers, Signal Generators, Noise Figure Analyzers, and RF test chambers.
* Hands-on flight hardware experience (satellite integration, RF lab testing, prototyping, troubleshooting).
* Experience handling ESD-sensitive components and operating in cleanroom environments.
* Strong communication skills to explain complex technical concepts to cross-functional stakeholders.
* 1+ years of technical leadership, project leadership, or team lead experience.

**Desirable:**

* Experience working in the smallsat or space industry with RF payloads or communication systems.
* Experience designing for radiation environments (TID and Proton)
* Experience with version control (git) and modern engineering workflows.
* Proficiency with Python, MATLAB, C++, or other coding languages for RF analysis and test automation.
* Experience with RF simulation tools (ADS, CST, Genesys, HFSS, Scikit-RF, Emerge, or similar) and RF modeling.
* Familiarity with CAD (NX, SolidWorks, etc.) to support electro-mechanical integration.

**Company Overview:**

HawkEye 360 is equipping defense, intelligence, and national security leaders with mission-critical signals intelligence to enable faster, better decision making. By detecting, geolocating, and characterizing radio frequency emissions worldwide, HawkEye 360 delivers trusted domain awareness and early warning indicators to the US Government and allied partners. Our space-based collection, proprietary signal processing, and AI-powered analytics transform knowledge of RF spectrum into a strategic advantage. Proven by operational mission success, HawkEye 360 is redefining how signals intelligence strengthens national and global security.

*HawkEye 360 is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.*

new_jobs.title: Senior Principal Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today's five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Principal Systems Engineer to join our growing team in Lanham, MD. This is a senior technical leadership role with system-level authority across multiple programs: owning system architecture, setting technical direction, resolving the most complex cross-cutting issues, and developing the next generation of systems engineering leads.

The ideal candidate brings a record of leading systems engineering on complex space or comparable programs from concept through launch and operations, is trusted by executives, customers, and engineers alike, and thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment where no two days look the same.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the technical authority for systems engineering across multiple programs, owning system architecture and technical direction from concept through verification, validation, launch, and on-orbit operations.
* Define and own system architectures and mission concepts, leading trade studies and making and defending key technical decisions in response to customer and internal needs.
* Establish top-level system requirements and govern their allocation, flow-down, and interface control across subsystems, suppliers, and organizations.
* Own technical budgets and margin philosophy (mass, power, link, thermal, schedule) at the program and constellation level, and ensure rigorous tracking across subsystems.
* Drive system-level integration across engineering disciplines (RF, software, mechanical, electrical, GNC, operations) and lead resolution of the most complex cross-cutting technical issues and anomalies.
* Provide technical leadership for proposal and business development efforts, including solution architecture, basis-of-estimate development, and cost/schedule inputs, and represent AST in technical engagements with customers and government partners.
* Serve as senior technical lead for major design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) and technical interchange meetings (TIMs), presenting to executive leadership, customers, and independent review boards.
* Lead technical risk management: identify and quantify top program and technical risks, drive mitigation, and advise leadership on risk-informed decisions.
* Define and evolve systems engineering processes, standards, practices, and drive their adoption across the organization.
* Mentor and develop SE leads and engineers, serve as a technical coach across the department, and contribute to hiring and talent growth.
  

**Qualifications**

**Education:**

Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field required; Master's degree or PhD strongly preferred

**Experience:**

A minimum of 12 years of systems engineering experience, with at least 5 years serving as SE Lead, Chief Engineer, or equivalent on a program of record or flight program, including end-to-end lifecycle experience on at least one program through launch and on-orbit operations

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in a relevant engineering discipline.
* Experience in space, satellite, or defense programs, ideally satellite communications, phased array, or RF payload systems.
* Experience establishing or leading SE practices and configuration control processes at the program or organizational level.

**Soft Skills:**

* Proven ability to lead and influence without direct authority across cross-functional teams and at the executive level.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to brief and build trust with executive, customer, and government audiences.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity: able to define the path forward and make sound decisions when requirements are incomplete or roles are fluid.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with the judgment to balance technical rigor against schedule and cost.
* Ability to manage multiple competing priorities across programs in a dynamic, fast-moving environment.
* Demonstrated mentor who builds technical talent and raises the bar for the team.
* Self-starter who takes ownership and drives issues to closure without close supervision.

**Technology Stack:**

* Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for documentation, analysis, and reporting.
* Requirements management tools: DOORS, Jama, or equivalent, with experience defining requirements management practices.
* MATLAB / Simulink for analysis and trade studies (preferred).
* Confluence and Jira for program tracking and collaboration.
* STK (Systems Tool Kit) for mission analysis (preferred).

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to work in a standard office environment and use a computer for extended periods.
* Occasional travel to other AST SpaceMobile facilities or customer/government sites (up to 20%).

*This job description may not be inclusive to the duties and responsibilities listed. Additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time or the scope of the job may change as needed by business demands**.*

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

**About the Role**
------------------

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations — which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance — supporting Manufacturing and Supply Chain across all Blue Origin facilities. You will sit on the software team within Operations that builds tools in direct support of our Manufacturing Engineers.

We are returning humankind to the Moon, and Blue Origin's Manufacturing Engineers build the hardware that gets us there. On our small AI Solutions team, you will own the backend and data layer behind the tools a 100+ person Manufacturing Engineering organization depends on. Several enterprise systems describe the same products from different angles, and they do not always agree. Your work turns that into one trusted picture of the product: the data models, integrations, and APIs our applications and AI features are built on. This is a systems-design role at its core, and the best engineers here also make a point of understanding the people they build for, so you will spend time on the floor with Manufacturing Engineers to learn the work before building for it.

  

**Special Mentions**
--------------------

* Shifts: 1st | Mon–Fri (8am–5pm)
* Location: Renton, WA (fully onsite / "work from work," co-located with the Manufacturing Engineering organization and production floor)
Relocation: Available  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the backend services, APIs, and data models behind the tools our team builds, primarily in Python, holding the technical-design and code-review bar as they grow.
* Build integrations that bring product data together from our enterprise systems, reconciling sources that describe the same things in different ways.
* Improve, harden, and modernize existing applications — not just greenfield work — including auth, data integrity, testing, and technical debt.
* Shape our product data so AI features can actually use it: structure, naming, and context a model can navigate reliably — plus human-in-the-loop safeguards and the evaluations that show whether those features are working.
* Deploy and operate the team's services on our cloud infrastructure (AWS), including CI/CD, monitoring, day-to-day reliability, and a share of on-call.
* Spend time with Manufacturing Engineers to learn how their work actually flows, and use data to validate that what you ship is actually helping the engineers who use it.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production backend services
* Strong backend and API development in Python or a comparable language (REST and/or GraphQL), including interfaces that applications and AI agents both build on
* Depth in relational data modeling and SQL — changing a schema and migrating data in production without breaking the applications built on it
* Experience integrating multiple systems of record: reconciling identifiers, handling incomplete or inconsistent data, and building pipelines that recover cleanly from partial failure
* Hands-on experience deploying and running applications on AWS and containerized infrastructure
* Comfortable integrating LLMs into products, with judgment about what data a model can actually work with and whether an AI-assisted system is genuinely working — designing evaluations, questioning flattering results, and reviewing AI-generated code for correctness
Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration; able to work directly with non-technical users to turn their needs into working software  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience designing a shared data model or service that multiple applications depend on
* Experience preparing data for retrieval or agentic use, where the data's shape rather than the prompt was what made it work
* Experience modeling complex hierarchical data, such as product structures or bills of materials
* Experience connecting documents and engineering artifacts into structured workflows
* Prior experience building software in, or in direct support of, a manufacturing, aerospace, hardware production, or operations environment
* Familiarity with manufacturing execution systems (MES), work-order/work-instruction authoring systems, or PLM — or a demonstrated habit of learning a domain deeply before building for it
* Experience building internal tools that other engineers or operators actually adopted

Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.

**Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:**

**Building the future of Disney’s media:** Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.

**Reach, Scale & Impact:** More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.

**Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

**Media Engineering** builds the software and systems that prepare media content and metadata for the Disney Streaming platform - providing the best possible playback experience to our viewers.

Media Engineering handles audio, video, and metadata content from ingest through publish - for normalization, processing, and packaging - supporting operator tools and automation for a scalable workflow. We build logic across players and back-end services to measure, control, and optimize playback across our stack.

Our team is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to help us deliver excellent streaming experiences for Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN+ as a developer of our web-based JavaScript player. Our team is responsible for playback across many devices including browsers, televisions, gaming consoles, and set-top boxes. You will have the opportunity to lead in the design and implementation of our cross-platform JavaScript player that runs Disney+, Hulu and ESPN on these devices.

We’re looking for an experienced engineer who has video player and cross platform development experience. Excellent fluency in JavaScript and web development is required. You should have a passion for coding and debugging hard problems, and an eagerness to help us deliver seamless video to our subscribers. Being a Senior engineer, you will get to own large features, lead the technical direction of our work, and mentor and provide technical expertise to other engineers. You will work closely with other technical teams in the application layer and backend video services to deliver features.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain our JavaScript player that drives our streaming experience
* Optimize our player to perform well for resource constrained platforms
* Create and review architecture and technical designs
* Maintain a strong understanding of our code to identify, research and address issues
* Collaborate with application development teams, services engineering teams and product management to help understand and explain device limitations and requirements
* Lead in strategies to ensure the quality and stability of our deployments, including testing strategies and telemetry approaches
* Develop our project’s build system and continuous integration system as needed
* Provide technical expertise or mentoring to developers on our team
* Drive high development standards

**Basic Qualifications**

* BS or BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of full software development lifecycle experience
* Highly fluent in JavaScript and web technologies
* Experience developing for web browsers & other web-based client devices
* Experience in Streaming technologies, such as:

  + HLS (preferred) or DASH
  + DRM technologies like PlayReady or Widevine
  + Adaptive Bitrate Streaming Algorithms
  + Caption and subtitle formats such as CEA-608 / 708
  + Codecs AVC, HEVC, AAC, EAC3
* Experience developing and optimizing high-performance client-side media applications
* Experience using build runners / compilation tools for multi-platform projects
* Strong individual contributor with a drive to learn and patience to teach others
* Great communication and collaboration skills and a strong teamwork ethic
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools effectively

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing for living room devices, e.g. Samsung, LG, Hisense, Vizio.
* Experience developing for gaming consoles (e.g. Playstation, Switch), Android devices (e.g.FireTV), or similar devices

#DISNEYTECH

  
The hiring range for this position in Seattle, WA is $150,900.00 to $202,400.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

This position is with Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology.

**Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology**

On any given day at Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology, we’re reimagining ways to create magical viewing experiences for the world’s most beloved stories while also transforming Disney’s media business for the future. Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to maximize flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world.

*A few reasons why we think you’d love working for Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology*

* **Building the future of Disney’s media business:** DE&E Technologists are designing and building the infrastructure that will power Disney’s media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.
* **Reach & Scale:** The products and platforms this group builds and operates delight millions of consumers every minute of every day – from Disney+ and Hulu, to ABC News and Entertainment, to ESPN and ESPN+, and much more.
* **Innovation:** We develop and execute groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and enhance how audiences experience sports, entertainment & news.

The Product & Data Engineering team is responsible for end-to-end development for Disney’s world-class consumer-facing products, including streaming platforms Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN+, and digital products & experiences across ESPN, Marvel, Disney Studios, NatGeo, and ABC News. The team drives innovation at scale for millions of consumers around the world across Apple, Android, Smart TVs, game consoles, and the web, with our platforms powering core experiences like personalization, search, messaging and data.

**Job Summary:**

The Android Browse team, responsible for building the experiences that help guide our users to their favorite content on Hulu and Disney+, is seeking an experienced Software Engineer with a passion for mobile applications to join our team. Our highly collaborative team brings together folks from many fields, including quality assurance, program management, product management, UX, and engineering. We are responsible for the apps that millions of subscribers use to watch their favorite movies and shows every single day. We strive to build and maintain the best Live and Video on Demand (VOD) applications on a broad set of Android devices including phones, tablets and TVs, from Android 7 to the latest developer preview. We would love to see samples of your work. If you’ve got something to share with us, please make sure your resume or application links to your GitHub account or an app in the Play Store.

On the Android team, we are accountable to one another, committed to aligning on common goals and moving forward. We do so because we know that no one person or team alone could achieve what we've set out to do! As a team, we continuously analyze data to improve our Apps, our processes, and how we work together.

Why you'd want to work with us:

* Nurture a highly collaborative, world-class team of software engineers.
* Work on a cutting-edge and evolving technology stack.
* Own substantial features shipped to millions of users.
* Influence the innovation of high-profile products in the media streaming landscape.
* Join an inclusive culture that incorporates diverse perspectives and supports individual needs.

**Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:**

* Work closely with UX designers, product managers, and engineering leadership to craft best-of-class, delightful TV-watching experiences
* Work closely with other client and backend engineers, to architect and implement solutions that are built to last.
* Demonstrate engineering excellence by developing test infrastructures, writing documentation, and following an agile development methodology.
* Assist with critical components including our release process and remote configuration management.
* Manage production issues and solve novel problems.
* Mentor associate and mid-level team members and support peers through code review and pair programming.
* Identify areas for growth within the team processes and develop new systems for collaboration.

**Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:**

Basic Qualifications

* Minimum of 7+ years of experience with Kotlin and Android development
* A deep understanding of the Android SDK, Activity and Fragment lifecycles, thread management, custom views, compose and animations
* Deep knowledge of Android app architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI, etc.) and design principles.
* Experience integrating with backend systems, web services, and third-party software
* Proven understanding and experience using reactive frameworks such as RxJava or Flow
* Be an excellent communicator who collaborates well across teams.
* Successfully lead a project from start to finish
* You build high-quality code by always writing tests and using performance evaluation tools like Android Profiler
* Experience with test automation, dependency injection frameworks, and continuous integration
* Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot), to improve software design, engineering productivity and system capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

* Familiar with Scrum and Agile methodologies
* Experience building UI with Compose
* A growth mindset towards learning, experience mentoring others, and a desire to give and receive feedback.
* Familiarity with Android TV / Amazon Fire TV development
* Experience with streaming video (DASH or HLS protocol), codecs, and DRM

Required Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience.

Our team is seeking someone who can fill the role of a Senior Software Engineer to create a feature rich standard streaming media playback library on Apple devices. Our intention is to design and develop a layered architecture for media playback which can span all the Disney direct-to-consumer brands like Disney+, ESPN, ABC News, and Hulu. You enjoy the challenges presented by difficult problems and take pride in finding solutions which successfully thread the needle between design constraints, technical constraints, and the end experience of your users. * Design and implement solutions in collaboration with team-members for new features which integrate with various Disney media services and back-ends.

* Participate in project estimation and resource planning.

**Job Description:**

Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. We continue to invest in electrical and firmware engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic and connected-device capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, wireless connectivity, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence.

  

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen. You will be responsible for the device connectivity architecture and strategy, strategic roadmap planning, resource allocation and scope management, oversight of technical reviews and design decisions, and process improvement and change management. We strive to recruit the best talent in the industry and give employees opportunities for continuing education and training to help them advance in their careers.

This role is responsible for applying entry-level knowledge of engineering principles and practices in electrical engineering to support NPD, sustaining and productivity designs that have limited complexity. This role will be heavily involved in testing and troubleshooting electrical designs in support of sustaining, production, and new product development projects.

* Use various software to design product models of control boxes; problem-solve manufacturing issues and redesigns models as necessary.
* Assist in the evaluation of sensors for compatibility, scope sequence of operations for products and check compatibility with firmware
* Test and troubleshoot electrical circuits by using common test equipment such as power supplies, signal generators, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers and network analyzer
* Write technical documentation such as specifications and test reports to support project deliverables
* Build prototype electrical circuits by using basic soldering skills and basic project management skills
* Design electrical circuits and PCBs using Altium Designer
* Analyze and simulate electrical circuits
* Comply with health and safety guidelines and rules; managers should also ensure compliance across their teams.
* Protect Chamberlain Group’s and Systems’ reputation by keeping information confidential.
* Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reading professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies.

Job Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* An advanced degree in a directly applicable area of study may substitute for work related experience
* UL 508A MTR or ability to acquire certification within 1 year of employment
* Relevant work experience or Electrical engineering internship (~0.5 years)

* Knowledge typically acquired through some on-the-job training
* Works under direction and typically follows protocols
* Asks effective questions and solicits feedback to understand needs

Other:

* Able to travel up to 10% - domestically and internationally

Preferred Job Requirements:

* Six Sigma Green Belt certification
* Intern or co-op experience in electrical engineering
* Experience with electrical components, proximity sensors, radar sensors, switch mode power supplies, power management circuits, motor control circuits, analog circuits
* Experience with wireless communication standards like Wi-Fi or Bluetooth

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

* Ability to work within cross functional teams to create electro-mechanical products; strong analytical skills; effective communication skills; ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment

With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As a Software Engineer, Applications, you will help shape the future of Trusted Content within the Trusted Content & Standards team. In this role, you will work with product management, operating segment stakeholders, customer co-innovation teams, and other Rockwell Automation engineering teams to define, develop, and scale Trusted Content development capabilities and standards that accelerate autonomous operations across design, operations, and maintenance workflows.

You combine strong systems and automation engineering experience with curiosity, collaboration, and execution discipline. You are an expert in Rockwell Automation technologies and Rockwell Automation product applications. You should be comfortable working across ambiguity, distilling organizational knowledge into Trusted Content methods and standards, and turning emerging ideas into repeatable solutions, proofs of concept, and scalable practices that support both internal teams and customer-facing efforts. You will report to Engineering Manager, Trusted Content & Standards and will work Hybrid in Milwaukee or Mequon, WI, Austin, TX or Mayfield Heights, OH.

### **Standards Development**

* Work with the Trusted Content Organization in addition to Operating Segments, Commercial Engineering, Technical Consultants to define best practices as standards

* Drive decisions through collaboration and cooperation of cross-functional teams

* Develop methods to check and grade adherence to defined standards through automated reviews and peer checks.

* Identify new areas where standards are needed to drive cohesiveness in development practices and consistency in delivered products.

### **Library and Application Development**

* Define Trusted Content Applications & Software leveraging Logix Designer, View Studio, View Designer, Optix Studio, Future Rockwell IDE and other Automation centric tools to create optimized Application Architectures for applications and work cells.

* Define and optimize Libraries that support creation of applications and software in Rockwell Automation’s Automation Development Environments.

* Participate, keep informed, and drive awareness in Rockwell Automation around the evolution of Industry Standards that support Trusted Content (including OPC-UA Companion Specifications, ISA, specific manufacturer requirements, and others).

* Support Development and Prioritization of Firmware and Software functions supporting Trusted Content application integration in controllers, drives, and other products.

* Help define Digital Engineering Strategies (Digital Twins, Automated Code, and Automated Library creation principles) that assist Development of Automotive Applications

* Manage intellectual property as it is being created and become part of Trusted Content patent development.

* Design integrated and complex automation systems using Trusted Content through modern methodologies

* Identify new industries and applications for Trusted Content and prioritize based on current library coverage, development delta to meet gaps, and effort to develop, deploy, and support

* Work with key members of the Trusted Content team to Pilot, Develop, and Refine new AI assisted library development workflow

### **Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Trusted Content Innovations team to develop requirements and review output

* Work closely with Commercial Engineering and Technical Consultants to determine future Library and Industry needs for Trusted Content

### **Other**

* Support global events such as Automation Fair, TechEd, or others as needed

new_jobs.description:
**Job Description:**  
  
Shift: First Shift

MGS has an exciting opportunity for a **Controls Software Engineer** to join our **MGS****Automation** team.

As a **Controls Software Engineer** at MGS, you will be responsible on control systems for pharmaceutical and medical device equipment - PLC application code, machine HMI, device and motion integration, and the data and validation layers that make equipment production and audit ready. Working within project teams and established software standards, the role focuses on writing clean, maintainable machine software on challenging, diverse projects.

Below are additional duties and responsibilities:

* Execute the software design, development, and debug of multi-station automated assembly and test systems
* Design, structure, and develop PLC application code on Rockwell (Studio 5000), Beckhoff (TwinCAT) or similar - clean, modular, reusable, and well-documented
* Architect machine software: state machines, sequencing, fault handling, and standard/reusable code frameworks
* Develop machine HMI applications (Beckhoff or Ignition) for operator interaction, data collection, and traceability
* Program and integrate peripheral devices (servo/motion drives, robotics, vision and inspection systems, smart sensors, and other field hardware)
* Design and program equipment to customer and internal build specifications, applying established design standards and techniques
* Develop software design specifications from requirements
* Apply software engineering best practices across controls deliverables: version control (Git - GitHub / Azure DevOps), branching/merging, code review, and configuration management
* Build structured software testing and validation
* Develop machine-level data, traceability, and integration features for production and audit readiness
* Translate electrical and I/O designs into robust, maintainable control software, and assist with that design work as project needs require
* Support customer start-ups and site acceptance testing as necessary
* Partner with mechanical, project management, and quality teams across the project lifecycle
* Serve as a software point of contact for customers on controls-related aspects of projects
Any other duties as assigned.  

**Experience and Skills:**

A qualified **Controls Software Engineer** candidate would fulfill these requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; a two-year technical program in a related field, combined with relevant hands-on experience, is an acceptable alternative
* 3+ years of software development experience, including industrial controls programming, or strong software engineering experience with demonstrated aptitude to learn PLC platforms
* Strong programming fundamentals: modular/structured design, state machines, Boolean logic, data structures, and software testing and validation
* Hands-on experience programming industrial PLCs on Rockwell (Studio 5000) and/or Beckhoff (TwinCAT), or equivalent software experience with a clear path to ramp on these platforms
* HMI development experience (Beckhoff, Ignition, or comparable)
* Experience using version control (Git) in a collaborative, multi-developer environment
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, and a documentation-minded approach to code
* CI/CD or DevOps practice and automated/structured testing
* Industrial Automation standard language experience (IEC 61131-1) / structured-text and ladder logic programming
* Vision systems, servo/motion control, and robotics integration

**About MGS**

As a global provider of healthcare manufacturing solutions, MGS provides the right balance to drive vital innovations: robust end-to-end solutions combined with the strong customer focus and seamless collaboration of an agile partner. That's why we're the engineering and manufacturing partner of choice for today's leading Pharma, Diagnostic and MedTech innovators. Serving customers from around the world, we transform our customers' most pressing challenges into innovations that improve lives. To learn more about MGS, please visit www.mgsmfg.com.  
**Job Benefits:**

MGS offers a competitive and comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, vision, and 401K with match.

**About the Team**

STR's Intelligence Division researches, develops, and transitions advanced analytics and machine-learning solutions for challenging national-security problems. Our team includes engineers and researchers with advanced backgrounds in engineering, computer science, mathematics, and data science who apply deep technical expertise and creativity to mission-critical challenges.

Our work spans data analysis, deep learning, and statistical methods across networking, communications, social media, text, time series, geospatial, and imagery data. We develop capabilities under constraints not typically encountered in commercial environments. U.S. Government analysts use our tools and technologies to extract, enrich, and act on intelligence information worldwide.

**The Role**

As a Lead Software Engineer, you will lead the technical execution of mission-relevant software systems that operationalize advanced analytics, machine learning, and data-processing capabilities. You will apply software and systems engineering expertise to develop scalable, secure, maintainable applications that operate in complex customer environments.

You will work with software engineers, systems engineers, researchers, and mission partners to translate customer needs into executable technical plans. You will own technical delivery for an assigned project or major subsystem, guiding architecture, implementation, integration, testing, demonstration, and transition.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Lead project execution:** Lead software development from requirements definition through implementation, integration, test, demonstration, deployment, and sustainment
* **Translate mission needs into plans:** Convert customer objectives into requirements, architectures, development plans, milestones, performance measures, and acceptance criteria
* **Lead the technical team:** Lead and mentor software engineers and collaborate with systems engineers, researchers, DevSecOps personnel, and mission partners
* **Manage technical work:** Decompose complex work into actionable tasks; manage dependencies, technical risks, interfaces, and progress toward program objectives
* **Own project architecture:** Design and oversee architectures spanning services, APIs, data pipelines, databases, ML integrations, user interfaces, and deployment infrastructure
* **Drive integration and quality:** Lead design reviews, code reviews, integration activities, testing, customer demonstrations, and release readiness; ensure reliability, security, maintainability, and performance
* **Support growth and transition:** Contribute technical content to proposals, customer engagements, and transition planning while ensuring delivered capabilities are reusable and mission relevant

**Who You Are:**

* **Education and experience:** PhD with 2+ years, MS with 6+ years, or BS with 8+ years of relevant experience in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, or a related technical discipline
* **Clearance eligibility:** Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance, for which U.S citizenship is needed by the U.S government
* **Technical delivery leadership:** Experience leading software development efforts or major workstreams involving applications, services, distributed systems, data platforms, or related domains

* **Architecture experience:** Experience designing system or software architectures for distributed, data-intensive, real-time, cloud, on-premises, or edge systems
* **DevSecOps experience:** Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, container orchestration, cloud platforms, monitoring, logging, and security tooling
* **Large codebase experience:** Experience developing software in large, multi-team code bases using collaborative engineering practices
* **Decentralized systems:** Familiarity with message queues, stream processing, distributed computing, or microservices
* **Customer and capture support:** Experience supporting technical proposals, customer demonstrations, technical briefings, or capture activities with DoW or IC customers
* **Modern development tools:** Experience using LLM-enabled development tools, such as Cursor or Codex, in a secure and effective engineering workflow
